senses.en: A place where people read or borrow books and other materials.
An organised collection of books, recordings, or digital resources.

ex.en: I reserved a study room at the library before the midterm.
ex.zh: 期中考试前，我在图书馆订了一间自习室。

ex.en: The library lends laptops so students can finish research when their own computers fail.
ex.zh: 图书馆出借笔记本电脑，方便学生在自己的电脑出故障时完成研究。

tip: library是借阅书籍的图书馆，bookshop是售书的书店。

senses.en: a person who studies at a school, college, or university

ex.en: Each student needs an ID card to enter the lab.
ex.zh: 每位学生都需要学生证才能进实验室。

ex.en: The survey asked every student how many hours they sleep during exam week.
ex.zh: 这项调查询问每位学生考试周睡多少小时。

tip: student不限于大学生；pupil主要指中小学生。

senses.en: an institution offering degree courses and conducting advanced research

ex.en: She chose the university because of its engineering program.
ex.zh: 她因为工程专业而选择了这所大学。

ex.en: The university requires first-year students to attend a short course on academic honesty.
ex.zh: 这所大学要求一年级学生参加一门关于学术诚信的短课。

tip: 用a university而非an，因开头发辅音/j/。

senses.en: A series of lessons about a particular subject.
The route something follows or the way events develop.
One part of a meal served separately from other parts.

ex.en: This course meets on Tuesdays in the science building.
ex.zh: 这门课每周二在科学楼上课。

ex.en: The course combines a weekly lecture with a smaller discussion section.
ex.zh: 这门课把每周一次的讲座和规模更小的讨论课结合在一起。

tip: course 是整门课程；lesson 是其中的一节课。

senses.en: A book of blank pages for writing notes.
A small portable computer with a folding screen.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a spiral notebook.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论螺旋装订笔记本。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a spiral notebook.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论螺旋装订笔记本的材料。

col: write in a notebook｜在笔记本上写
a spiral notebook｜螺旋装订笔记本
tip: 通常指纸质笔记本；电脑义也可说notebook computer。

senses.en: A formal test of knowledge or ability.

ex.en: Our professor circled exam results on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了考试成绩。

ex.en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of exam results.
ex.zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得考试成绩这个例子。

col: revise for an exam｜复习备考
tip: exam是examination的常用缩写；参加考试用take。

senses.en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend.
A social group or category sharing particular characteristics.
To place someone or something in a particular category.

ex.en: Our professor circled social class on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会阶层。

ex.en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of social class.
ex.zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得社会阶层这个例子。

tip: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

senses.en: Schoolwork that students are asked to complete outside lessons.
Research or preparation done before making a decision.

ex.en: Our professor circled hand in homework on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了交作业。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss hand in homework.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论交作业的材料。

col: do your homework｜做好事前准备
tip: 不可数名词；一项作业用a piece of homework。

senses.en: An institution offering education beyond school, including practical or academic courses.
A constituent institution or division within a university.

ex.en: Office hours began with community college.
ex.zh: 答疑从社区学院开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss community college.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论社区学院的材料。

col: go to college｜上大学或学院
tip: 美式常泛指大学；英式多指学院或继续教育院校。

senses.en: A university teacher, especially one holding a senior academic position.

ex.en: The professor posted the slides after class.
ex.zh: 教授课后上传了课件。

ex.en: The professor asked us to question the method before accepting the conclusion.
ex.zh: 教授让我们在接受结论之前先质疑研究方法。

tip: 英国通常指高级职称；美国也泛指大学教师。

senses.en: A short piece of writing exploring a particular subject.

ex.en: His essay opened with a clear claim.
ex.zh: 他的文章以一个明确的主张开头。

ex.en: A strong essay explains the evidence before it states what the evidence implies.
ex.zh: 一篇好的文章会先解释证据，再说明证据意味着什么。

col: an essay on｜一篇关于……的文章
tip: 可数名词；一篇关于某主题的文章用an essay on。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something.
An organized and systematic approach to an activity.

ex.en: We changed the method after the first trial failed.
ex.zh: 第一次试验失败后，我们改了方法。

ex.en: The passage contrasts a traditional method with a newer way to measure sleep.
ex.zh: 文章把一种传统方法和一种更新的睡眠测量方式做了对比。

tip: 常用a method of/for doing sth表示做事的方法。

senses.en: The natural world, including land, water, air, and living things.
The conditions and surroundings in which someone lives or works.

ex.en: Noise in the dorm affects the study environment.
ex.zh: 宿舍里的噪音会影响学习环境。

ex.en: The lecture linked a warming environment to changes in when plants flower.
ex.zh: 讲座把变暖的环境与植物开花时间的变化联系了起来。

tip: 泛指自然环境常用the environment。

senses.en: the way a person or animal acts
the way a substance or system acts under particular conditions

ex.en: Sleep loss can change a student's behavior in class.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会改变学生在课堂上的行为。

ex.en: Researchers recorded behavior during the task so they could compare the two groups.
ex.zh: 研究者记录了任务过程中的行为，以便比较两组受试者。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为behaviour。通常不可数。

senses.en: The activity of entering words using a keyboard.

ex.en: Office hours began with touch typing.
ex.zh: 答疑从盲打开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss touch typing.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论盲打的材料。

tip: 作名词时不可数；也是type的现在分词。

senses.en: Relating to men or boys, or the sex that produces sperm.
A male person or animal.

ex.en: The textbook introduces male students in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了男学生。

ex.en: The author returns to male students when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了男学生。

col: male and female｜男性和女性；雄性和雌性
tip: male可作形容词或名词；日常指男人通常用man。

senses.en: A collection of recorded music released as one product.
A book for keeping photographs, stamps or similar collections.

ex.en: The textbook introduces debut album in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了首张专辑。

ex.en: The author returns to debut album when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了首张专辑。

tip: 音乐专辑用album；单曲用single。

senses.en: plan how something will look or work before making it
the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: The professor asked us to design a building.
ex.zh: 教授让我们设计建筑。

ex.en: When the class discussed the humanities, the speaker told us to design a building.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人文学科时，讲者让我们设计建筑。

col: be designed to do something｜旨在做某事
tip: be designed to do表示“旨在做……”。

senses.en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about violin lessons.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于小提琴课的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to violin lessons when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了小提琴课。

col: a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。

senses.en: speaking or behaving without respect for others

ex.en: Office hours began with rude behaviour.
ex.zh: 答疑从粗鲁的行为开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of rude behaviour.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得粗鲁的行为这个例子。

tip: 对某人无礼用 rude to someone，不用 rude with。

senses.en: To make the sounds of a word when speaking.
To state an official decision or judgment.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to pronounce a word.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何读出单词。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to pronounce a word.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来读出单词。

col: pronounce someone innocent｜宣布某人无罪
tip: 名词是pronunciation，注意中间没有字母o。

senses.en: the skill or power needed to do something

ex.en: Office hours began with academic ability.
ex.zh: 答疑从学业能力开始。

ex.en: The author returns to academic ability when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学业能力。

col: the ability to learn｜学习能力
develop an ability｜培养一种能力
tip: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

senses.en: a device that captures sound, images, or information
a wooden or plastic wind instrument with finger holes
a person who keeps an official record

ex.en: The textbook introduces digital recorder in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了数字录音机。

ex.en: The author returns to digital recorder when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了数字录音机。

tip: play the recorder指吹竖笛，不是播放录音机。

senses.en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money
The medal awarded for first place in a competition
Made of gold or having its yellow colour

ex.en: The textbook introduces pure gold in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纯金。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss pure gold.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论纯金的材料。

tip: gold作材料名通常不可数；a gold可指一枚金牌。

senses.en: the way a word or language is spoken

ex.en: Our professor circled clear pronunciation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了清晰的发音。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss clear pronunciation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论清晰的发音的材料。

tip: 拼写是pronunciation，注意中间不是noun。

senses.en: The food and drink someone regularly consumes.
A planned way of eating for health or weight control.
To control what you eat, usually to lose weight.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论均衡饮食。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论均衡饮食的材料。

col: a diet rich in fibre｜富含纤维的饮食
go on a diet｜开始节食
tip: diet不一定指节食，也可指日常饮食。

senses.en: A country's military force trained mainly to fight on land.
A large group of people working toward a shared purpose.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an army of volunteers.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于大批志愿者的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an army of volunteers.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大批志愿者展开说明。

col: serve in the army｜在陆军服役
an army of volunteers｜大批志愿者
tip: army主要指陆军；armed forces泛指各军种。

senses.en: relating to society and how people live together
relating to meeting people and spending time with them
living naturally in organised groups rather than alone

ex.en: Our professor circled social inequality on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会不平等。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around social inequality.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕社会不平等展开说明。

tip: social指社会或社交的；sociable指人爱交际。

senses.en: The currency used by many countries in the European Union.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about the euro area.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于欧元区的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the euro area.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论欧元区的材料。

tip: 普通英语中复数通常为euros；并非所有欧盟国家都用欧元。

senses.en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required
control of a country or people by a leader or group
to govern a country or make an official legal decision

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on rule out.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论排除。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rule out.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论排除的材料。

tip: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

senses.en: the son of your son or daughter

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on youngest grandson.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论最小的孙子或外孙。

ex.en: The reading connects youngest grandson with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把最小的孙子或外孙和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: youngest grandson｜最小的孙子或外孙
eldest grandson｜最大的孙子或外孙
tip: 不区分父系与母系，既指孙子也指外孙。

senses.en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation
to mark something as needing attention
to become weaker or less energetic

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on national flag.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论国旗。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss national flag.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论国旗的材料。

tip: 动词过去式flagged，进行式flagging，双写g。

senses.en: To become someone's husband or wife.
To perform the ceremony that makes two people legally married.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to marry young.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何年纪轻轻就结婚。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to marry young.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得年纪轻轻就结婚。

tip: 说marry someone或get married to，不说marry with。

senses.en: A person who uses a product, service, or facility.

ex.en: Our professor circled road user on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了道路使用者。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of road user.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得道路使用者这个例子。

tip: use作动词及user中的s读/z/。

senses.en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes
made of plastic
able to be shaped or changed easily

ex.en: The textbook introduces single-use plastic in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一次性塑料。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of single-use plastic.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得一次性塑料这个例子。

tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

senses.en: A green vegetable with thick stems and tightly clustered flower buds.

ex.en: The textbook introduces steamed broccoli in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了蒸西兰花。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of steamed broccoli.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得蒸西兰花这个例子。

col: a head of broccoli｜一整颗西兰花
tip: 通常不可数；小朵西兰花可说broccoli florets。

senses.en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to protect the environment.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何保护环境。

ex.en: The passage says students who can protect the environment follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够保护环境的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: protect from harm｜保护……免受伤害
tip: 常用protect sb/sth from或against，表示免受伤害。

senses.en: the mother of your husband or wife

ex.en: I wrote mother-in-law on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把mother-in-law和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses mother-in-law when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了婆婆。

col: future mother-in-law｜未来的婆婆或岳母
supportive mother-in-law｜给予支持的婆婆或岳母
tip: 指配偶的母亲；复数mothers-in-law。

senses.en: A website or page with regularly added posts.
To write and publish posts on a blog.

ex.en: The textbook introduces travel blog in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了旅行博客。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss travel blog.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论旅行博客的材料。

col: blog about something｜写关于某事的博客
tip: 一篇博文叫a blog post；blog常指整个博客。

senses.en: using electronic systems that store and process information as digits

ex.en: Our professor circled digital technology on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数字技术。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss digital technology.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论数字技术的材料。

tip: digital侧重数字技术；表示“数字上的”常用numerical。

senses.en: Showing respect and consideration for other people.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about polite request.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于礼貌的请求的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss polite request.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论礼貌的请求的材料。

col: polite to someone｜对某人有礼貌
tip: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

senses.en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity
Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity

ex.en: The textbook introduces full of energy in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精力充沛。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around full of energy.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕精力充沛展开说明。

tip: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

senses.en: the group of people officially controlling a country or region
the activity or system of controlling a country

ex.en: Office hours began with local government.
ex.zh: 答疑从地方政府开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used local government to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用地方政府来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 英国英语中，指政府群体时可接单数或复数谓语。

senses.en: in a way that is accurate or follows the rules

ex.en: The professor told us to correctly identify and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们正确识别，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to correctly identify before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先正确识别。

col: if I remember correctly｜如果我没记错
tip: 修饰动作；correct是形容词或动词，不作副词使用。

senses.en: treating people equally or reasonably
having pale skin or light hair
an event where people display or sell goods and services

ex.en: The textbook introduces trade fair in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了贸易展览会。

ex.en: A campus survey used trade fair to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用贸易展览会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: fair指待遇公平；fairly还可表示“相当”。

senses.en: An object used to build, repair, or make things.
Something that helps you perform a task or achieve something.

ex.en: I copied a useful tool into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把实用工具抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a useful tool.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论实用工具的材料。

col: a tool for learning｜学习工具
tip: tool是可数名词；equipment通常不可数。

senses.en: the joint connecting your foot to your leg

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a swollen ankle.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论肿胀的脚踝。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a swollen ankle.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论肿胀的脚踝的材料。

tip: ankle指脚与小腿连接处，不是脚后跟heel。

senses.en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal.
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fierce competition.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论激烈竞争。

ex.en: The reading connects fierce competition with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把激烈竞争和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

senses.en: to talk about something and exchange ideas
to examine a subject in speech or writing

ex.en: The professor asked us to discuss a problem.
ex.zh: 教授让我们讨论问题。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to discuss a problem.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得讨论问题。

col: discuss something with someone｜与某人讨论某事
tip: 直接接讨论内容：discuss sth，不加about。

senses.en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals.
To eat small amounts of food between main meals.

ex.en: Our professor circled a healthy snack on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了健康零食。

ex.en: A campus survey used a healthy snack to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用健康零食来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: snack on nuts｜吃坚果当零食
tip: 动词常用snack on sth，表示吃某物当零食。

senses.en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised
someone or something that provides a good example to follow
a person who displays clothes or poses for artists

ex.en: Office hours began with scale model.
ex.zh: 答疑从比例模型开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scale model.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕比例模型展开说明。

tip: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

senses.en: lacking physical strength or energy
not effective, convincing, or well supported
having little intensity, flavour, or power

ex.en: The textbook introduces weak evidence in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了薄弱的证据。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around weak evidence.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕薄弱的证据展开说明。

tip: weak与week同音；weakness可指弱点，也可指虚弱。

senses.en: To design or make something that did not exist before.
To make up a story or excuse that is untrue.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to invent a device.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求发明装置。

ex.en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to invent a device.
ex.zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们发明装置。

tip: invent是创造新事物；discover是发现已有事物。

senses.en: to find something or learn something previously unknown

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to discover a cure.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须发现疗法。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to discover a cure.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来发现疗法。

col: discover a new species｜发现新物种
tip: discover发现原本存在的事物；invent创造新事物。

senses.en: Someone who plans how something will look or work.
Made by a famous fashion designer, usually expensive.

ex.en: Our professor circled fashion designer on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了时装设计师。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fashion designer.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论时装设计师的材料。

tip: 作形容词常置于衣物等名词前，强调设计师品牌。

senses.en: A child who attends school.
The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on primary school pupil.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小学生。

ex.en: A campus survey used primary school pupil to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用小学生来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 英式英语常指中小学生；大学生用 student。

senses.en: The words someone knows or uses in a language.
The words used in a particular subject or activity.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on expand your vocabulary.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论扩大词汇量。

ex.en: A campus survey used expand your vocabulary to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用扩大词汇量来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: a limited vocabulary｜有限的词汇量
tip: 单个词用word；vocabulary通常指词汇总量或集合。

senses.en: A thin paper tube filled with tobacco for smoking.

ex.en: Office hours began with cigarette smoke.
ex.zh: 答疑从香烟烟雾开始。

ex.en: The reading connects cigarette smoke with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把香烟烟雾和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a packet of cigarettes｜一包香烟
tip: 可数名词；一包香烟可说a packet of cigarettes。

senses.en: Using, producing, or relating to electricity.
Full of excitement and energy.

ex.en: I copied electric car into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把电动汽车抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of electric car.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得电动汽车这个例子。

tip: 电动设备多用electric；电气系统多用electrical。

senses.en: armed fighting between countries or groups
a determined effort to defeat something harmful

ex.en: Our professor circled civil war on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了内战。

ex.en: The author returns to civil war when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了内战。

col: war on poverty｜消除贫困的斗争
tip: 表示处于交战状态用at war，不加冠词。

senses.en: A person who reads, especially books, newspapers, or magazines
A device that displays written material or reads stored information
A book designed to help learners develop reading skills

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an avid reader.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论热衷阅读的人。

ex.en: The reading connects an avid reader with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把热衷阅读的人和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an avid reader｜热衷阅读的人
tip: reader既可指人，也可指设备或供学习的读物。

senses.en: The process of learning or teaching knowledge and skills.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on higher education.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高等教育。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of higher education.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得高等教育这个例子。

col: access to education｜受教育的机会
tip: 通常不可数；但可说a good education（良好教育）。

senses.en: A distinctive way of doing something or expressing ideas.
The design of something or a fashionable appearance.
To arrange or design something to achieve a particular look.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on writing style.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论写作风格。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss writing style.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论写作风格的材料。

col: style your hair｜给头发做造型
tip: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

senses.en: A trained person who cares for ill or injured people.
To care for someone who is ill or injured.

ex.en: I copied registered nurse into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把注册护士抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to registered nurse when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了注册护士。

col: nurse someone back to health｜照料某人直至康复
tip: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

senses.en: No longer married because the marriage legally ended.
Separated from something that should be closely connected.

ex.en: The textbook introduces divorced parents in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了离异父母。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss divorced parents.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论离异父母的材料。

tip: get divorced表示离婚；脱离某事用divorced from。

senses.en: The idea that a word, action, or message communicates.
The importance or purpose that makes something worthwhile.

ex.en: The textbook introduces literal meaning in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了字面意思。

ex.en: The reading connects literal meaning with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把字面意思和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the meaning of a word｜词义
give meaning to life｜赋予生活意义
tip: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

senses.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: The textbook introduces an active lifestyle in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了积极运动的生活方式。

ex.en: The author returns to an active lifestyle when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了积极运动的生活方式。

col: an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式
play an active role｜发挥积极作用
tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: Available through the internet or connected to a computer network.
Using the internet or while connected to a computer network.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about available online.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于可在网上获取的的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects available online with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可在网上获取的和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：shop online。

senses.en: someone who plays music, especially professionally

ex.en: I copied professional musician into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把职业音乐人抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects professional musician with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把职业音乐人和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: musician指音乐人；作曲家更具体地用composer。

senses.en: a building where Christians gather to worship
Christian religious worship attended as a service
an organized group of Christians sharing beliefs and practices

ex.en: Office hours began with attend church.
ex.zh: 答疑从参加礼拜开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss attend church.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论参加礼拜的材料。

tip: go to church指做礼拜；go to the church指去教堂。

senses.en: A grand official home for a royal or important leader.

ex.en: I copied royal palace into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把王宫抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of royal palace.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得王宫这个例子。

tip: 主要用作名词；palace gardens中作名词定语。

senses.en: the activity of taking food into your body
taking food into your mouth and swallowing it

ex.en: I copied healthy eating into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把健康饮食抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects healthy eating with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把健康饮食和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: eating可作动名词；eat out表示外出就餐。

senses.en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on digital technology.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论数字技术。

ex.en: The reading connects digital technology with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把数字技术和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

senses.en: A set of connected parts that work together.
An organised structure through which services or institutions operate.
An organised way of doing something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on heating system.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论供暖系统。

ex.en: The reading connects heating system with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把供暖系统和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: public transport system｜公共交通系统
tip: systematic指有条理的，systemic指全系统的。

senses.en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.

ex.en: Our professor circled square centimetre on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了平方厘米。

ex.en: The author returns to square centimetre when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了平方厘米。

tip: 英式拼写centimetre，美式centimeter；缩写cm。

senses.en: the scientific study of living things
the natural processes and characteristics of a living thing

ex.en: I copied marine biology into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把海洋生物学抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects marine biology with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把海洋生物学和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 学科名称，通常不可数；生物学家是biologist。

senses.en: Someone who creates pictures using paint.
Someone whose job is painting buildings or other surfaces.

ex.en: Office hours began with a landscape painter.
ex.zh: 答疑从风景画家开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a landscape painter.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得风景画家这个例子。

tip: 既可指艺术画家，也可指刷墙的油漆工。

senses.en: Something discussed, studied, or taught.
Affected by something or dependent on a condition.
To make someone experience something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about school subject.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于学校科目的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects school subject with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把学校科目和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: subject someone to stress｜使某人承受压力
tip: 动词重音在后：/səbˈdʒekt/；常用subject A to B。

senses.en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship.
Two things or people, or a small number of them.
To join two things or consider them together.

ex.en: Our professor circled a married couple on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一对已婚夫妇。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a married couple.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕一对已婚夫妇展开说明。

col: a married couple｜一对已婚夫妇
tip: a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。

senses.en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money
to invent a new word or expression

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a gold coin.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于金币的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a gold coin.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕金币展开说明。

tip: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。

senses.en: Something done to achieve a result or address a problem.
A particular thing that someone does.
Exciting events in a story, film, or real situation.

ex.en: The textbook introduces urgent action in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了紧急行动。

ex.en: The reading connects urgent action with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把紧急行动和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: take action中的action不可数；具体举动可用actions。

senses.en: A surface on which electronic images or films appear.
To check people or things for problems or suitability.
To show a film or programme to an audience.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about touch screen.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于触摸屏的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to touch screen when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了触摸屏。

tip: screen A for B表示检查A是否存在B问题。

senses.en: A large fortified building with thick walls and towers.

ex.en: Our professor circled medieval castle on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了中世纪城堡。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss medieval castle.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论中世纪城堡的材料。

tip: castle中的t不发音；palace指宫殿。

senses.en: Written words, especially the main written content of something.
A short written message sent using a phone.
Send someone a short written message using a phone.

ex.en: I copied plain text into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把纯文本抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to plain text when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了纯文本。

tip: 文字内容通常不可数；一条短信可说a text。

senses.en: something that happens because of an action or event
the final score or outcome of a test or competition
to happen because of something or cause something to happen

ex.en: Our professor circled result in on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了导致。

ex.en: A campus survey used result in to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用导致来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: result in后接结果；result from后接原因。

senses.en: A set of keys used to enter information into a computer

senses.zh: 乐器键盘；电子键盘乐器
senses.en: A musical instrument's keys, or an electronic instrument with keys

ex.en: Office hours began with wireless keyboard.
ex.zh: 答疑从无线键盘开始。

ex.en: The author returns to wireless keyboard when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了无线键盘。

col: play the keyboard｜弹电子键盘乐器
tip: 电脑键盘常说a keyboard；演奏键盘乐器用play the keyboard。

senses.en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about generate electricity.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于发电的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss generate electricity.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论发电的材料。

tip: electricity不可数；electric多指用电的，electrical指电相关的。

senses.en: something made or grown to be sold or used
something that results from a process or situation
the result of multiplying two or more quantities

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about product development.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于产品开发的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of product development.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得产品开发这个例子。

tip: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。

senses.en: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments and tests

ex.en: The textbook introduces research lab in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了研究实验室。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around research lab.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕研究实验室展开说明。

tip: lab是laboratory的常用缩写，二者均为可数名词。

senses.en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.

ex.en: Our professor circled criminal lawyer on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了刑事律师。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of criminal lawyer.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得刑事律师这个例子。

tip: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。

senses.en: the name given to a book, film, or other work
a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role
the position of winner in a sporting competition

ex.en: Office hours began with book title.
ex.zh: 答疑从书名开始。

ex.en: The author returns to book title when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了书名。

tip: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。

senses.en: a machine that produces paper copies of digital documents or images
a person or business that prints books and other materials

ex.en: The textbook introduces laser printer in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了激光打印机。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss laser printer.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论激光打印机的材料。

tip: print是打印；printer可指机器，也可指印刷从业者。

senses.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.
The humorous quality of a situation or event.

ex.en: The textbook introduces romantic comedy in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了浪漫喜剧。

ex.en: The author returns to romantic comedy when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了浪漫喜剧。

tip: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。

senses.en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.

ex.en: Office hours began with travelling circus.
ex.zh: 答疑从巡回马戏团开始。

ex.en: The reading connects travelling circus with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把巡回马戏团和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 可指马戏团或表演；复数为circuses。

senses.en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results.
Unwanted material left after something has been used or made.
An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.

ex.en: The assignment is to waste time, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先浪费时间，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to waste time.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来浪费时间。

col: a waste of money｜浪费金钱
tip: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。

senses.en: the head of state in a country without a monarch
the person leading an organisation, company, club, or university

ex.en: The textbook introduces university president in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了大学校长。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of university president.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得大学校长这个例子。

tip: 可指总统，也可指机构负责人；具体译法看语境。

senses.en: Sleeping rather than awake.

ex.en: The textbook introduces fast asleep in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了熟睡的。

ex.en: The author returns to fast asleep when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了熟睡的。

tip: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。

senses.en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about news reporter.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于新闻记者的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to news reporter when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了新闻记者。

tip: reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。

senses.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony.
The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the reigning queen.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论在位女王。

ex.en: The reading connects the reigning queen with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把在位女王和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。

senses.en: The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills.
Ideas or principles taught by a person or tradition.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a career in teaching.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论教师职业生涯。

ex.en: The reading connects a career in teaching with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把教师职业生涯和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a career in teaching｜教师职业生涯
tip: 指教学时不可数；指教义或学说常用teachings。

senses.en: the science of matter, energy, forces, and their interactions

ex.en: The textbook introduces the laws of physics in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了物理定律。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the laws of physics.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论物理定律的材料。

col: the laws of physics｜物理定律
tip: 虽以s结尾，仍作不可数名词，谓语用单数。

senses.en: to grow or make something stronger, larger, or more advanced
to create a new product, method, or idea
to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling

ex.en: The lab instructions say to develop skills.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求培养技能。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to develop skills.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们培养技能。

tip: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。

senses.en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness
strong emotional suffering caused by loss or distress
to cause someone emotional suffering

ex.en: I copied sharp pain into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把剧痛；刺痛抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to sharp pain when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了剧痛；刺痛。

tip: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。

senses.en: certainly, with no doubt about something

ex.en: The professor told us to definitely worth and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们绝对值得，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to definitely worth before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先绝对值得。

tip: 拼写是definitely；不要与defiantly混淆。

senses.en: A device or application used for mathematical calculations

ex.en: I copied scientific calculator into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把科学计算器抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to scientific calculator when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了科学计算器。

tip: calculator指工具；calculation指计算过程或结果。

senses.en: the natural object that moves around Earth
a natural object that moves around a planet

ex.en: Office hours began with full moon.
ex.zh: 答疑从满月开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used full moon to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用满月来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: the surface of the moon｜月球表面
tip: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。

senses.en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing.
The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions.
To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a voice in decisions.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论决策中的发言权。

ex.en: The reading connects a voice in decisions with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把决策中的发言权和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a voice in decisions｜决策中的发言权
tip: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。

senses.en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position

ex.en: The professor explained king with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了国王。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up king while discussing evidence about public institutions.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共制度的证据时提到了国王。

col: the king's reign｜国王的统治时期
tip: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。

senses.en: A way in which people or things are not alike
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a significant difference.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于显著差异的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a significant difference to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用显著差异来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。

senses.en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity

ex.en: Our professor circled scrap metal on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了废金属。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scrap metal.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕废金属展开说明。

tip: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。

senses.en: To give someone something they need or make it available.
To support someone financially by supplying what they need.

ex.en: The assignment is to provide support, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先提供支持，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to provide support.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们提供支持。

col: provide access to｜提供使用……的机会
provide someone with something｜向某人提供某物
tip: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。

senses.en: An illness affecting humans, animals or plants

ex.en: The textbook introduces heart disease in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了心脏病。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of heart disease.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得心脏病这个例子。

col: the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。

senses.en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

ex.en: I copied a former classmate into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把以前的同班同学抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a former classmate to explain a pattern in student life.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用以前的同班同学来解释校园生活中的一种模式。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

senses.en: the end of a person's or animal's life

ex.en: The textbook introduces premature death in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了过早死亡。

ex.en: The author returns to premature death when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了过早死亡。

tip: die是动词，dead是形容词，death是名词。

senses.en: popular music with catchy tunes and usually simple structures
to burst or make a short, sharp sound
to go somewhere briefly or put something somewhere quickly

ex.en: I copied pop music into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把流行音乐抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects pop music with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把流行音乐和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: pop into a shop｜顺便进店
tip: 表示短暂去或顺手放时属非正式用法。

senses.en: Involving two or more countries.
A match between countries, or a player representing a country.

ex.en: Office hours began with international trade.
ex.zh: 答疑从国际贸易开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of international trade.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得国际贸易这个例子。

tip: international涉及多国；domestic指国内的。

senses.en: Something that happens, especially an important or planned occasion.
A particular contest within a sports competition.

ex.en: Office hours began with major event.
ex.zh: 答疑从重大事件开始。

ex.en: The reading connects major event with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把重大事件和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: in the event of｜万一发生
tip: in the event of后接名词，意为“万一发生”。

senses.en: Used to introduce a contrasting statement.
No matter how much or to what degree.
In any way that someone chooses.

ex.en: However, the author limits the claim in the final paragraph.
ex.zh: 然而，作者在最后一段限定了这个主张。

ex.en: However, evidence from a single semester cannot support a policy for the whole college.
ex.zh: 然而，仅一个学期的证据不足以支持面向全院的政策。

col: however hard you try｜无论你多努力
tip: 表转折时不是并列连词；勿仅用逗号连接两句。

senses.en: Any person, or someone whose identity is not specified.

ex.en: Office hours began with hardly anybody.
ex.zh: 答疑从几乎没有人开始。

ex.en: The reading connects hardly anybody with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把几乎没有人和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: anybody作主语时，谓语用单数形式。

senses.en: To use physical force against another person or group.
To try hard to stop something or achieve a goal.
An occasion of physical conflict or a determined effort against something.

ex.en: The professor asked us to fight poverty.
ex.zh: 教授让我们与贫困作斗争。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to fight poverty.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来与贫困作斗争。

col: get into a fight｜卷入打斗
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为fought；fight for表示争取。

senses.en: Showing poor judgment or a lack of sensible thought.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a stupid mistake.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于愚蠢的错误的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a stupid mistake to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用愚蠢的错误来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 直接说别人stupid带侮辱性，评价人时应避免。

senses.en: The daughter of someone's son or daughter

ex.en: The textbook introduces youngest granddaughter in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最小的孙女或外孙女。

ex.en: A campus survey used youngest granddaughter to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用最小的孙女或外孙女来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: youngest granddaughter｜最小的孙女或外孙女
granddaughter's birthday｜孙女或外孙女的生日
tip: 既指孙女也指外孙女，英语不区分父系与母系。

senses.en: A piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine, or website.
A single item, especially one belonging to a particular group.
A word such as a, an, or the before a noun.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a newspaper article.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论报纸文章。

ex.en: A campus survey used a newspaper article to explain a pattern in public communication.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用报纸文章来解释公共传播中的一种模式。

col: an article of clothing｜一件衣物
tip: 一件衣物可说an article of clothing。

senses.en: The main page of a website, linking to other sections.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on website homepage.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论网站主页。

ex.en: A campus survey used website homepage to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用网站主页来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: 也可写作home page；不等于网站中的任意网页。

senses.en: For every hundred, used when expressing a proportion.

ex.en: The professor explained percent with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了百分之。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses percent when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了百分之。

col: a five percent increase｜百分之五的增长
tip: 英式也写per cent；具体比例用percent。

senses.en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.

ex.en: Our professor circled a young teenager on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了十三四岁的青少年。

ex.en: The author returns to a young teenager when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了十三四岁的青少年。

col: a young teenager｜十三四岁的青少年
as a teenager｜在青少年时期
tip: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

senses.en: A married woman managing her home rather than doing paid work.

ex.en: Our professor circled a full-time housewife on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了全职家庭主妇。

ex.en: A campus survey used a full-time housewife to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用全职家庭主妇来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: a full-time housewife｜全职家庭主妇
work as a housewife｜做家庭主妇
tip: 复数为housewives；homemaker不限定性别。

senses.en: including everything, or complete in degree
the amount obtained by adding everything together
to reach a particular amount or add amounts together

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about total cost.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于总费用的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss total cost.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论总费用的材料。

tip: in total表示“总共”；totally常表示“完全地”。

senses.en: a person who serves in an army

ex.en: The textbook introduces professional soldier in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了职业军人。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around professional soldier.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕职业军人展开说明。

col: serve as a soldier｜当兵服役
tip: 通常指陆军军人；水手和飞行员另有专称。

senses.en: A room or building where artworks are displayed or sold.
A raised seating area overlooking a hall or theatre.
A collection of images available to view, especially online.

ex.en: The textbook introduces art gallery in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了美术馆；画廊。

ex.en: The author returns to art gallery when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了美术馆；画廊。

col: public gallery｜公共美术馆；旁听席
tip: gallery主要展示艺术品；museum涵盖的展品范围更广。

senses.en: a substance stored in bodies or used in cooking
having a large amount of body fat

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on body fat.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论体脂。

ex.en: The author returns to body fat when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了体脂。

tip: 用fat形容人可能冒犯；谈健康宜用overweight。

senses.en: the act of exchanging something for money
a period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices
the amount sold or money earned from selling goods

ex.en: The textbook introduces a clearance sale in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了清仓促销。

ex.en: A campus survey used a clearance sale to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用清仓促销来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: for sale指待售；销售额或销量通常用复数sales。

senses.en: A secret word or sequence used to gain access.

ex.en: I copied a strong password into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把安全性高的密码抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a strong password to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用安全性高的密码来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

col: a strong password｜安全性高的密码
tip: password是密码；passcode也可指数字口令。

senses.en: the final part of a story, event, or activity
a final word part that often shows grammatical information

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a happy ending.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于圆满结局的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of a happy ending.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得圆满结局这个例子。

col: a surprise ending｜出人意料的结局
tip: 故事结局用ending；at the end表示在末尾。

senses.en: to help, encourage, provide for, or agree with someone
to hold something up or bear its weight
help, encouragement, money, or something that holds another thing up

ex.en: The professor asked us to support a family.
ex.zh: 教授让我们养家。

ex.en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers support a family before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要养家。

col: support an argument｜为论点提供依据
tip: support是及物动词；名词常用support for。

senses.en: a mixture of gases and particles produced when something burns
to breathe in smoke from burning tobacco
to produce smoke

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on thick smoke.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论浓烟。

ex.en: The author returns to thick smoke when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了浓烟。

tip: smoke作“烟雾”通常不可数；smoky意为烟雾弥漫的。

senses.en: sound or moving images saved for later listening or viewing
the process of saving sounds, images, or information

ex.en: Office hours began with audio recording.
ex.zh: 答疑从音频录音开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used audio recording to explain a pattern in public communication.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用音频录音来解释公共传播中的一种模式。

tip: 一段录音可数；表示录制过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: describing a place where smoking is not allowed
describing someone who does not smoke

ex.en: The professor explained non-smoking with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了禁止吸烟的。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up non-smoking while discussing evidence about public health.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了禁止吸烟的。

tip: 可指场所禁烟，也可指人不吸烟。

senses.en: a desire to learn about or become involved in something
money paid for borrowing money or earned on savings
to make someone want to know or learn more

ex.en: Our professor circled stimulate interest on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了激发兴趣。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss stimulate interest.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论激发兴趣的材料。

col: take an interest in｜对……产生兴趣
tip: 兴趣用interest in；具体爱好可用复数interests。

senses.en: to express, involve, or intend something
unkind or unwilling to share or spend money
the total of several values divided by how many exist

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to mean value.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何平均值。

ex.en: The reading asks you to mean value and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你平均值，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: mean to do something｜打算做某事
mean doing something｜意味着做某事
be mean to someone｜对某人刻薄
tip: mean to do是“打算做”；mean doing是“意味着做”。

senses.en: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping
something you strongly hope to achieve or experience
to experience dreams while sleeping or imagine something you want

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about dream of becoming.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于梦想成为的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around dream of becoming.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕梦想成为展开说明。

col: a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip: dream of/about后接名词或动名词；过去式可用dreamt或dreamed。

senses.en: to go to an event or regularly visit an institution
to deal with something or care for someone

ex.en: I heard the lecturer attend a meeting during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时参加会议。

ex.en: The passage says students who can attend a meeting follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够参加会议的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: attend to a problem｜处理问题
tip: 参加活动直接接宾语；处理、照料用attend to。

senses.en: Forming the main or most necessary part of something.
Having only necessary features, without anything extra.

ex.en: The textbook introduces basic skills in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了基本技能。

ex.en: A campus survey used basic skills to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用基本技能来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 名词“基础知识”用复数 the basics。

senses.en: For everyone to use, see, or know about.
Provided or controlled by the government.
Ordinary people in society considered as a group.

ex.en: Our professor circled the general public on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了普通民众。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of the general public.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得普通民众这个例子。

tip: the public指公众；in public指在公共场合。

senses.en: Things people throw away because they no longer need them.
Ideas or statements that are silly or untrue.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about household rubbish.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于生活垃圾的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of household rubbish.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得生活垃圾这个例子。

tip: 通常不可数；英式常用词，美式常说garbage或trash。

senses.en: the act or freedom of choosing between different possibilities
something you can choose, or the range of available options
of especially good quality

ex.en: The textbook introduces freedom of choice in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了选择自由。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of freedom of choice.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得选择自由这个例子。

col: a wide choice of｜种类丰富的
tip: choice是名词，choose是动词；选择做某事用choose to do。

senses.en: Plays and the art of writing or performing them.
An exciting or emotional event or situation.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on television drama.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电视剧。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss television drama.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电视剧的材料。

tip: 戏剧艺术用不可数drama；一部戏剧用a drama。

senses.en: A punctuation mark separating parts of a sentence or list.

ex.en: Our professor circled a misplaced comma on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了位置不当的逗号。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a misplaced comma.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕位置不当的逗号展开说明。

col: a misplaced comma｜位置不当的逗号
separate items with commas｜用逗号分隔各项
tip: comma是逗号，句号通常叫full stop（英）或period（美）。

senses.en: To damage something so badly that it cannot be used.
To completely end something valuable, such as trust or hope.

ex.en: The professor asked us to destroy habitats.
ex.zh: 教授让我们摧毁栖息地。

ex.en: The passage says students who can destroy habitats follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够摧毁栖息地的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: destroy比damage程度重，通常指彻底毁坏。

senses.en: one of two earpieces worn over the ears for listening

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on headphone jack.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论耳机插孔。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss headphone jack.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论耳机插孔的材料。

col: a pair of headphones｜一副耳机
tip: 日常说耳机通常用复数headphones，一副用a pair of。

senses.en: To become better or make something better.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to improve performance.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求提高表现。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to improve performance.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得提高表现。

col: improve access to｜改善获取……的机会
improve living standards｜提高生活水平
tip: 既可及物也可不及物：improve skills；skills improve。

senses.en: The way people know, feel about, and treat each other.
A connection between things or the way they affect each other.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a close relationship.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于亲密关系的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a close relationship to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用亲密关系来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: the relationship between A and B｜甲与乙之间的关系
tip: 与某人的关系用with；两者关系用between。

senses.en: Music with strong rhythms and often freely invented melodies.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about jazz band.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于爵士乐队的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around jazz band.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕爵士乐队展开说明。

tip: 表示音乐类型时通常不可数，不加 a。

senses.en: To produce words or images on paper using a machine
Letters and words produced on paper by printing
A mark left by something pressed against a surface

ex.en: The assignment is to print a document, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先打印文件，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to print a document.
ex.zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们打印文件。

col: in print｜已出版且仍可购得
tip: print out指打印出来；out of print则指书已绝版。

senses.en: agreement allowing someone to do something

ex.en: After the lecture, we used permission in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了许可。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up permission while discussing evidence about social change.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了许可。

col: permission to do something｜做某事的许可
tip: 通常不可数；说give permission，不加a。

senses.en: feeling tired and ready to sleep
quiet and having very little activity

ex.en: Our professor circled sleepy village on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了宁静的村庄。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sleepy village.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论宁静的村庄的材料。

tip: sleepy是想睡的；asleep是已经睡着的。

senses.en: Suffering from an illness or feeling unwell.
Feeling that you might vomit.
Very annoyed or tired of someone or something.

ex.en: Office hours began with sick leave.
ex.zh: 答疑从病假开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used sick leave to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用病假来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: call in sick｜打电话请病假
tip: 英式英语中be sick常指呕吐，feel sick常指恶心。

senses.en: a word naming a person, place, thing, quality, or idea

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about countable noun.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于可数名词的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss countable noun.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论可数名词的材料。

tip: 名词不只指实物，也可指advice等抽象概念。

senses.en: a portable computer with a flat touchscreen
a small solid dose of medicine swallowed whole
a flat stone or metal slab bearing an inscription

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about vitamin tablet.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于维生素片的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to vitamin tablet when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了维生素片。

tip: tablet既指平板电脑，也指药片，需看语境。

senses.en: pain in a tooth or the surrounding area

ex.en: The textbook introduces severe toothache in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了剧烈牙痛。

ex.en: The author returns to severe toothache when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了剧烈牙痛。

tip: 英式常说have toothache，美式常说have a toothache。

senses.en: A measure of how hot or cold something is.
A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.

ex.en: I copied room temperature into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把室温抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to room temperature when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了室温。

col: take someone's temperature｜测量某人的体温
tip: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

senses.en: A person or group that opposes or wants to harm another.
Something that seriously harms or threatens something else.

ex.en: Our professor circled bitter enemy on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了死敌。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around bitter enemy.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕死敌展开说明。

tip: enemy指敌人；比赛对手通常用opponent。

senses.en: an idea or detail expressed in speech or writing
the sharp, narrow end of something
show a direction or object with a finger or tool

ex.en: The textbook introduces main point in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了要点。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of main point.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得要点这个例子。

tip: make a point是提出观点；point at是指着。

senses.en: The vast salt water covering much of Earth's surface.

ex.en: Our professor circled ocean currents on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了洋流。

ex.en: The author returns to ocean currents when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了洋流。

tip: ocean通常比sea范围大；专名常加the。

senses.en: To appear to be a certain way.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to seem likely.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求似乎有可能。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to seem likely.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们似乎有可能。

tip: 常用seem＋形容词或seem to do，不表示装作。

senses.en: A period of one hundred years.

ex.en: I copied the twentieth century into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把二十世纪抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to the twentieth century when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了二十世纪。

col: over a century ago｜一个多世纪以前
the turn of the century｜世纪之交
tip: 世纪序数比年份前两位大一：如1901—2000为20世纪。

senses.en: To take action, behave in a way, or perform a role.
Something that someone does.
A law formally approved by a legislative body.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to act quickly.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求迅速行动。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to act quickly.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来迅速行动。

tip: act as表示充当；act还可指戏剧的一幕。

senses.en: To give an answer without having enough information to be certain.
An answer or opinion given without being certain.
To think something is probably true, without being completely sure.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to guess correctly.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须猜对。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to guess correctly.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来猜对。

col: an educated guess｜有依据的猜测
tip: I guess偏口语，表示“我想、大概”，语气不确定。

senses.en: A schedule showing when lessons, journeys, or other events happen.
To arrange when an event or activity will happen.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about train timetable.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于列车时刻表的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects train timetable with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把列车时刻表和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a revised timetable｜调整后的时间表
tip: 英式常用timetable；美式常用schedule。

senses.en: A king's or queen's daughter, or a prince's wife.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a royal princess.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于王室公主的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a royal princess.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论王室公主的材料。

tip: 可指君主的女儿，也可指王子的妻子。

senses.en: a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a gramme of salt.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一克盐的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a gramme of salt.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一克盐的材料。

tip: gramme是英式变体；gram更常用，单位符号为g。

senses.en: waste material that people throw away
something considered untrue, useless, or very poor in quality

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about garbage collection.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于垃圾收集的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects garbage collection with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把垃圾收集和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: take out the garbage｜把垃圾拿出去
tip: 不可数名词；常见于美式英语，英式多用rubbish。

senses.en: a qualification awarded after completing a university course
the amount or level of something
a unit used to measure temperature or angles

ex.en: Our professor circled a bachelor's degree on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了学士学位。

ex.en: A campus survey used a bachelor's degree to explain a pattern in student life.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用学士学位来解释校园生活中的一种模式。

col: a degree in economics｜经济学学位
to some degree｜在某种程度上
tip: 某专业的学位用a degree in；程度义常见to some degree。

senses.en: A book used to study a particular subject.
Showing exactly how something usually happens or should be done.

ex.en: Our professor circled school textbook on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了学校教材。

ex.en: The author returns to school textbook when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学校教材。

tip: 作形容词时指典型或标准，如textbook example。

senses.en: A thick, slightly sour food made by fermenting milk.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about plain yogurt.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于原味酸奶的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects plain yogurt with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把原味酸奶和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a pot of yogurt｜一小罐酸奶
tip: 英式也常拼作yoghurt；通常不可数，一份可用a yogurt。

senses.en: A computer program designed for a particular task.

ex.en: The textbook introduces mobile app in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了移动应用。

ex.en: The reading connects mobile app with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把移动应用和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: download an app｜下载应用程序
install an app｜安装应用程序
language learning app｜语言学习应用
tip: app是application的缩写；为可数名词，用an app。

senses.en: Either fleshy edge of the opening of the mouth.
The projecting edge of a container, opening, or hollow.

ex.en: I copied upper lip into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把上嘴唇抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of upper lip.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得上嘴唇这个例子。

col: the lip of a cup｜杯口边缘
tip: 上下嘴唇合称lips；lip也可指容器等的边沿。

senses.en: A person who shares a room or apartment.

ex.en: My roommate and I split the grocery list.
ex.zh: 我和室友分开列了购物清单。

ex.en: A noisy roommate can affect sleep and, with it, attention in morning lectures.
ex.zh: 吵闹的室友会影响睡眠，进而影响早课的注意力。

tip: 美式校园听力里极常见；英式也说 flatmate。

senses.en: To feel pain or cause physical injury.
To cause emotional pain or damage something.
Physically injured or emotionally upset.

ex.en: The assignment is to hurt your back, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先伤到背部，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers hurt your back before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要伤到背部。

col: hurt someone's feelings｜伤害某人的感情
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为 hurt；疼痛部位可作主语。

senses.en: Information explaining what to do or how to do something
An order telling someone what they must do
The activity of teaching someone a skill or subject

ex.en: Office hours began with practical instruction.
ex.zh: 答疑从实践指导开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of practical instruction.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得实践指导这个例子。

tip: 操作说明常用复数instructions；表示教学时不可数。

senses.en: to copy data from the internet onto your device
the act of downloading, or a file obtained this way

ex.en: I heard the lecturer download a file during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时下载文件。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to download a file.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来下载文件。

tip: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；反义词是upload。

senses.en: the name shared by members of a family

ex.en: Office hours began with family surname.
ex.zh: 答疑从家族姓氏开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of family surname.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得家族姓氏这个例子。

tip: surname指姓，given name指名；姓不一定在最后。

senses.en: the ability to store and recall information or experiences
something from the past that you remember
the part of a computer that stores information

ex.en: The textbook introduces short-term memory in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了短期记忆。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss short-term memory.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论短期记忆的材料。

tip: 记忆力通常不可数；一段段回忆用memories。

senses.en: A set of instructions that tells a computer what to do.
Write computer instructions or set a machine to operate automatically.
An organised plan, course of activities, or broadcast show.

ex.en: Office hours began with computer program.
ex.zh: 答疑从计算机程序开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of computer program.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得计算机程序这个例子。

col: program a computer｜给计算机编程
tip: 英式计算机程序用program；计划、节目用programme。

senses.en: For each unit of something.

ex.en: The professor explained per with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了每。

ex.en: Students who can explain per usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释每的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

tip: per后通常接单数名词，不加冠词，如per day。

senses.en: the science of substances and how they react
the chemical properties and processes of a substance
a natural connection or attraction between people

ex.en: I copied organic chemistry into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把有机化学抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used organic chemistry to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用有机化学来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 学科名通常不可数：study chemistry，不加a。

senses.en: The condition of someone's body and mind.
How well an organisation, economy, or system is functioning.

ex.en: The textbook introduces mental health in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了心理健康。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mental health.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论心理健康的材料。

tip: 通常不可数；表示身体健康用in good health。

senses.en: able to move or be moved easily between places
relating to phones or services used while away from home
a telephone you can carry and use almost anywhere

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mobile phone.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论手机。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of mobile phone.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得手机这个例子。

tip: 英式英语常用a mobile指手机；美式常说a cell phone。

senses.en: a choice made after considering different possibilities

ex.en: Our professor circled informed decision on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了基于充分了解的决定。

ex.en: The reading connects informed decision with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把基于充分了解的决定和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: informed decision｜基于充分了解的决定
tip: 作决定用make a decision，不用do。

senses.en: The study of quantities, shapes, patterns, and their relationships.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about applied mathematics.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于应用数学的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects applied mathematics with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把应用数学和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 虽以s结尾，作学科名用单数谓语；英式简称maths。

senses.en: To like or choose something more than another option.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to prefer A to B.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求比起B更喜欢A。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers prefer A to B before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要比起B更喜欢A。

col: prefer A to B｜比起B更喜欢A
tip: 用prefer A to B；过去式preferred双写r。

senses.zh: 无线网络；无线联网技术
senses.en: Technology connecting devices to a network without cables.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on free wifi.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论免费无线网络。

ex.en: A campus survey used free wifi to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用免费无线网络来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: 常规范写作Wi-Fi；通常不可数，不加a。

senses.en: the money needed to buy or do something
to require a particular amount of money
something valuable lost to achieve or obtain something

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about the cost of living.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于生活成本的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the cost of living.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论生活成本的材料。

col: the cost of living｜生活成本
at all costs｜不惜一切代价
tip: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

senses.en: The organ inside your head controlling thought and bodily activity.
The ability to think clearly and understand things.

ex.en: Office hours began with brain function.
ex.zh: 答疑从大脑功能开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around brain function.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大脑功能展开说明。

tip: 表示智力时常用复数brains；器官用brain。

senses.en: to say firmly that you will do something
a firm statement that you will do something
signs that someone or something may succeed

ex.en: I heard the lecturer promise to do something during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时承诺做某事。

ex.en: The reading asks you to promise to do something and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你承诺做某事，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: promise to do something｜承诺做某事
tip: 用promise to do，不用promise doing。

senses.en: An opinion or belief about something.
What you can see from a particular place.
To consider something in a particular way, or look at it.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a sea view.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论海景。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a sea view.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得海景这个例子。

tip: 观点用view on；把某事视为用view…as…。

senses.en: a disease, or the state of being unwell

ex.en: Office hours began with serious illness.
ex.zh: 答疑从重病开始。

ex.en: The author returns to serious illness when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了重病。

col: recover from an illness｜病后康复
tip: 泛指生病时不可数；指具体疾病时可数。

senses.en: Pain felt in the head.
A problem that causes worry or is difficult to manage.

ex.en: Office hours began with a severe headache.
ex.zh: 答疑从剧烈头痛开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a severe headache when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了剧烈头痛。

tip: 表示一次头痛用a headache，通常说have a headache。

senses.en: a request for someone to attend or join something

ex.en: The textbook introduces an invitation to dinner in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了晚餐邀请。

ex.en: A campus survey used an invitation to dinner to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用晚餐邀请来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: an invitation to dinner｜晚餐邀请
tip: 参加活动用invitation to；邀请做事用to do。

senses.en: something given for winning a competition or achieving something
to value something very highly

ex.en: I copied first prize into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把一等奖抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of first prize.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得一等奖这个例子。

tip: prize可作动词表珍视，常见be highly prized。

senses.en: a small solid piece of medicine that you swallow
an oral medicine used to prevent pregnancy

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on vitamin pill.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论维生素片。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss vitamin pill.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论维生素片的材料。

tip: take a pill指服药；the pill常特指口服避孕药。

senses.en: not sleeping
to stop sleeping or cause someone to stop sleeping

ex.en: Our professor circled wide awake on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了完全清醒的。

ex.en: A campus survey used wide awake to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用完全清醒的来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 形容词通常作表语；动词变化为awoke、awoken。

senses.en: a sound, especially one that is loud or unwanted

ex.en: I copied background noise into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把背景噪音抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around background noise.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕背景噪音展开说明。

tip: 泛指噪音时不可数；指某个具体声响可用a noise。

senses.en: Relating to women, girls, or animals that typically produce eggs.
An animal or person of the female sex.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on female students.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论女生。

ex.en: A campus survey used female students to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用女生来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 指成年女性通常用women；female作定语较自然。

senses.en: Form a picture or idea of something in your mind.
Think something is probably true without being certain.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to imagine the future.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求设想未来。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to imagine the future.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们设想未来。

tip: imagine后接动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: Stored information on a computer, or an organized collection of papers.
To store documents systematically or submit them to an authority.
A rough metal tool used to smooth or shape surfaces.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about file documents.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于将文件归档的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used file documents to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用将文件归档来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

col: file a complaint｜正式提出投诉
tip: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。

senses.en: an idea offered for someone to consider
a slight sign that something exists or may be true

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a useful suggestion.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论有用的建议。

ex.en: The author returns to a useful suggestion when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有用的建议。

tip: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

senses.en: a woman who performs characters in plays or films

ex.en: Our professor circled leading actress on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了女主角。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of leading actress.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得女主角这个例子。

tip: actor也可指女性；actress明确指女演员。

senses.en: Liked or enjoyed by many people.
Intended for ordinary people rather than specialists.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on increasingly popular.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论越来越受欢迎。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around increasingly popular.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕越来越受欢迎展开说明。

tip: 表示受某群体欢迎，常用popular with或among。

senses.en: to act in a particular way
to act politely and do what is expected
to work or react in a particular way

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to behave responsibly.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何负责任地行事。

ex.en: The passage says students who can behave responsibly follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够负责任地行事的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: behave yourself意为守规矩，不是“表现自己”。

senses.en: to make something new or bring something into existence
to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop

ex.en: The assignment is to create opportunities, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先创造机会，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to create opportunities.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来创造机会。

col: create a work of art｜创作艺术作品
tip: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

senses.en: A group of people working together for a particular purpose.
The planning and arrangement of activities, people, or things.

ex.en: Office hours began with charitable organisation.
ex.zh: 答疑从慈善组织开始。

ex.en: The author returns to charitable organisation when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了慈善组织。

col: require careful organisation｜需要周密安排
tip: 英式常写organisation，美式通常写organization。

senses.en: belonging to a period thousands of years in the past
having existed for a very long time

ex.en: Our professor circled ancient history on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了古代史。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of ancient history.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得古代史这个例子。

tip: ancient强调年代久远，不宜代替一般的old。

senses.en: A photograph you take of yourself, usually with a phone.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on selfie stick.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论自拍杆。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss selfie stick.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论自拍杆的材料。

tip: 拍自拍照用take a selfie，不用make a selfie。

senses.en: an organised set of activities with a particular purpose
a show broadcast on television or radio
to arrange activities or set a machine to operate automatically

ex.en: The textbook introduces training programme in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了培训项目。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of training programme.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得培训项目这个例子。

col: launch a programme｜启动一项计划
tip: 英式通常用programme，计算机程序用program；美式均用program。

senses.en: a person who gives a talk or addresses others
a person who speaks a particular language
a device that produces sound from electrical signals

ex.en: Office hours began with guest speaker.
ex.zh: 答疑从特邀演讲者开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around guest speaker.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕特邀演讲者展开说明。

tip: a native speaker of English指英语母语者。

senses.en: A daughter of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about young niece.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于年幼的侄女或外甥女的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around young niece.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕年幼的侄女或外甥女展开说明。

col: young niece｜年幼的侄女或外甥女
nieces and nephews｜侄子侄女及外甥外甥女
tip: niece指女性晚辈，nephew指男性晚辈。

senses.en: a live musical performance given before an audience

ex.en: I copied concert hall into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把音乐厅抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of concert hall.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得音乐厅这个例子。

tip: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

senses.en: Becoming a member of a group or taking part.
Connecting two or more things together.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to joining a club.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求加入俱乐部。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to joining a club.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得加入俱乐部。

col: joining two pieces together｜把两块连接起来
tip: 是join的-ing形式；加入组织直接接宾语，不加in。

senses.en: Words or actions used when meeting or welcoming someone.
Friendly wishes expressed on a special occasion.

ex.en: Our professor circled a warm greeting on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了热情的问候。

ex.en: The author returns to a warm greeting when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了热情的问候。

tip: 表示节日祝福常用复数greetings，如birthday greetings。

senses.en: costing half the usual price
at half the usual price

ex.en: After the lecture, we used half-price in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了半价的。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses half-price when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了半价的。

col: buy something half-price｜以半价购买某物
tip: 名词前常写half-price；at half price不加连字符。

senses.en: A spoken or written account giving information about something
To give information about an event or situation
To arrive somewhere and tell the person in charge

ex.en: I copied a news report into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把新闻报道抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a news report.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕新闻报道展开说明。

tip: report on后接报道主题；report for duty指报到上班。

senses.en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions.
