ex.en: The quiz had a short question about mutual understanding.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于相互理解的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mutual understanding.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论相互理解的材料。

col: a clear understanding of｜对……的清楚理解
an understanding friend｜善解人意的朋友
tip: 表示“对……的理解”用understanding of。

senses.en: Something you can choose from a range of possibilities.
The right or opportunity to choose whether to do something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces the best option in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最佳选择。

ex.en: A campus survey used the best option to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用最佳选择来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: have no option but to｜别无选择只能
keep your options open｜保留选择余地
the option to buy｜购买的选择权
tip: option指可选方案；have no option but to后接动词原形。

senses.en: A marked face or rotating control on an instrument
Enter a telephone number to make a call

ex.en: The textbook introduces a clock dial in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了钟面。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a clock dial.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕钟面展开说明。

tip: 过去式英式常用dialled，美式常用dialed。

senses.en: extremely good or impressive

ex.en: Our professor circled a marvelous opportunity on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了绝佳的机会。

ex.en: The reading connects a marvelous opportunity with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把绝佳的机会和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: marvelous为美式拼写；英式通常写marvellous。

senses.en: Something that must be done, possessed, or provided
Something needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: The textbook introduces a legal requirement in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了法律规定的要求。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a legal requirement.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕法律规定的要求展开说明。

col: a legal requirement｜法律规定的要求
tip: 满足要求用meet requirements，不用reach。

senses.en: to have enough money or resources for something
to provide something useful or desirable

ex.en: I heard the lecturer afford protection during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时提供保护。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to afford protection.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们提供保护。

col: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事
cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去
tip: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

senses.en: Feeling as if you or your surroundings are spinning.

ex.en: I copied a dizzy spell into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把一阵眩晕抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a dizzy spell with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把一阵眩晕和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 人作主语用feel dizzy；事物可make人dizzy。

senses.en: Dishonest behaviour intended to gain an unfair advantage.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on prevent cheating.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论防止作弊。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss prevent cheating.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论防止作弊的材料。

col: accuse someone of cheating｜指责某人作弊
tip: cheating作行为名词通常不可数；cheat也可指作弊者。

senses.en: Mental strain caused by difficult situations or too many demands
To give particular importance to something when speaking or writing
Extra force used when pronouncing a syllable or word

ex.en: Office hours began with reduce stress.
ex.zh: 答疑从减轻压力开始。

ex.en: The author returns to reduce stress when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了减轻压力。

col: stress the importance of｜强调…的重要性
tip: 人感到压力用stressed；事情令人紧张用stressful。

senses.en: Not present where someone is expected to be.
Not existing or found in a particular place or situation.

ex.en: Office hours began with conspicuously absent.
ex.zh: 答疑从明显缺席的开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of conspicuously absent.
ex.zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得明显缺席的这个例子。

tip: 表示缺席某场合用absent from，不用absent in。

senses.en: a person who writes poems

ex.en: Our professor circled a celebrated poet on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了著名诗人。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a celebrated poet.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕著名诗人展开说明。

tip: poet指诗人，poem指一首诗，poetry统称诗歌。

senses.en: The study of how societies produce, distribute, and use resources.
The financial factors affecting whether an activity is practical.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about behavioural economics.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于行为经济学的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to behavioural economics when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了行为经济学。

col: the economics of recycling｜回收利用的经济可行性
tip: 指学科时虽以s结尾，仍接单数谓语。

senses.en: very pleased about something

ex.en: The textbook introduces absolutely delighted in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了欣喜万分。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss absolutely delighted.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论欣喜万分的材料。

col: delighted with the result｜对结果非常满意
delighted to hear｜听到后很高兴
tip: 人感到高兴用delighted；事物令人愉快用delightful。

senses.en: A device that captures sound for recording or making it louder.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a wireless microphone.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于无线麦克风的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a wireless microphone.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得无线麦克风这个例子。

col: speak into a microphone｜对着麦克风讲话
tip: microphone收音；speaker播放声音，勿混淆。

senses.en: a musical instrument played by hitting its stretched surface
a large cylindrical container for storing liquids or other materials
to play a drum or tap something repeatedly

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an oil drum.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论油桶。

ex.en: A campus survey used an oil drum to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用油桶来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

tip: play the drums常指打鼓；drum也可指大圆桶。

senses.en: A performer who entertains people by doing seemingly impossible tricks.
A person believed or imagined to have magical powers.

ex.en: I copied performing magician into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把表演魔术师抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around performing magician.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕表演魔术师展开说明。

col: skilled magician｜技艺娴熟的魔术师
tip: 现实中指魔术表演者；故事中也可指魔法师。

senses.en: Relating to skilled work or an activity done for payment.
Showing the skill and behaviour expected of a trained worker.
Someone trained for skilled work or paid to perform.

ex.en: Our professor circled healthcare professional on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了医疗专业人员。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕医疗专业人员展开说明。

tip: 与amateur对比强调职业；形容态度时强调专业得体。

senses.en: very important, large, or serious
a main university subject, or a student studying that subject
to study a particular subject as your main university subject

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on major problem.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论重大问题。

ex.en: The author returns to major problem when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了重大问题。

tip: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: mathematics involving addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division

ex.en: I copied mental arithmetic into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把心算抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of mental arithmetic.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得心算这个例子。

tip: 作名词通常不可数；范围比mathematics窄。

senses.en: the production of goods in factories
businesses that provide a particular type of product or service
steady effort and hard work

ex.en: I copied heavy industry into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把重工业抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to heavy industry when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了重工业。

tip: 工业用industrial；勤奋的用industrious。

senses.en: A situation that makes it possible to do something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces an opportunity to learn in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了学习的机会。

ex.en: A campus survey used an opportunity to learn to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用学习的机会来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: an opportunity to learn｜学习的机会
tip: 常用an opportunity to do，表示做某事的机会。

senses.en: Communication with someone, or physical touching between things.
To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or another method.
Someone you know who can offer help or information.

ex.en: I copied direct contact into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把直接接触抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used direct contact to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用直接接触来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: keep in contact with｜与……保持联系
tip: 动词contact直接接人，不加with；名词后可加with。

senses.en: To stop something happening or someone doing something.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to prevent accidents.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须预防事故。

ex.en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to prevent accidents.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们预防事故。

col: prevent someone from doing｜阻止某人做某事
tip: 用prevent sb from doing，不用prevent sb to do。

senses.en: very angry
behaving or thinking in an unreasonable or foolish way
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something

ex.en: The textbook introduces mad about football in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了痴迷足球。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around mad about football.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕痴迷足球展开说明。

tip: mad at表示生气；mad about可表示痴迷。

senses.en: A place where people are kept as punishment or awaiting trial.
Put someone in jail.

ex.en: I copied a jail sentence into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把监禁刑期抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a jail sentence when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了监禁刑期。

col: be jailed for fraud｜因诈骗被监禁
tip: in jail指在押，不加冠词；英式旧拼法为gaol。

senses.en: something that makes success harder or reduces something's value

ex.en: Office hours began with a major disadvantage.
ex.zh: 答疑从重大弊端开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a major disadvantage.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得重大弊端这个例子。

col: at a disadvantage｜处于不利地位
tip: 表示处于不利地位用at a disadvantage。

senses.en: easy to recognise because you have encountered it before
having knowledge or experience of something

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on familiar with.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论熟悉……。

ex.en: The author returns to familiar with when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了熟悉……。

tip: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

senses.en: Extremely good and very enjoyable.
Causing great surprise or admiration.

ex.en: Office hours began with a marvellous idea.
ex.zh: 答疑从绝妙的主意开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a marvellous idea.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕绝妙的主意展开说明。

col: a marvellous achievement｜了不起的成就
tip: 英式拼写为marvellous，美式通常为marvelous。

senses.en: Force air suddenly from your throat with a rough sound.
The act or sound of coughing, or an illness causing it.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to cough medicine.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须止咳药。

ex.en: The passage says students who can cough medicine follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够止咳药的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: gh在此发/f/；have a cough表示有咳嗽症状。

senses.en: In a similar way; also true of another person or thing

ex.en: Similarly, one campus is not enough to settle the question.
ex.zh: 相似地，只有一所学校并不足以回答这个问题。

ex.en: Similarly, the lecture treats the two trends as related rather than identical.
ex.zh: 相似地，讲座把这两种趋势视为相关，而不是同一回事。

tip: 句首Similarly常接逗号，用于引出相似情况。

senses.en: who a person is
qualities and beliefs distinguishing a person or group

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about proof of identity.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于身份证明的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects proof of identity with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把身份证明和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: identity指身份；identify是识别、确认身份的动词。

senses.en: The way things actually are, rather than imagined or wished.
Something that actually exists or happens.

ex.en: Office hours began with face reality.
ex.zh: 答疑从面对现实开始。

ex.en: The author returns to face reality when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了面对现实。

tip: in reality意为“实际上”；a reality指已实现的事。

senses.en: Someone who teaches at a university or gives educational talks

ex.en: I copied university lecturer into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把大学讲师抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around university lecturer.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大学讲师展开说明。

tip: 某学科的讲师用lecturer in；不等同于教授。

senses.en: How often something happens or how quickly something changes.
An amount charged or paid for a particular unit.
To judge the quality, value, or level of something.

ex.en: Our professor circled unemployment rate on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了失业率。

ex.en: The reading connects unemployment rate with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把失业率和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: rate可指比率或单位费用；评价某物用rate。

senses.en: the habits and activities that shape how someone lives

ex.en: Our professor circled healthy lifestyle on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了健康的生活方式。

ex.en: A campus survey used healthy lifestyle to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用健康的生活方式来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 可数名词：常说lead a healthy lifestyle。

senses.en: a building used for worship in certain religions
the flat area on either side of the forehead

ex.en: Office hours began with an ancient temple.
ex.zh: 答疑从古庙开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an ancient temple.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕古庙展开说明。

tip: 表示太阳穴时，常用复数temples指两侧。

senses.en: Behave towards someone or consider something in a particular way.
Use medicine or other care to help an illness improve.
Something enjoyable that you do not have very often.

ex.en: The assignment is to treat a disease, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先治疗疾病，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to treat a disease.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来治疗疾病。

col: treat someone with respect｜尊重某人
tip: treat someone to a meal表示请某人吃饭。

senses.en: Fine thread produced by silkworms, or fabric made from it.

ex.en: The textbook introduces pure silk in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了真丝。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of pure silk.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得真丝这个例子。

tip: silk通常不可数；silky指柔滑如丝，不一定是丝制。

senses.en: To have earned something because of your actions or qualities.

ex.en: The assignment is to deserve praise, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先值得表扬，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to deserve praise and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你值得表扬，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

senses.en: Relating to the mind and emotional wellbeing.

senses.zh: 脑力的；在头脑中进行的
senses.en: Using thought rather than physical action or written calculation.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about mental health.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于心理健康的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects mental health with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把心理健康和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: mental侧重心理或脑力；口语中形容人疯狂可能冒犯。

senses.en: money paid in advance, held as security, or banked
to put money or material somewhere for keeping or accumulation
material that builds up naturally in a place

ex.en: Our professor circled refundable deposit on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可退还的押金。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of refundable deposit.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得可退还的押金这个例子。

col: pay a deposit｜支付订金或押金
tip: 订金是预付款；押金作担保；银行存款也用deposit。

senses.en: To die, or cause death, by being unable to breathe underwater.
To cover a sound with a much louder sound.

ex.en: The assignment is to drown out a voice, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先盖过说话声，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to drown out a voice.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来盖过说话声。

col: drown out a voice｜盖过说话声
drown in paperwork｜陷入文书工作
tip: drown指溺死，不只是落水；盖过声音常加out。

senses.en: A distinct part of something larger.
A surface or thin piece exposed by cutting through something.
To divide something into parts or cut it into slices.

ex.en: The textbook introduces final section in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最后一部分。

ex.en: A campus survey used final section to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用最后一部分来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: section可指文章章节，也可指商店等场所的区域。

senses.en: someone who catches fish for work or pleasure

ex.en: After the lecture, we used fisherman in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了渔民。

ex.en: Students who can explain fisherman usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释渔民的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

tip: 复数为fishermen；中性表达可用fisher。

senses.en: so special or powerful that you will always remember it

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an unforgettable experience.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于难忘的经历的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an unforgettable experience.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕难忘的经历展开说明。

tip: 形容经历令人难忘；forgetful指人健忘。

senses.en: To promote products, services or events through public messages.
To announce publicly that someone or something is wanted.

ex.en: The professor asked us to advertise a product.
ex.zh: 教授让我们为产品做广告。

ex.en: The passage says students who can advertise a product follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够为产品做广告的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: advertise a product｜为产品做广告
advertise for staff｜登广告招聘员工
tip: advertise产品指宣传；advertise for人指登广告招聘。

senses.en: A strip of material wrapped around an injury for protection.
To wrap an injured body part in a bandage.

ex.en: I wrote bandage on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把bandage和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up bandage while discussing evidence about public health.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了绷带。

tip: 既是名词也是动词；bandage a wound意为包扎伤口。

senses.en: a place or institution where legal cases are heard
an area for playing sports such as tennis or basketball
to seek something desirable or risk something harmful

ex.en: Our professor circled tennis court on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了网球场。

ex.en: The author returns to tennis court when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了网球场。

tip: in court指在法庭上；on court指在球场上。

senses.zh: 令人赞叹的；令人钦佩的
senses.en: Causing admiration because of exceptional quality, size, or skill.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on impressive achievement.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论令人赞叹的成就。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around impressive achievement.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕令人赞叹的成就展开说明。

tip: 事物令人赞叹用impressive；人感到佩服用impressed。

senses.en: Used to express what you hope will happen.
In a way that shows hope.

ex.en: The lab manual says to hopefully soon before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先但愿很快，再记下数字。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior asks the class to hopefully soon before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先但愿很快。

col: look hopefully at｜满怀希望地看着
tip: 句首常表示“但愿”，不表示某事一定会发生。

senses.en: the reason for doing something or what something is intended for
a feeling of having meaningful aims in life

ex.en: I copied main purpose into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把主要目的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to main purpose when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主要目的。

tip: on purpose意为“故意地”，不是“有目的地”。

senses.en: damage to the environment caused by harmful substances or energy

ex.en: Our professor circled air pollution on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了空气污染。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss air pollution.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论空气污染的材料。

tip: pollution不可数；具体污染物用pollutant。

senses.en: A wheeled chair used by someone who has difficulty walking.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on electric wheelchair.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电动轮椅。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss electric wheelchair.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电动轮椅的材料。

tip: 说a wheelchair user，避免用带有束缚意味的表达。

senses.zh: 有组织的运动；宣传活动
senses.en: A series of organised activities aimed at achieving a goal
To organise or take part in activities supporting a cause
A series of military operations with a particular objective

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an advertising campaign.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于广告宣传活动的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an advertising campaign.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论广告宣传活动的材料。

col: an advertising campaign｜广告宣传活动
campaign for reform｜为改革开展运动
campaign against pollution｜开展反污染运动
tip: 动词后接for表示争取，接against表示反对。

senses.en: All space and everything that exists within it
A complete world of experiences, ideas, or imagined events

ex.en: I copied the expanding universe into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把不断膨胀的宇宙抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the expanding universe.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕不断膨胀的宇宙展开说明。

col: the expanding universe｜不断膨胀的宇宙
the origins of the universe｜宇宙的起源
tip: 指宇宙通常用the universe；开头是辅音音素/j/。

senses.en: The family, education, and experience that shape someone's life
Information or events needed to understand a situation
The part of a scene behind the main subject

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a professional background.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论职业背景。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a professional background.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得职业背景这个例子。

col: a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

senses.en: To save someone or something from danger or difficulty.
An act of saving someone or something from danger.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to rescue someone from.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须从……中救出某人。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to rescue someone from.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来从……中救出某人。

col: rescue someone from｜从……中救出某人
come to the rescue｜前来解围
tip: 常用rescue sb from sth，表示从险境中救出某人。

senses.en: A written instruction asking a bank to pay a specified amount.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize cheque/check in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出支票。

ex.en: Students who can explain cheque/check usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释支票的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

col: a bounced check｜被退回的支票
tip: 支票英式拼写为cheque，美式为check，读音相同。
note: 并列英美拼写，并非单一词头。

senses.en: To officially forbid an activity or the use of something
An official rule that forbids something

ex.en: The lab instructions say to ban smoking.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求禁止吸烟。

ex.en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to ban smoking.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们禁止吸烟。

col: a ban on something｜对某事物的禁令
tip: ban doing；ban sb from doing；过去式banned。

senses.en: a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person
a detailed description of a person, place, or situation

ex.en: Office hours began with a family portrait.
ex.zh: 答疑从全家福开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a family portrait with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把全家福和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: portrait以人物为主体；landscape多指风景画或照片。

senses.en: the basic verb form, used with or without to
relating to or using the basic form of a verb

ex.en: Our professor circled a bare infinitive on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不带to的不定式。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a bare infinitive.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得不带to的不定式这个例子。

col: a bare infinitive｜不带to的不定式
tip: 不定式可带to，也可不带；如to go与must go中的go。

senses.en: the act of keeping someone or something safe from harm

ex.en: Office hours began with environmental protection.
ex.zh: 答疑从环境保护开始。

ex.en: The reading connects environmental protection with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把环境保护和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常不可数；protection from/against表示免受伤害。

senses.en: things that belong to a person or organisation
land or buildings that someone owns
a quality of a substance or material

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on private property.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论私人财产。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of private property.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得私人财产这个例子。

tip: 财产义不可数；房产和性质义可数。

senses.en: An explanation or meeting that first presents someone or something.
The act of bringing something into use or a place.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a brief introduction.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于简短介绍的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to a brief introduction when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了简短介绍。

col: an introduction to｜对……的介绍；……入门
tip: 入门介绍常用introduction to；引进某物用of。

senses.en: Sadness and concern for someone who is suffering.
Something disappointing or unfortunate.
To feel sorry for someone because of their difficulties.

ex.en: I copied a sense of pity into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把怜悯之情抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a sense of pity when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了怜悯之情。

col: a sense of pity｜怜悯之情
tip: 表同情通常不可数；表遗憾常用a pity。

senses.en: Showing good judgement and practical understanding.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a sensible decision.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于明智的决定的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a sensible decision.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得明智的决定这个例子。

tip: sensible指明智的；sensitive指敏感的。

senses.en: To make someone unable to understand or think clearly.
To wrongly think one person or thing is another.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer confuse A with B during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时把A与B混淆。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to confuse A with B.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得把A与B混淆。

col: confuse A with B｜把A与B混淆
confuse the issue｜把问题弄复杂
tip: confused形容人感到困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: Wanting to learn or know more about something.
Unusual or strange in a way that attracts attention.

ex.en: The textbook introduces curious about in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了对……好奇。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of curious about.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得对……好奇这个例子。

col: a curious mixture｜奇特的混合物
tip: be curious about表示“对……好奇”。

senses.en: someone you love, especially a romantic partner
a very kind and helpful person

ex.en: I copied childhood sweetheart into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把青梅竹马的恋人抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around childhood sweetheart.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕青梅竹马的恋人展开说明。

tip: 可指恋人，也可作亲昵称呼；不宜随意称呼陌生人。

senses.en: A word or expression with a particular meaning.
One of the periods into which a school year is divided.
A fixed period during which something lasts or someone serves.

ex.en: I copied technical term into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把专业术语抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of technical term.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得专业术语这个例子。

col: in the long term｜从长远来看
tip: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。

senses.en: money earned for work, often calculated by the hour or week
to carry on a war or organised campaign

ex.en: Office hours began with minimum wage.
ex.zh: 答疑从最低工资开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss minimum wage.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论最低工资的材料。

tip: wage常按小时或周计算；salary通常指固定薪金。

senses.en: to make someone feel frightened
a sudden feeling or period of fear

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to scare someone away.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须把某人吓跑。

ex.en: The passage says students who can scare someone away follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够把某人吓跑的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: give someone a scare｜吓某人一跳
tip: scared形容人感到害怕；scary形容事物吓人。

senses.en: To make someone unhappy by failing to meet their expectations.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer disappoint customers during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时让顾客失望。

ex.en: The passage says students who can disappoint customers follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够让顾客失望的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 人感到失望用disappointed；事物令人失望用disappointing。

senses.en: slightly angry about something unpleasant or inconvenient

ex.en: Our professor circled visibly annoyed on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了明显感到恼火。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around visibly annoyed.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕明显感到恼火展开说明。

tip: annoyed形容人的感受；annoying形容令人恼火的事物。

senses.en: Becoming more economically advanced, often with improving living standards.
Growing or becoming more complete over time.

ex.en: I copied developing countries into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把发展中国家抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects developing countries with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把发展中国家和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a developing situation｜不断演变的局势
tip: developing指发展中的；developed指已发展的、发达的。

senses.en: someone who has successfully completed a university degree
to successfully complete a course at a school or university

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on university graduate.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论大学毕业生。

ex.en: The reading connects university graduate with a larger point about student life.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把大学毕业生和关于校园生活的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: graduate with honours｜以优等成绩毕业
tip: 名词尾音/ət/，动词/eɪt/；毕业于用graduate from。

senses.en: The activity or business of promoting products and services.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about misleading advertising.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于误导性广告的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used misleading advertising to explain a pattern in public communication.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用误导性广告来解释公共传播中的一种模式。

tip: 通常不可数；一则具体广告用an advertisement。

senses.en: A large room where several people sleep.
A building where students live, especially at American colleges.

ex.en: Our professor circled shared dormitory on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了集体寝室。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of shared dormitory.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得集体寝室这个例子。

tip: 美式常指学生宿舍楼；英式也常指多人寝室。

senses.en: a connection between people, things, or ideas
a person who belongs to your family

ex.en: Our professor circled a close relation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了近亲。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a close relation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕近亲展开说明。

col: relations between countries｜国家间的关系
tip: 国家或群体间的关系常用复数relations。

senses.en: a person or business that sells something

ex.en: Our professor circled online seller on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了网络卖家。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of online seller.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得网络卖家这个例子。

tip: seller侧重交易中的卖方，不一定是店内售货员。

senses.en: Not worried or excited; without strong movement or disturbance.
To become less upset, or make someone feel more relaxed.
A peaceful state without worry, noise, or disturbance.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a sense of calm in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了宁静感。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sense of calm.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕宁静感展开说明。

tip: calm中的l不发音；calm down表示平静下来。

senses.en: very unhappy, sometimes persistently as part of a mental illness
having little economic activity or few opportunities

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about severely depressed.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于严重抑郁的的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to severely depressed when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了严重抑郁的。

col: economically depressed area｜经济萧条地区
tip: depressed形容人的感受；depressing形容令人沮丧的事。

senses.en: an object played to produce musical sounds
a tool or device for precise scientific or medical work
something used to achieve a particular purpose

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about musical instrument.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于乐器的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of musical instrument.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得乐器这个例子。

col: instrument of change｜推动变革的工具
tip: 乐器和精密仪器均可用instrument；普通工具常用tool。

senses.en: A man who is engaged to be married.

ex.en: The textbook introduces her fiance in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了她的未婚夫。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around her fiance.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕她的未婚夫展开说明。

col: my fiance and I｜我和我的未婚夫
tip: 也写作fiancé；未婚妻是fiancee或fiancée。

senses.en: An expression or action showing strong disagreement or opposition.
Express strong disagreement with something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on peaceful protest.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论和平抗议。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around peaceful protest.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕和平抗议展开说明。

tip: 所列为名词音；动词英音/prəˈtest/，常接against。

senses.en: A person kept in prison or prevented from leaving.
A person captured and held by an enemy during war.

ex.en: I copied prisoner of war into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把战俘抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around prisoner of war.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕战俘展开说明。

tip: prisoner 不一定已被定罪，也可指被俘或被拘禁者。

senses.en: a person trained to travel and work in space

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about astronaut training.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于宇航员训练的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used astronaut training to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用宇航员训练来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: a team of astronauts｜一队宇航员
tip: astronaut是宇航员；astronomer是天文学家。

senses.en: To tell someone you are sorry for doing something wrong

ex.en: The professor asked us to apologize sincerely.
ex.zh: 教授让我们真诚道歉。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to apologize sincerely.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们真诚道歉。

col: apologize for doing something｜为做某事道歉
tip: 向人道歉用to，为事情道歉用for；英式也写apologise。

senses.en: A person from a country other than the one being discussed.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize foreigner in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出外国人。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses foreigner when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了外国人。

col: foreigners living abroad｜在海外生活的外国人
tip: 泛指外国人；特指游客时用visitor更自然。

senses.en: Having formally agreed to marry someone.
Actively involved in an activity or task.
Currently being used and therefore unavailable.

ex.en: The textbook introduces the line is engaged in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了电话占线。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of the line is engaged.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得电话占线这个例子。

col: the line is engaged｜电话占线
tip: 订婚对象前用to；参与的活动前用in。

senses.en: someone who behaves without good sense or judgment
to make someone believe something that is not true

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fool around.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论胡闹。

ex.en: The reading connects fool around with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把胡闹和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: fool someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事
make a fool of yourself｜出洋相
tip: fool作名词称呼别人有贬义；动词可接into doing。

senses.en: Time when you are not working or attending school.

ex.en: I wrote time off on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把time off和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: Students who can explain time off usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释休假的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

col: time off work｜不上班的时间
tip: 通常不可数；请一天假可说 take a day off。

senses.en: connected with love or expressing loving feelings
seeing things as more beautiful or exciting than they really are
someone strongly influenced by love, imagination, or idealistic hopes

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about romantic relationship.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于恋爱关系的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of romantic relationship.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得恋爱关系这个例子。

col: a romantic view of｜对……的理想化看法
tip: 除爱情义外，也可指把现实想得过于美好。

senses.en: An increase in size, amount, or level.
The process of growing physically or developing over time.
An unusual lump of tissue growing in or on the body.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about economic growth.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于经济增长的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects economic growth with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把经济增长和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示增长通常不可数；a growth可指一个肿块。

senses.en: a story, especially one involving imaginary or exciting events
an account of something that happened to someone

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a fairy tale.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于童话的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a fairy tale.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕童话展开说明。

tip: tale指故事；tail指尾巴，两者同音。

senses.en: happening or existing before the time or thing being discussed

ex.en: The textbook introduces previous experience in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了以往经验。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around previous experience.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕以往经验展开说明。

tip: previous是形容词；表示“以前”用副词previously。

senses.en: A person who does not eat meat or fish.
Containing no meat or fish, or following this diet.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about vegetarian diet.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于素食饮食的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to vegetarian diet when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了素食饮食。

tip: vegetarian不吃肉和鱼；vegan还不吃蛋奶等动物产品。

senses.en: A small booklet giving information about products, services, or places.

ex.en: I copied travel brochure into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把旅游宣传册抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of travel brochure.
ex.zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得旅游宣传册这个例子。

tip: 可数名词，常指介绍旅游、课程或产品的小册子。

senses.en: A sound, movement, or light that communicates a message.
An electrical or radio wave carrying information.
Communicate through an action, or indicate that something is happening.

ex.en: Office hours began with a weak signal.
ex.zh: 答疑从微弱的信号开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used a weak signal to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用微弱的信号来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: 过去式英式常写signalled，美式常写signaled。

senses.en: a formal test of knowledge or ability
the act of looking at something carefully to assess it

ex.en: The textbook introduces a medical examination in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了体检。

ex.en: A campus survey used a medical examination to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用体检来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 考试义口语常简称exam；检查义常接of。

senses.en: having a duty to manage or look after something
being the cause of something, especially something bad
sensible and trustworthy in your actions and decisions

ex.en: I copied responsible for into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把对……负责抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of responsible for.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得对……负责这个例子。

col: hold someone responsible｜认定某人应担责
tip: responsible for后接名词或动名词；to后接上级。

senses.en: using circuits to control electrical signals
stored, sent, or accessed using computers

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on electronic devices.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电子设备。

ex.en: A campus survey used electronic devices to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用电子设备来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: electronic强调电子电路；electric泛指用电的。

senses.en: Close to a particular amount, but not exactly.

ex.en: The professor told us to approximately equal and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们大致相等，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences asks the class to approximately equal before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先大致相等。

tip: 多放在数量前，语气比about更正式。

senses.en: a powerful tropical storm with extremely strong winds

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on powerful hurricane.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论强烈的飓风。

ex.en: A campus survey used powerful hurricane to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用强烈的飓风来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

tip: hurricane和typhoon均属热带气旋，名称因海域而异。

senses.en: to tell a story or describe events again

ex.en: I heard the lecturer retell a story during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时复述故事。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to retell a story.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来复述故事。

col: retell in your own words｜用自己的话复述
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为retold。

senses.en: A device that makes recorded or transmitted sound audible

ex.en: Office hours began with portable loudspeaker.
ex.zh: 答疑从便携式扬声器开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of portable loudspeaker.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得便携式扬声器这个例子。

tip: loudspeaker指设备；speaker还可指说话者。

senses.en: material made of crossing threads with spaces between them
remaining after costs, taxes, or other amounts have been deducted
to earn as profit or successfully obtain something

ex.en: The textbook introduces fishing net in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了渔网。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fishing net.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕渔网展开说明。

tip: net指扣除成本或税款后的净额；gross指扣除前的总额。

senses.en: The state of being alike, or a shared feature

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on striking similarity.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论惊人的相似。

ex.en: A campus survey used striking similarity to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用惊人的相似来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 相似性常不可数；具体相似点可数，常用复数。

senses.en: an object used for fighting or causing physical harm

ex.en: Our professor circled nuclear weapon on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了核武器。

ex.en: A campus survey used nuclear weapon to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用核武器来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 可数名词；武器的总称也可用weaponry。

senses.en: used to introduce your own opinion or preference
by a particular person rather than someone acting for them
as relating to someone's character rather than their actions

ex.en: The lab manual says to personally speaking before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先就个人而言，再记下数字。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will personally speaking when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会就个人而言。

col: take something personally｜认为某事针对自己
know someone personally｜与某人本人相识
tip: take it personally指把事情看作针对自己。

senses.en: the passage inside the neck through which air and food pass

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a sore throat.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论喉咙痛。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sore throat.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕喉咙痛展开说明。

tip: 喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

senses.en: to have enough courage to do something
to challenge someone to do something requiring courage
a challenge to do something difficult or frightening

ex.en: The professor asked us to dare to ask.
ex.zh: 教授让我们敢于提问。

ex.en: The passage says students who can dare to ask follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够敢于提问的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: dare someone to do something｜激某人做某事
for a dare｜为了应对激将
tip: 敢做用dare to do；激将用dare sb to do。

senses.en: believing in your own ability to succeed
certain that something is true or will happen

ex.en: I wrote confident on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把confident和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: A reading on human behavior uses confident when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于人类行为的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了自信的。

col: confident about the future｜对未来有信心
tip: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

senses.en: a mark showing achievement, or a level of quality
a school year level, especially in the American system
to assess work or sort things by quality

ex.en: I copied grade assignments into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把给作业评分抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss grade assignments.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论给作业评分的材料。

col: get a good grade｜取得好成绩
tip: 表示年级时多用于美式英语；英式英语常用year。

senses.en: one part of a television or radio series
a particular event or period within a longer story
a period when someone experiences a particular illness or symptom

ex.en: Office hours began with the final episode.
ex.zh: 答疑从最后一集开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the final episode.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕最后一集展开说明。

col: a brief episode｜一段短暂经历
tip: episode指一集；series指整部系列或连续剧。

senses.en: Someone in a romantic or sexual relationship with another person.
Someone who enjoys or admires something very much.

ex.en: Office hours began with a music lover.
ex.zh: 答疑从音乐爱好者开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a music lover.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论音乐爱好者的材料。

tip: 表爱好者常用名词＋lover；单用可能指情人。

senses.en: the joint where your arm bends
to push someone or something with your elbow

ex.en: Our professor circled bend your elbow on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了弯曲手肘。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of bend your elbow.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得弯曲手肘这个例子。

col: rest your elbows on｜将双肘搁在……上
elbow your way through｜用肘推挤着穿过
tip: elbow作动词时常指用肘推挤着前进。

senses.en: Materials used for writing, such as paper, pens, and envelopes.

ex.en: Office hours began with office stationery.
ex.zh: 答疑从办公文具开始。

ex.en: The reading connects office stationery with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把办公文具和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 不可数；勿与stationary（静止的）混淆。

senses.en: Worry or demands that make someone feel forced to act
Force pressing on a surface or within a substance
Try to make someone do something through strong persuasion

ex.en: I copied blood pressure into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把血压抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss blood pressure.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论血压的材料。

col: pressure someone into doing something｜迫使某人做某事
tip: under pressure表示承压；动词常接into doing。

senses.en: Physical exercises done to stay healthy and fit.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize keep-fit in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出健身操。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up keep-fit while discussing evidence about public health.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了健身操。

tip: 主要用于英式英语；动词短语keep fit不加连字符。

senses.en: red, painful skin caused by too much exposure to sunlight

ex.en: Office hours began with severe sunburn.
ex.zh: 答疑从严重晒伤开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss severe sunburn.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论严重晒伤的材料。

tip: 英式常说get sunburn；美式也常说get a sunburn。

senses.en: Putting medicine into the body using a needle.
The addition of money or resources to improve something.

ex.en: I copied a cash injection into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把一笔现金注入抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a cash injection when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一笔现金注入。

col: a cash injection｜一笔现金注入
an injection of funding｜资金的注入
tip: 注入资金可说an injection of cash，属于比喻用法。

senses.en: someone who entertains an audience by acting, singing, or playing

senses.zh: 表现出某种水平的人或事物
senses.en: a person or thing achieving a particular level of success

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a street performer.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论街头艺人。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a street performer.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论街头艺人的材料。

tip: 不仅指演员；top performer也可指业绩优异的员工。

senses.en: Identify someone or something known or seen before.
Accept or understand that something is true or important.
Officially accept someone's status, qualifications, or achievements.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to recognize a face.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何认出一张脸。

ex.en: The reading asks you to recognize a face and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你认出一张脸，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: recognize the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: 英式也常拼作recognise；表示“认出”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: a strong feeling of surprise caused by something unexpected
to make someone feel very surprised or upset
a dangerous medical collapse, or an electrical jolt through the body

ex.en: I copied culture shock into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把文化冲击抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used culture shock to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用文化冲击来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: come as a shock｜令人震惊
in a state of shock｜处于震惊状态
tip: 人感到震惊用shocked；事物令人震惊用shocking。

senses.en: a physical or mental change that suggests an illness
a sign that an underlying problem exists

ex.en: Office hours began with common symptom.
ex.zh: 答疑从常见症状开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used common symptom to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用常见症状来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 常用a symptom of；症状缓解用relieve symptoms。

senses.en: To express words or writing in another language
To change something into a different form or practical result

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to translate into English.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须翻译成英语。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to translate into English.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来翻译成英语。

col: translate ideas into action｜将想法付诸行动
tip: 从某语言译成另一语言：translate from…into…。

senses.en: physical or mental energy used to achieve something
an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a joint effort.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论共同努力。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a joint effort.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得共同努力这个例子。

tip: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

senses.en: A device that stores energy and supplies electricity.
A large set of similar things, especially tests or questions.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a rechargeable battery.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于可充电电池的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects a rechargeable battery with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可充电电池和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a battery of tests｜一系列测试
tip: 复数为batteries；a battery of可指一系列测试。

senses.en: Things produced for sale or transported for trade.
Movable possessions belonging to a person.

ex.en: Our professor circled consumer goods on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了消费品。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss consumer goods.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论消费品的材料。

tip: goods是复数名词；一件商品可说an item。

senses.en: To send a document or application for consideration
To accept another person's authority or control

ex.en: The assignment is to submit an application, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先提交申请，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to submit an application.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们提交申请。

tip: 过去式 submitted；submit sth to sb 表示向某人提交。

senses.en: Having reached a particular age.
Very old, especially when describing people.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about children aged five.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于五岁的儿童的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects children aged five with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把五岁的儿童和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: aged eighteen and over｜年满十八岁的
tip: 表岁数读/eɪdʒd/；表年迈读/ˈeɪdʒɪd/。

senses.en: happening, existing, or being used now
a continuous movement of water, air, or electricity

ex.en: I copied a strong current into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把强劲水流抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a strong current to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用强劲水流来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 形容词指当前的；名词可指水流或电流。

senses.en: Very surprised and upset by something unexpected.
Feeling strong disapproval at something offensive or wrong.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about deeply shocked.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于深感震惊的的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of deeply shocked.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得深感震惊的这个例子。

col: shocked by the news｜被消息震惊
tip: shocked形容人的感受；shocking形容令人震惊的事物。

senses.en: extremely tired and lacking energy
completely used up, with nothing remaining

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on physically exhausted.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论身体疲惫不堪。

ex.en: The reading connects physically exhausted with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把身体疲惫不堪和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 人感到累用exhausted；事情令人累用exhausting。

senses.en: The pleasure you get from doing or experiencing something

ex.en: Our professor circled pure enjoyment on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了纯粹的享受。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of pure enjoyment.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得纯粹的享受这个例子。

col: get enjoyment from｜从……中获得乐趣
tip: 通常不可数；表示从某事获得乐趣可用get enjoyment from。

senses.en: Confidence that something is true or someone is capable.
An idea accepted as true, especially about life or religion.

ex.en: Office hours began with a widely held belief.
ex.zh: 答疑从普遍持有的看法开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a widely held belief.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论普遍持有的看法的材料。

col: belief in someone｜对某人的信任
a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法
contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

senses.en: To burst violently, or cause something to burst violently.
To increase extremely quickly in size, amount, or popularity.
To express strong feelings suddenly and forcefully.

ex.en: The professor asked us to explode into flames.
ex.zh: 教授让我们突然起火。

ex.en: The passage says students who can explode into flames follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够突然起火的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 爆炸物作主语常用主动形式，不必用被动。

senses.en: people living in the same area
people sharing interests, beliefs, or a particular background

ex.en: Office hours began with local community.
ex.zh: 答疑从当地社区开始。

ex.en: The reading connects local community with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把当地社区和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 既指同地区居民，也指有共同背景或兴趣的群体。

senses.en: Something that you plan or mean to do.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used intention in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了意图。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up intention while discussing evidence about academic research.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了意图。

col: with the intention of｜抱着…的目的
announce an intention to｜宣布做…的打算
tip: 用intention to do或intention of doing。

senses.en: requiring rules to be obeyed and standards to be met
following an exact meaning or limit without exceptions

ex.en: Our professor circled strict rules on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了严格的规定。

ex.en: A campus survey used strict rules to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用严格的规定来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: strict about punctuality｜严格要求守时
in the strict sense｜严格意义上
tip: 对人严格用with；对事情要求严格用about。

senses.en: Making someone feel afraid.

ex.en: Our professor circled frightening experience on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可怕的经历。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of frightening experience.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得可怕的经历这个例子。

tip: frightening指事物吓人；frightened指人感到害怕。

senses.en: To make, grow, or create something.
To cause a result or effect.
Food grown on farms, especially fruit and vegetables.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to produce electricity.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求发电。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers produce electricity before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要发电。

tip: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；农产品义不可数。

senses.en: Relating to trade, industry, money, or the study of these.

ex.en: The textbook introduces economic growth in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济增长。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around economic growth.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕经济增长展开说明。

tip: economic指经济方面的；economical指节约的。

senses.en: material burned or used to produce heat or power
to supply something with fuel
to make a feeling or situation stronger

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fuel consumption.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论燃料消耗。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fuel consumption.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕燃料消耗展开说明。

tip: fuel作动词还可表示助长情绪或推动变化。

senses.en: relating to money or how it is managed

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial support.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济支持。

ex.en: The author returns to financial support when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经济支持。

col: financial stability｜金融稳定；财务稳定
tip: financial侧重金钱与财务；economic侧重经济整体。

senses.en: considering only the main facts or most important features

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to basically the same.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习基本相同。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to basically the same before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先基本相同。

tip: 用于概括核心情况；不等于“几乎不”的barely。

senses.en: made from waste materials processed for use again

ex.en: I copied recycled paper into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把再生纸抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to recycled paper when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了再生纸。

tip: recycled 指已回收再制；recyclable 指可回收。

senses.en: Information that helps you solve a problem or understand something.

ex.en: Office hours began with a clue to.
ex.zh: 答疑从关于…的线索开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a clue to.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕关于…的线索展开说明。

col: not have a clue｜完全不知道
tip: a clue to中的to是介词，后接名词等。

senses.en: what is real or actually happened
a fact or principle generally accepted as true

ex.en: I wrote truth on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把truth和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: Students who can explain truth usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
ex.zh: 能解释事实的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。

col: the truth about something｜关于某事的真相
tip: 说实话用tell the truth，通常不能省略the。

senses.en: someone who attacks ships and steals from them
to copy or distribute protected material without permission
someone who illegally copies or distributes protected material

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about pirate ship.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于海盗船的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of pirate ship.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得海盗船这个例子。

tip: pirated强调被非法复制；piracy是对应名词。

senses.en: Clearly decided or known, without uncertainty.
Clearly noticeable or unquestionably present.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a definite answer.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论明确的答复。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a definite answer.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得明确的答复这个例子。

tip: definite是形容词；definitely是副词，意为肯定地。

senses.en: a performer who entertains people by making them laugh

ex.en: The textbook introduces professional comedian in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了职业喜剧演员。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss professional comedian.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论职业喜剧演员的材料。

col: talented comedian｜有才华的喜剧演员
tip: comedian指人，comedy指喜剧或喜剧作品。

senses.en: How well a person, organisation or machine does something.
An occasion when someone entertains an audience by performing.
The act of carrying out a task or duty.

ex.en: The textbook introduces academic performance in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了学业表现。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of academic performance.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得学业表现这个例子。

tip: 表示整体表现通常不可数；一场演出用a performance。

senses.en: a building or shared room where students sleep

ex.en: The textbook introduces college dorm in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了大学宿舍。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss college dorm.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论大学宿舍的材料。

tip: dorm是dormitory的非正式简称，多见于美式英语。

senses.en: a general direction of change or development
to become widely discussed or shared online

ex.en: Our professor circled an upward trend on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了上升趋势。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of an upward trend.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得上升趋势这个例子。

col: a growing trend｜日益明显的趋势
tip: 朝向某种趋势常用a trend towards后接名词。

senses.en: to make someone believe something is true
to persuade someone to do something

ex.en: The lab instructions say to convince someone of something.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求使某人相信某事。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to convince someone of something.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得使某人相信某事。

col: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事
convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

senses.en: To make something smaller or less in amount or degree.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to reduce costs.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求降低成本。

ex.en: When the class discussed environmental policy, the speaker told us to reduce costs.
ex.zh: 全班讨论环境政策时，讲者让我们降低成本。

tip: reduce by接减少量；reduce to接减少后的量。

senses.en: a publication containing articles about a particular subject
a personal record of experiences, thoughts, or events

ex.en: Our professor circled an academic journal on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了学术期刊。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an academic journal.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论学术期刊的材料。

tip: journal常指专业期刊；表示私人记录时近似diary。

senses.en: getting someone to act or believe something by giving reasons

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to persuading someone to act.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须说服某人采取行动。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to persuading someone to act.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们说服某人采取行动。

col: persuading someone to act｜说服某人采取行动
persuading someone of the benefits｜使某人相信其益处
tip: persuade的-ing形式；劝某人做某事用to do。

senses.en: an artwork made by carving, shaping, or assembling materials
the art of creating solid forms from materials

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a bronze sculpture.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论青铜雕塑。

ex.en: The author returns to a bronze sculpture when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了青铜雕塑。

tip: 指艺术门类不可数；指一件作品可数。

senses.en: the desire or need for particular goods or services
a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed
to insist on receiving something or require something essential

ex.en: Our professor circled demand for housing on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了住房需求。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around demand for housing.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕住房需求展开说明。

tip: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

senses.en: relating to formal Western music, such as symphonies and operas
relating to ancient Greece or Rome and their culture
based on established theories rather than newer approaches

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on classical music.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论古典音乐。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss classical music.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论古典音乐的材料。

tip: 古典音乐用classical；经典作品常用classic。

senses.en: A hard black or brown material burned to produce heat.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on burn coal.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论烧煤。

ex.en: The reading connects burn coal with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把烧煤和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: coal指煤，charcoal指木炭；煤通常用作不可数名词。

senses.en: to accept that something is true, often reluctantly
to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution

ex.en: The lab instructions say to admit a mistake.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求承认错误。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to admit a mistake.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来承认错误。

col: admit doing something｜承认做过某事
be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

senses.en: to share information, thoughts, or feelings with others
to make information or feelings known to someone

ex.en: The lab instructions say to communicate with.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求与……交流。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to communicate with.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来与……交流。

tip: 与某人交流用with；向某人传达某事用某事＋to。

senses.en: To make information known publicly or officially.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to announce plans.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求宣布计划。

ex.en: The reading asks you to announce plans and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你宣布计划，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

senses.en: People living together in an organised community.
An organisation for people who share an interest or purpose.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on modern society.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论现代社会。

ex.en: A campus survey used modern society to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用现代社会来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: society as a whole｜整个社会
tip: 泛指社会常不加the；表示协会时是可数名词。

senses.en: a public message promoting a product, service, or opportunity

ex.en: Office hours began with online ad.
ex.zh: 答疑从网络广告开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used online ad to explain a pattern in public communication.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用网络广告来解释公共传播中的一种模式。

tip: ad是advertisement的非正式缩写，是可数名词。

senses.en: body tissue that tightens and relaxes to produce movement
power or influence used to achieve something

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about financial muscle.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于财力的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to financial muscle when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了财力。

tip: muscle中的c不发音；pull a muscle指拉伤肌肉。

senses.en: a woman employed to clean rooms or do household work

ex.en: Office hours began with hotel maid.
ex.zh: 答疑从酒店女清洁服务员开始。

ex.en: The reading connects hotel maid with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把酒店女清洁服务员和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: hotel maid｜酒店女清洁服务员
tip: 指女性家务或清洁雇员；酒店中常用room attendant。

senses.en: To say you are sorry for something you have done.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer apologise sincerely during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时真诚道歉。

ex.en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers apologise sincerely before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要真诚道歉。

tip: 英式拼写；美式常用apologize，后接to人、for事。

senses.en: the state of being ill
the feeling of needing to vomit, or vomiting itself

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on travel sickness.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论晕车晕船。

ex.en: The author returns to travel sickness when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了晕车晕船。

tip: 通常不可数；英式英语中也常指恶心、呕吐。

senses.en: activities concerning government and how a country is run
a person's beliefs about government and public affairs

ex.en: Our professor circled local politics on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了地方政治。

ex.en: The author returns to local politics when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了地方政治。

tip: 指政治活动时通常配单数谓语；政治立场可配复数。

senses.en: Someone who gathers and reports news for the media.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about investigative journalist.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于调查记者的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around investigative journalist.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕调查记者展开说明。

tip: journalist泛指新闻工作者，reporter更侧重采访报道。

senses.en: Someone whose job is to prepare and check financial records

ex.en: I copied qualified accountant into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把合格的会计师抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around qualified accountant.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕合格的会计师展开说明。

tip: accountant指人；accounting指会计工作或学科。

senses.en: Examining things to see how they are similar or different.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a direct comparison.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于直接比较的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a direct comparison.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得直接比较这个例子。

tip: 两者之间的比较用comparison between A and B。

senses.en: A substance produced or used in a chemical process.
Relating to substances and how they combine or change.

ex.en: Our professor circled a chemical reaction on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了化学反应。

ex.en: A campus survey used a chemical reaction to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用化学反应来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: chemical作名词可数；化学物质不一定有害。

senses.en: Something that is unknown or cannot be explained
The quality of being strange, secret, or difficult to understand
A story about solving a puzzling event, often a crime

ex.en: Our professor circled a sense of mystery on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了神秘感。

ex.en: A campus survey used a sense of mystery to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用神秘感来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 表示一个谜用a mystery；表示神秘感通常不可数。

senses.en: A person who types, especially as a job.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a fast typist.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于打字快的人的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to a fast typist when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了打字快的人。

col: a skilled typist｜熟练的打字员
tip: 指人；typing指打字活动，typewriter指打字机。

senses.en: A vegetable with dark green leaves eaten raw or cooked.

ex.en: The textbook introduces fresh spinach in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了新鲜菠菜。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of fresh spinach.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得新鲜菠菜这个例子。

tip: 通常不可数；一片菠菜叶说a spinach leaf。

senses.en: A pleasant state of physical ease and relaxation.
Relief from sadness or worry, or something providing it.
To help someone feel less sad, worried, or upset.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used comfort in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了舒适。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up comfort while discussing evidence about human behavior.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人类行为的证据时提到了舒适。

col: take comfort in｜从……中获得慰藉
creature comforts｜物质上的舒适享受
tip: 表示舒适或慰藉时通常不可数；作动词直接接人。

senses.en: Having an allergy to a particular substance
Caused by an allergy

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about allergic reaction.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于过敏反应的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects allergic reaction with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把过敏反应和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 说对某物过敏用be allergic to，不用allergic with。

senses.en: a connection between people, things, or ideas
a clickable element that opens another webpage or digital resource
to connect things or show a relationship between them

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a link between.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论……之间的联系。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a link between.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得……之间的联系这个例子。

col: link A to B｜将A与B联系起来
tip: 常用a link between A and B；动词用link A to/with B。

senses.en: Relaxed and friendly rather than following strict social rules.

senses.zh: 口语化的；非正式语体的
senses.en: Suitable for casual communication rather than formal writing or speech.
Not officially arranged, recognized, or controlled.

ex.en: I copied informal chat into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把闲聊抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around informal chat.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕闲聊展开说明。

tip: 表示不拘礼节，不等于不礼貌或不专业。

senses.en: sound recorded on magnetic tape

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize tape-recording in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出磁带录音。

ex.en: Students who can explain tape-recording usually follow the rest of a lecture on technological change.
ex.zh: 能解释磁带录音的学生，通常跟得上一节关于技术变革的讲座。

col: make a tape-recording｜制作磁带录音
listen to a tape-recording｜听磁带录音
a tape-recording of an interview｜访谈的磁带录音
tip: 也常写作 tape recording；数字录音通常用 recording。

senses.en: Not known, identified, or familiar.
Something not yet understood, or a person not widely known.

ex.en: Office hours began with the unknown.
ex.zh: 答疑从未知事物开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used the unknown to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用未知事物来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: unknown to someone｜某人不知道的
tip: the unknown泛指“未知事物或未知领域”。

senses.en: a pronunciation style associated with a place or social group
emphasis on a syllable, or a mark indicating pronunciation
to give special emphasis or prominence to something

ex.en: I copied regional accent into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把地方口音抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to regional accent when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了地方口音。

col: speak with an accent｜说话带口音
tip: accent指发音特点；dialect还涉及词汇和语法。

senses.en: A structure whose wind-driven sails power machinery, often for grinding grain.

ex.en: Our professor circled a traditional windmill on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了传统风车。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a traditional windmill.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕传统风车展开说明。

tip: 现代发电风机通常叫wind turbine。

senses.en: an amount expressed as a fraction of one hundred

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a high percentage of.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于很高比例的的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a high percentage of.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得很高比例的这个例子。

col: a high percentage of｜很高比例的
a small percentage of｜小部分的
tip: 数字后用percent；谈比例用percentage。

senses.en: Responsible for breaking a law or doing something wrong.
Feeling bad because you believe you have done something wrong.

ex.en: I copied plead guilty into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把认罪抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects plead guilty with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把认罪和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: find someone guilty｜裁定某人有罪
tip: guilty of接罪行；feel guilty about接内疚的事。

senses.en: to send goods to another country for sale
selling goods abroad, or goods sold to another country
to save computer data in a format another program uses

ex.en: I heard the lecturer export goods during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时出口商品。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to export goods.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来出口商品。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。

senses.en: A person or organisation trying to succeed against others.
Someone taking part in a competition.

ex.en: Our professor circled a major competitor on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了主要竞争对手。

ex.en: The reading connects a major competitor with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把主要竞争对手和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a major competitor｜主要竞争对手
a direct competitor｜直接竞争对手
a strong competitor｜强劲的竞争者
tip: competitor指竞争者；competition指竞争或比赛。

senses.en: take air into your lungs and let it out

ex.en: I heard the lecturer breathe deeply during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时深呼吸。

ex.en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers breathe deeply before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要深呼吸。

col: breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

senses.en: To say what will happen, often using evidence.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to predict the outcome.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何预测结果。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to predict the outcome.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来预测结果。

tip: 可接that从句；不要与表示预防的prevent混淆。

senses.zh: 机械修理工；汽车修理工
senses.en: Someone whose job is repairing vehicles or machines.

ex.en: Our professor circled car mechanic on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了汽车修理工。

ex.en: A campus survey used car mechanic to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用汽车修理工来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: a qualified mechanic｜合格的机械修理工
work as a mechanic｜当机械修理工
tip: mechanic指修理工；mechanics可指力学。

senses.en: to keep someone interested or amused
to welcome guests and provide food, drink, or activities
to consider an idea or hold a thought or feeling

ex.en: The lab instructions say to entertain an audience.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求为观众提供娱乐。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to entertain an audience.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来为观众提供娱乐。

col: entertain an audience｜为观众提供娱乐
entertain the idea of｜考虑……的想法
tip: entertain an idea指考虑某想法，并非已经接受。

senses.en: drinks containing a substance that can make people drunk
a colourless liquid used in drinks, cleaning products, and fuels

ex.en: I copied rubbing alcohol into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把外用消毒酒精抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rubbing alcohol.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论外用消毒酒精的材料。

tip: 泛指酒或酒精时通常不可数；a drink可指一杯酒。

senses.en: To suddenly force air out through your nose and mouth.
A sudden, involuntary burst of air from the nose and mouth.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to sneeze into a tissue.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何对着纸巾打喷嚏。

ex.en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers sneeze into a tissue before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要对着纸巾打喷嚏。

col: sneeze into a tissue｜对着纸巾打喷嚏
a fit of sneezing｜一阵喷嚏
tip: 动词不及物；“打一个喷嚏”可说give a sneeze。

senses.en: medical care given to improve an illness or injury
the way someone behaves towards a person or group
a process that cleans, protects, or changes a substance

ex.en: The textbook introduces receive treatment in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了接受治疗。

ex.en: A campus survey used receive treatment to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用接受治疗来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 泛指治疗通常不可数；指具体疗法时可用a treatment。

senses.en: Telling the truth and not cheating or stealing.
Expressing what you really think or feel.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an honest person.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于诚实的人的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects an honest person with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把诚实的人和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

senses.en: A powerful farm vehicle used to pull equipment or loads

ex.en: Our professor circled tractor driver on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了拖拉机驾驶员。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss tractor driver.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论拖拉机驾驶员的材料。

tip: tractor是拖拉机；truck是卡车，注意区别。

senses.en: someone harmed by an accident, crime, or unfair treatment

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on victim of crime.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论犯罪受害者。

ex.en: A campus survey used victim of crime to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用犯罪受害者来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: fall victim to｜成为……的受害者
tip: 表示某事的受害者，用victim of。

senses.en: Harm that makes something less useful, valuable, or healthy.
Harm something or make it less effective.

ex.en: I copied environmental damage into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把环境破坏抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss environmental damage.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论环境破坏的材料。

col: damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

senses.en: to take someone into police custody under legal authority
the act of taking someone into police custody
to stop the progress or development of something

ex.en: The assignment is to arrest the decline, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先遏制衰退，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to arrest the decline and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你遏制衰退，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: arrest someone for theft｜因盗窃逮捕某人
tip: 因某事被捕用be arrested for；under arrest表示被捕状态。

senses.en: funny or entertaining in a pleasant way

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about amusing story.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于有趣的故事的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to amusing story when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有趣的故事。

col: find something amusing｜觉得某事好笑
tip: amusing形容事物逗人笑；amused形容人觉得好笑。

senses.en: Feeling thankful for kindness, help, or something good.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about deeply grateful.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于深表感激的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss deeply grateful.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论深表感激的材料。

tip: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

senses.en: The middle part of your body above your hips.
The part of a garment that fits around your waist.

ex.en: The textbook introduces waist size in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了腰围。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around waist size.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕腰围展开说明。

col: from the waist up｜从腰部往上
tip: waist指腰，与表示浪费的waste同音。

senses.en: written dialogue or translation displayed on a screen
an additional title explaining a work's main title
to add written dialogue or translation to a film

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize subtitle in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出字幕。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up subtitle while discussing evidence about public communication.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共传播的证据时提到了字幕。

tip: 影视字幕通常用复数subtitles；单数也可指副标题。

senses.en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty
get back something lost, stolen, or spent

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to recover from an illness.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须病后康复。

ex.en: The passage says students who can recover from an illness follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够病后康复的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: recover from an illness｜病后康复
recover lost data｜恢复丢失的数据
tip: 从疾病或挫折中恢复用recover from。

senses.en: A brass musical instrument with three valves and a bright sound.
To announce or praise something loudly and publicly.
To make a loud sound like an elephant's call.

ex.en: Our professor circled trumpet player on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了小号手。

ex.en: The reading connects trumpet player with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把小号手和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 乐器义是“小号”；动词可指大肆宣扬。

senses.en: A belief or custom passed down through generations.

ex.en: The textbook introduces family tradition in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了家庭传统。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of family tradition.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得家庭传统这个例子。

tip: 具体习俗可数；泛指传统时可不可数，如break with tradition。

senses.en: Physical power to lift, move, or resist something.
A quality or skill that makes someone or something effective.
How strong, powerful, or resistant to damage something is.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about physical strength.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于体力的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used physical strength to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用体力来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 表示力气通常不可数；表示长处可数。

senses.en: the armed force that operates mainly at sea
a very dark blue colour
having a very dark blue colour

ex.en: Our professor circled navy blue on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了藏青色。

ex.en: A campus survey used navy blue to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用藏青色来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

col: serve in the navy｜在海军服役
tip: navy指海军整体；具体的一艘军舰用warship。

senses.en: Lasting a short time or using few words.
To give someone essential information or instructions.
Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.

ex.en: Our professor circled a design brief on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了设计任务说明。

ex.en: A campus survey used a design brief to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用设计任务说明来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况
a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

senses.en: Unlike anything else, or the only one of its kind
Found only in a particular person, place, or thing

ex.en: I copied unique opportunity into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把难得的机会抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss unique opportunity.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论难得的机会的材料。

col: unique to the region｜该地区特有的
tip: unique to表示某处特有；严格指唯一时不用very修饰。

senses.en: money borrowed and expected to be paid back
the temporary use of something belonging to someone else
to give money or something temporarily, expecting its return

ex.en: Office hours began with student loan.
ex.zh: 答疑从学生贷款开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss student loan.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论学生贷款的材料。

col: take out a loan｜申请贷款
tip: loan作动词意为借出，不是借入。

senses.en: not allowed by a rule, law, or authority

ex.en: I copied strictly forbidden into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把严格禁止的抄进了课堂笔记。
