ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around religious faith.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕宗教信仰展开说明。

col: in good faith｜真诚地；善意地
tip: 表示对某人或某事有信心，用have faith in。

senses.zh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的
senses.en: Having or showing plenty of energy and enthusiasm.

ex.en: I copied energetic children into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把精力旺盛的孩子抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used energetic children to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用精力旺盛的孩子来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: energetic形容人或活动有活力；energy是名词。

senses.en: Extreme or severe, causing a major change

ex.en: I copied drastic measures into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把严厉措施抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of drastic measures.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得严厉措施这个例子。

tip: 强调程度大、影响强，不等于表示速度快的rapid。

senses.en: A weapon with a long blade and a handle.

ex.en: Office hours began with a double-edged sword.
ex.zh: 答疑从双刃剑开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used a double-edged sword to explain a pattern in historical change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用双刃剑来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。

tip: w不发音；双刃剑可比喻既有利又有弊的事物。

senses.en: To accept something unpleasant or unwanted without stopping it.
To withstand difficult conditions or substances without serious harm.

ex.en: The professor asked us to tolerate noise.
ex.zh: 教授让我们忍受噪声。

ex.en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers tolerate noise before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要忍受噪声。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：tolerate doing，不接to do。

senses.en: The recorded music, speech, and sounds accompanying a film or programme.

ex.en: Office hours began with a film soundtrack.
ex.zh: 答疑从电影原声开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a film soundtrack when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了电影原声。

col: an original soundtrack｜原创影视配乐
compose a soundtrack｜创作影视配乐
tip: 不仅指配乐，也可指含对白和音效的完整声轨。

senses.en: An injury involving damage to skin or other body tissue.
To injure someone's body, especially by damaging the skin.
To hurt someone's feelings deeply.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a deep wound.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论很深的伤口。

ex.en: The reading connects a deep wound with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把很深的伤口和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: wound someone's pride｜伤害某人的自尊
tip: 伤口读/wuːnd/；wind的过去式wound读/waʊnd/。

senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of fear.
Violence or threats used to frighten and control people.

ex.en: Office hours began with sheer terror.
ex.zh: 答疑从极度恐惧开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sheer terror.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕极度恐惧展开说明。

col: a campaign of terror｜一连串恐怖活动
tip: 表示强烈恐惧，程度比fear深；通常不可数。

senses.en: The act of giving or taking food.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on bottle feeding.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论奶瓶喂养。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around bottle feeding.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕奶瓶喂养展开说明。

col: a feeding schedule｜喂养时间安排
tip: 既可作名词，也可作feed的现在分词。

senses.en: supporting new ideas and changes intended to improve society
happening or developing gradually over time
a person who supports social or political reform

ex.en: The textbook introduces progressive policies in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了进步的政策。

ex.en: The author returns to progressive policies when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了进步的政策。

tip: 既可指支持改革，也可指逐步发展，未必变好。

senses.en: The space between two lines or surfaces that meet.
A particular way of considering or presenting something.
To position something so that it slopes or faces sideways.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a right angle.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论直角。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a right angle.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕直角展开说明。

col: from a different angle｜从不同角度
tip: angle 是角度；angel 才是天使，注意字母顺序。

senses.en: Able to make people believe something or agree with you

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on persuasive argument.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论有说服力的论点。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of persuasive argument.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得有说服力的论点这个例子。

col: persuasive speaker｜善于说服人的演讲者
tip: 通常形容论点或表达有说服力，不作名词。

senses.en: Having no useful purpose or chance of achieving anything.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a pointless exercise.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于徒劳之举的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a pointless exercise to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用徒劳之举来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 常用 it is pointless to do，表示做某事徒劳。

senses.en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something
expressing disapproval or carefully judging strengths and weaknesses
so serious that someone may die or something may fail

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about critical to success.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于对成功至关重要的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects critical to success with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把对成功至关重要和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: critical to success｜对成功至关重要
tip: critical of表示批评；critical to表示对……至关重要。

senses.zh: 小牛；某些大型动物的幼崽
senses.en: A young cow or another large mammal, such as an elephant.
The fleshy back part of the leg below the knee.

ex.en: I copied a newborn calf into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把刚出生的小牛抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a newborn calf.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕刚出生的小牛展开说明。

col: a newborn calf｜刚出生的小牛
tip: 复数为calves；字母l不发音。

senses.en: A pause or delay caused by uncertainty or nervousness.

ex.en: Office hours began with a moment's hesitation.
ex.zh: 答疑从片刻犹豫开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of a moment's hesitation.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得片刻犹豫这个例子。

col: have no hesitation in doing｜毫不犹豫地做
tip: 毫不犹豫做某事：have no hesitation in doing。

senses.en: A person or organisation that pays taxes.

ex.en: The textbook introduces taxpayer money in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纳税人的钱。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of taxpayer money.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得纳税人的钱这个例子。

col: at taxpayers' expense｜由纳税人承担费用
taxpayer funding｜纳税人提供的资金
tip: 通常指纳税的个人，也可指纳税机构。

senses.en: A raw material or basic product that can be bought and sold.

ex.en: Coffee is both a campus habit and a traded commodity.
ex.zh: 咖啡既是校园习惯，也是被交易的大宗商品。

ex.en: The article explains how a commodity price can fall even when local shops stay expensive.
ex.zh: 文章解释了为什么大宗商品价格下跌时，本地商店仍可能很贵。

col: a commodity price｜大宗商品价格
tip: 复数 commodities 常指整类大宗商品。

senses.en: concerning right and wrong, or following accepted standards of goodness
a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on moral responsibility.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论道德责任。

ex.en: A campus survey used moral responsibility to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用道德责任来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: the moral of the story｜故事的寓意
tip: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: In a way that shows politeness and regard for others.

ex.en: The professor told us to respectfully disagree and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们礼貌地表示不同意，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will respectfully disagree when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会礼貌地表示不同意。

col: respectfully disagree｜礼貌地表示不同意
treat someone respectfully｜尊重地对待某人
tip: 勿混respectively（分别地）；本词强调尊重。

senses.en: a scientist who studies stars, planets, and space

ex.en: Our professor circled professional astronomer on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了专业天文学家。

ex.en: A campus survey used professional astronomer to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用专业天文学家来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: astronomer研究天体；astrologer是占星师。

senses.en: Likely to change frequently or unexpectedly.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about highly changeable.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于极易变化的的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to highly changeable when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了极易变化的。

col: a changeable mood｜变化无常的情绪
tip: 常形容天气或情绪多变；注意保留change末尾的e。

senses.en: information or resources supplied to a system or process
ideas or advice contributed to a discussion or task
to enter information into a computer or other device

ex.en: Our professor circled data input on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数据输入。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around data input.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕数据输入展开说明。

tip: 作动词时，过去式可用 input 或 inputted。

senses.en: To travel regularly between home and work.
A regular journey between home and work.
To replace a legal punishment with a less severe one.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to commute to work.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求通勤上班。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to commute to work.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得通勤上班。

tip: 通勤用 commute to work；减刑用 commute a sentence。

senses.en: A relationship in which changes in things are linked

ex.en: Our professor circled strong correlation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了高度相关。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss strong correlation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论高度相关的材料。

tip: correlation不等于causation：相关不代表因果。

senses.en: The ability to read and write.
Basic knowledge and skills needed in a particular area.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about adult literacy.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于成人读写能力的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects adult literacy with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把成人读写能力和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 不可数；digital literacy指数字素养，不只是识字。

senses.en: A note that tells the reader where a fact or quotation came from.

ex.en: Every chart in the paper needs a citation.
ex.zh: 论文里的每张图都需要引用出处。

ex.en: A missing citation makes it hard to check whether the claim is fair.
ex.zh: 缺少引用会让人难以核对这个主张是否公允。

tip: cite 是动词，citation 是名词。

senses.en: an exceptionally fine work of art, literature, or skill

ex.en: I copied a literary masterpiece into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把文学杰作抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a literary masterpiece with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把文学杰作和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常指作品，不用来指才华出众的人。

senses.en: a child whose parents have both died
to cause a child to lose both parents through death

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize orphan in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出孤儿。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up orphan while discussing evidence about social change.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了孤儿。

col: be orphaned at a young age｜幼年失去双亲
an orphaned child｜失去双亲的孩子
tip: 常用be orphaned表示因双亲去世而成为孤儿。

senses.en: existing only in the mind, not in reality

ex.en: I copied imaginary friend into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把想象中的朋友抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss imaginary friend.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论想象中的朋友的材料。

tip: imaginary指想象中的；imaginative指富有想象力的。

senses.en: Physical or mental pain experienced by people or animals.

ex.en: Our professor circled alleviate suffering on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了缓解痛苦。

ex.en: The reading connects alleviate suffering with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把缓解痛苦和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 泛指痛苦时通常不可数；sufferings指种种苦难。

senses.en: intended to be thrown away after use
available for spending or saving after taxes are paid

ex.en: Our professor circled disposable income on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可支配收入。

ex.en: A campus survey used disposable income to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用可支配收入来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

tip: disposable income指税后收入，不是扣除生活费后的余额。

senses.en: A brownish metal made mainly from copper and tin.
A medal awarded for finishing third in a competition.
Made of bronze, or having its reddish-brown color.

ex.en: The textbook introduces cast in bronze in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了用青铜铸造。

ex.en: A campus survey used cast in bronze to explain a pattern in historical change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用用青铜铸造来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。

tip: bronze是青铜；brass是黄铜；copper是铜。

senses.en: To try to find or obtain something.
To try to do or achieve something.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer seek advice during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时征求意见。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to seek advice.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们征求意见。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sought；后直接接宾语。

senses.en: in a way that achieves the intended result
in practice, although not officially or in every detail

ex.en: The lab manual says to effectively impossible before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先实际上不可能，再记下数字。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy asks the class to effectively impossible before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先实际上不可能。

tip: effectively侧重效果；efficiently侧重效率。

senses.en: the bony structure of the head that protects the brain

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a human skull.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论人类头骨。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a human skull.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论人类头骨的材料。

col: the base of the skull｜颅底
tip: skull指头部骨骼，brain指内部的大脑。

senses.en: a belief that something is wrong without definite proof
a feeling that someone or something cannot be trusted
a very small amount of something

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on arouse suspicion.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论引起怀疑。

ex.en: A campus survey used arouse suspicion to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用引起怀疑来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: on suspicion of theft｜涉嫌盗窃
tip: 常用suspicion of或suspicion that从句。

senses.en: the process of breaking down food so the body absorbs nutrients

ex.en: Our professor circled aid digestion on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了帮助消化。

ex.en: The reading connects aid digestion with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把帮助消化和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常不可数；消化不良常用 indigestion。

senses.en: the feeling that something is not as good as expected

ex.en: Office hours began with express dissatisfaction.
ex.zh: 答疑从表达不满开始。

ex.en: The author returns to express dissatisfaction when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了表达不满。

tip: 通常不可数；对某事不满用dissatisfaction with。

senses.en: The quality of being easy to understand or use.
The quality of having little decoration or unnecessary detail.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on elegant simplicity.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论典雅简约。

ex.en: The reading connects elegant simplicity with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把典雅简约和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: simplicity通常不可数；simple的名词形式。

senses.en: To injure a joint by twisting it too far.
An injury caused by twisting a joint too far.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to sprain an ankle.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须扭伤脚踝。

ex.en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers sprain an ankle before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要扭伤脚踝。

tip: sprain指关节扭伤；strain常指肌肉或肌腱拉伤。

senses.en: a government department responsible for a particular area
the work or duties of a religious minister

ex.en: The textbook introduces education ministry in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了教育部。

ex.en: A campus survey used education ministry to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用教育部来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 政府部门名称常用Ministry of加领域名词。

senses.en: To show respect through a formal gesture, especially in the military.
To publicly express admiration for someone or their achievements.
A formal gesture or action showing respect.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to salute an officer.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须向军官敬礼。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to salute an officer.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来向军官敬礼。

col: salute someone's courage｜赞扬某人的勇气
tip: 作动词直接接人：salute someone，无需加to。

senses.en: extremely large in size or amount

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a gigantic task.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论艰巨的任务。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a gigantic task.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕艰巨的任务展开说明。

tip: 语气强于big，可形容体积、规模或任务。

senses.en: the regular rise and fall of the sea
a strong movement or change in events or opinion

ex.en: I copied high tide into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把高潮；涨潮最高点抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss high tide.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论高潮；涨潮最高点的材料。

col: a tide of change｜变革浪潮
tip: tide是海水的周期性涨落，wave是单个波浪。

senses.zh: 至关重要的；必不可少的
senses.en: extremely important or necessary
necessary for keeping a living body alive

ex.en: Our professor circled vital importance on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了极端重要性。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vital importance.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕极端重要性展开说明。

col: play a vital role｜发挥关键作用
vital for survival｜生存所必需的
tip: 常用be vital for/to，表示对……至关重要。

senses.en: not paid by the date when payment was required

ex.en: The professor explained past-due with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了逾期未付的。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses past-due when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了逾期未付的。

tip: 名词前可加连字符；表语通常写作 past due。

senses.en: to make a disease disappear or someone healthy again
a treatment that makes a disease or condition disappear

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to cure a disease.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须治愈疾病。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cure a disease.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得治愈疾病。

col: cure someone of｜治好某人的……病
tip: cure强调治好；treat只表示治疗，不保证痊愈。

senses.en: A small gun designed to be held in one hand.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a starting pistol.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于发令枪的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a starting pistol.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕发令枪展开说明。

tip: pistol指手枪；rifle通常指步枪。

senses.en: Without paid employment, especially when wanting to work.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about the jobless.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于失业者群体的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the jobless.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕失业者群体展开说明。

tip: the jobless指失业者群体，作主语时谓语用复数。

senses.en: The work or study of recording and reporting financial transactions.

ex.en: Office hours began with financial accounting.
ex.zh: 答疑从财务会计开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss financial accounting.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论财务会计的材料。

tip: 表示会计工作或学科时不可数；会计师是 accountant。

senses.en: To a limited degree; rather, but not very.

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to somewhat different.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习有些不同。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research asks the class to somewhat different before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先有些不同。

tip: 比a bit正式，常用于缓和判断或语气。

senses.en: More powerful, influential, or noticeable than others.
Expressed when at least one copy of a gene is present.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a dominant role.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论主导作用。

ex.en: The author returns to a dominant role when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主导作用。

tip: dominant是形容词；dominate是动词。

senses.en: The light that reaches Earth from the moon.

senses.zh: 兼职；私下兼第二份工作
senses.en: To do another paid job alongside your main job, often secretly.

ex.en: I copied pale moonlight into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把淡淡的月光抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects pale moonlight with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把淡淡的月光和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: moonlight as a waiter｜兼职当服务员
tip: 月光是不可数名词；动词常接as表示兼职身份。

senses.en: To give someone the right to have or do something.
To give a name to a book, film, or other work.

ex.en: The assignment is to entitle someone to benefits, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先使某人有资格享受福利，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to entitle someone to benefits.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使某人有资格享受福利。

col: entitle someone to benefits｜使某人有资格享受福利
be entitled to compensation｜有权获得赔偿
be entitled to vote｜有权投票
tip: entitle sb to sth或to do sth；常用于被动语态。

senses.en: To become stronger or more complete, or make something so
To become physically deeper, or make something deeper
To become lower in pitch, or make a sound lower

ex.en: I heard the lecturer deepen understanding during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时加深理解。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to deepen understanding.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得加深理解。

tip: 既可及物也可不及物：deepen trust；a crisis deepens。

senses.en: Having no end or limit
Extremely great in amount or degree

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about infinite possibilities.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于无限的可能性的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects infinite possibilities with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把无限的可能性和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常作形容词；表示“无穷”常用名词infinity。

senses.en: A particular version of a book or other published work.

senses.zh: 报刊的一期；节目的一期
senses.en: One particular issue of a newspaper or broadcast programme.

ex.en: Our professor circled first edition on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了第一版。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss first edition.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论第一版的材料。

tip: edition指版本或期次；一本实体书通常叫a copy。

senses.en: Relating to a particular area within a country or world.

ex.en: I copied regional development into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把区域发展抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects regional development with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把区域发展和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: regional范围通常比local大，比national小。

senses.en: not completely correct or exact

ex.en: The textbook introduces factually inaccurate in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了事实有误的。

ex.en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of factually inaccurate.
ex.zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得事实有误的这个例子。

tip: 指信息或测量不准确；不一定意味着故意造假。

senses.en: spoken rather than written
relating to the mouth or taken through the mouth

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on oral examination.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论口试。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss oral examination.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论口试的材料。

tip: oral既指口头的，也指口腔的；oral medication是口服药。

senses.en: very pleasant, enjoyable, or charming

ex.en: Our professor circled a delightful experience on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了愉快的体验。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a delightful experience.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕愉快的体验展开说明。

col: a delightful surprise｜令人欣喜的意外
tip: delightful形容令人愉快；delighted指感到高兴。

senses.en: Based on personal feelings or opinions rather than independent facts

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on highly subjective.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论非常主观的。

ex.en: The author returns to highly subjective when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了非常主观的。

tip: subjective强调个人感受；objective强调客观事实。

senses.en: the state of being impossible, or something that cannot happen

ex.en: Office hours began with a practical impossibility.
ex.zh: 答疑从实际上不可能的事开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a practical impossibility.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得实际上不可能的事这个例子。

col: a practical impossibility｜实际上不可能的事
a physical impossibility｜客观条件下不可能的事
the impossibility of doing something｜做某事的不可能性
tip: 指不可能性时不可数；指一件不可能的事时可数。

senses.en: Not being used or doing any work.
Avoiding work or spending time doing nothing.
For an engine to run while the vehicle remains still.

ex.en: The textbook introduces idle machinery in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了闲置的机器。

ex.en: The reading connects idle machinery with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把闲置的机器和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an idling engine｜空转的发动机
tip: idle可指人闲着、设备闲置，也可指发动机空转。

senses.en: An established organisation serving an educational, financial, or public purpose.
An established custom or system within a society.

ex.en: Office hours began with educational institution.
ex.zh: 答疑从教育机构开始。

ex.en: The reading connects educational institution with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把教育机构和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the institution of marriage｜婚姻制度
tip: 可指具体机构，也可指婚姻等社会制度。

senses.en: A wide, open container for water or washing.
The land drained by a river and its smaller rivers.
A broad area of low land surrounded by higher ground.

ex.en: The textbook introduces wash basin in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了洗脸盆。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of wash basin.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得洗脸盆这个例子。

tip: river basin指整个流域，不只是河道。

senses.en: pointing straight up or down, perpendicular to a horizontal surface
a vertical line, direction, or position

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a vertical line.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于垂直线的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a vertical line.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得垂直线这个例子。

tip: vertical指竖直方向；horizontal指水平方向。

senses.en: The activity of buying and selling goods and services.

ex.en: I copied international commerce into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把国际贸易抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around international commerce.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕国际贸易展开说明。

tip: commerce通常不可数，侧重商品和服务的买卖活动。

senses.en: to officially choose someone for a job or responsibility
to officially decide a time or place for something

ex.en: The professor asked us to appoint a committee.
ex.zh: 教授让我们任命委员会成员。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers appoint a committee before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要任命委员会成员。

col: appoint a committee｜任命委员会成员
at the appointed time｜在约定的时间
tip: 任命某人可用appoint sb as或appoint sb to职位。

senses.en: Using both sound and images to communicate information

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize audio-visual in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出视听的。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up audio-visual while discussing evidence about academic research.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了视听的。

tip: 也写作audiovisual，常缩写为AV。

senses.en: To fail to notice or consider something.
To have a view of somewhere from above.
To deliberately ignore a mistake or fault.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to overlook a detail.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求忽略细节。

ex.en: The passage says students who can overlook a detail follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够忽略细节的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: overlook the fact that｜忽略这一事实
tip: overlook可指忽略或俯瞰；不要与监督的oversee混淆。

senses.en: To make someone extremely tired.
To use all of something, leaving none remaining.
Waste gases from an engine, or the pipe releasing them.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer exhaust natural resources during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时耗尽自然资源。

ex.en: The passage says students who can exhaust natural resources follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够耗尽自然资源的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: exhaust natural resources｜耗尽自然资源
exhaust all possibilities｜尝试所有可能的办法
tip: exhausted 指人累极了；exhausting 指事物令人疲惫。

senses.en: An organised list of items, often with descriptions or pictures
Make an organised record of items and their details
A series of unpleasant events or failures

ex.en: Our professor circled library catalogue on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了图书馆目录。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss library catalogue.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论图书馆目录的材料。

col: a catalogue of errors｜一连串错误
tip: 英式拼写catalogue；美式常写catalog。

senses.en: Behaving immaturely in a way unsuitable for an adult.
Typical of or connected with children.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about childish behaviour.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于幼稚的行为的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of childish behaviour.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得幼稚的行为这个例子。

tip: childish 常含贬义；childlike 多指天真无邪。

senses.en: a row of closely planted bushes forming a boundary
something that reduces the risk of financial loss

senses.zh: 回避明确表态；含糊其辞
senses.en: to avoid giving a clear or definite answer

ex.en: Office hours began with a hedge against inflation.
ex.zh: 答疑从对冲通胀的手段开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used a hedge against inflation to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用对冲通胀的手段来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: a hedge against inflation｜对冲通胀的手段
hedge your bets｜多方下注以分散风险
tip: 金融义常用 a hedge against，表示防范某种风险。

senses.en: Making someone feel worried, upset, or uncomfortable.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about deeply disturbing.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于极其令人不安的的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used deeply disturbing to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用极其令人不安的来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: a disturbing trend｜令人担忧的趋势
tip: disturbing指事物令人不安；disturbed指人感到不安。

senses.en: A body part that performs a particular function.
A keyboard instrument producing sound through pipes or electronic equipment.

ex.en: I copied organ donation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把器官捐献抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around organ donation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕器官捐献展开说明。

tip: organ指器官；organism指完整的生物体。

senses.en: a long orchestral composition, usually divided into several movements

ex.en: The textbook introduces symphony orchestra in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了交响乐团。

ex.en: The reading connects symphony orchestra with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把交响乐团和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: symphony指交响曲；交响乐团用symphony orchestra。

senses.en: A fault that makes something imperfect or unable to work properly.
To leave a country or group and join an opposing one.

ex.en: Our professor circled a design defect on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了设计缺陷。

ex.en: The reading connects a design defect with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把设计缺陷和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: defect to the opposition｜转投反对派
tip: 名词重音在前；动词读/dɪˈfekt/。

senses.en: A difference or change in amount, level, form, or quality.
A version of something that differs from its usual form.

ex.en: Office hours began with seasonal variation.
ex.zh: 答疑从季节性变化开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss seasonal variation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论季节性变化的材料。

col: a variation on a theme｜同一主题的变体
tip: variation in指某方面的差异；variation on指变体。

senses.en: Great respect, or something that brings pride and privilege.
To show deep respect or publicly recognize someone's achievements.
To do what a promise or agreement requires.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a great honour.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论莫大的荣幸。

ex.en: A campus survey used a great honour to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用莫大的荣幸来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: in honour of｜为纪念；向……致敬
tip: 英式honour，美式honor；h不发音，用an。

senses.en: Say that something is not true or did not happen.
Refuse to give or allow someone something.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to deny an allegation.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须否认指控。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to deny an allegation.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来否认指控。

col: deny doing something｜否认做过某事
deny access to｜不准使用或进入
tip: 否认做某事用 deny doing，不用 deny to do。

senses.en: a close connection between people or groups
an investment representing a loan with promised repayment and interest
to develop a close relationship or join things firmly together

ex.en: The textbook introduces a strong bond in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了牢固的纽带。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a strong bond.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得牢固的纽带这个例子。

col: form a bond｜建立亲密关系
tip: bond with sb指增进感情；issue bonds指发行债券。

senses.en: A ball-shaped model of Earth showing its land and oceans.
The Earth, especially when considering all its regions.
An object shaped like a ball.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a glass globe in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了玻璃球。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a glass globe.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕玻璃球展开说明。

tip: a globe常指地球仪；the globe常指整个世界。

senses.en: the natural environment where an animal or plant lives

ex.en: Our professor circled natural habitat on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了自然栖息地。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of natural habitat.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得自然栖息地这个例子。

tip: habit 是习惯，habitat 是动植物的栖息地。

senses.en: A judgement about something based on careful examination.
A task or process used to measure a learner's progress.

ex.en: I copied risk assessment into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把风险评估抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used risk assessment to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用风险评估来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: carry out an assessment｜进行评估
tip: 评估某事用assessment of；动词形式是assess。

senses.en: loss of respect caused by unacceptable behaviour
a person or thing deserving strong disapproval
to cause someone or something to lose respect

ex.en: I copied a disgrace to into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把给……丢脸的人或事抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a disgrace to when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了给……丢脸的人或事。

col: a disgrace to｜给……丢脸的人或事
tip: 泛指耻辱时不可数；a disgrace指可耻的人或事。

senses.en: To take legal action against someone, usually seeking compensation.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to sue for damages.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何起诉要求损害赔偿。

ex.en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers sue for damages before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要起诉要求损害赔偿。

col: sue for damages｜起诉要求损害赔偿
sue for negligence｜因过失提起诉讼
tip: sue someone for something：因某事起诉某人。

senses.en: the study and use of electronic circuits and devices
devices that operate using electronic circuits

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about consumer electronics.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于消费类电子产品的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around consumer electronics.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕消费类电子产品展开说明。

tip: 指电子学时虽以s结尾，谓语仍用单数。

senses.en: to organize and carry out an activity
to allow heat or electricity to pass through
the way a person behaves, especially towards others

ex.en: The professor asked us to conduct research.
ex.zh: 教授让我们开展研究。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers conduct research before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要开展研究。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

senses.en: The state of being completely sure about something.

senses.zh: 必然发生的事；确定的事
senses.en: Something that is definitely true or sure to happen.

ex.en: I copied absolute certainty into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把绝对确定抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used absolute certainty to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用绝对确定来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: a degree of certainty｜一定程度的把握
tip: 表确信通常不可数；a certainty指确定的事。

senses.en: Someone trained to help people discuss and manage personal problems.
Someone who gives professional advice on a particular subject.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a school counsellor.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论学校辅导员。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a school counsellor.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得学校辅导员这个例子。

tip: 英式counsellor，美式counselor；勿混councillor议员。

senses.en: Relating to the sea or organisms living in it
Relating to ships and transport by sea
A soldier trained to serve on land and at sea

ex.en: The textbook introduces marine life in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了海洋生物。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of marine life.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得海洋生物这个例子。

tip: marine侧重海洋；海军的通常用naval。

senses.en: A treatment or medicine used to relieve an illness.
A way of correcting a problem or improving a situation.
To correct a problem or improve an unsatisfactory situation.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about home remedy.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于家庭疗法的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects home remedy with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把家庭疗法和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a remedy for｜针对……的疗法或办法
tip: 名词常接for；动词直接接问题，不加for。

senses.en: The act of identifying someone or something encountered before.
Public appreciation of someone's achievements or value.
Acceptance that something exists, is true, or has official status.

ex.en: Our professor circled facial recognition on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了人脸识别。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss facial recognition.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论人脸识别的材料。

col: in recognition of｜为表彰；为肯定
tip: 通常不可数；in recognition of常用于表彰贡献。

senses.en: working together or helping by doing what is requested

ex.en: The assignment is to cooperating with colleagues, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先与同事合作，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers cooperating with colleagues before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要与同事合作。

col: cooperating on research｜合作开展研究
tip: cooperate的-ing形式；与某人合作用with。

senses.en: an amount of a drug taken that exceeds safe limits
to take a dangerously large amount of a drug

ex.en: Office hours began with an accidental overdose.
ex.zh: 答疑从意外用药过量开始。

ex.en: The reading connects an accidental overdose with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把意外用药过量和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an accidental overdose｜意外用药过量
overdose on medication｜过量服用药物
tip: 动词用 overdose on sth；名词用 an overdose of sth。

senses.en: Not too expensive for someone to pay for.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on affordable housing.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可负担的住房。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss affordable housing.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论可负担的住房的材料。

col: affordable healthcare｜负担得起的医疗服务
tip: 强调价格在承受范围内，不一定意味着绝对便宜。

senses.en: the way parts of a space or page are arranged

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about page layout.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于页面布局的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of page layout.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得页面布局这个例子。

tip: 名词layout写成一词；动词lay out分开写。

senses.en: to change something into a different form, purpose, or system
to adopt a different religion or persuade someone to do so
someone who has adopted a new religion, belief, or practice

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to convert into.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须转变为。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to convert into.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来转变为。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前。

senses.en: the business or process of transporting goods
the charge for delivering goods
ships considered together as a group

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about free shipping.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于免运费的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss free shipping.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论免运费的材料。

tip: 通常不可数；网购中的shipping也可指非海运配送。

senses.en: An insect with long back legs used for jumping.

ex.en: Our professor circled a green grasshopper on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一只绿色蚱蜢。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a green grasshopper.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得一只绿色蚱蜢这个例子。

col: a green grasshopper｜一只绿色蚱蜢
tip: locust指能形成迁飞群的某些蝗虫。

senses.en: A large area of sea partly surrounded by land.
A major difference separating people, groups, or ideas.

ex.en: I copied a wide gulf into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把巨大差距抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a wide gulf.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论巨大差距的材料。

col: the gulf between rich and poor｜贫富差距
tip: gulf可指海湾，也常用gulf between表示巨大差距。

senses.en: Lasting forever, without an end.
Seeming to continue endlessly, often in an annoying way.

ex.en: The textbook introduces eternal life in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了永生。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around eternal life.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕永生展开说明。

tip: eternal强调无终点；eternal complaints可夸张指抱怨不断。

senses.en: clearly different or separate from something else
easy to notice, hear, see, or recognize

ex.en: Our professor circled distinct from on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了与……不同。

ex.en: The reading connects distinct from with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把与……不同和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: two distinct groups｜两个不同的群体
tip: distinct from表示“与……不同”；勿混淆为distant。

senses.en: Form ideas about something without having enough evidence.
Buy and sell assets hoping to profit from price changes.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to speculate about the cause.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求推测原因。

ex.en: The reading asks you to speculate about the cause and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你推测原因，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: speculate about the cause｜推测原因
tip: 推测常接about或that从句；投机领域用in。

senses.en: the state of being real or present
a person's way of living, especially under particular conditions

ex.en: Our professor circled a peaceful existence on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了平静的生活。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a peaceful existence.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得平静的生活这个例子。

col: come into existence｜开始存在；形成
tip: 表示“存在”通常不可数；a quiet existence指平静生活。

senses.en: To face and deal with a difficult situation or problem.
To challenge someone directly about something they have done.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to confront a problem.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何正视问题。

ex.en: The passage says students who can confront a problem follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够正视问题的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: confront someone about something｜就某事质问某人
tip: 直接接问题；be confronted with表示面临。

senses.en: Relating to scientific tests or based on their results
Using new ideas or methods whose success is not yet established

ex.en: I copied experimental evidence into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把实验证据抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss experimental evidence.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论实验证据的材料。

tip: experimental指实验的或试验性的，不是“有经验的”。

senses.en: An act that breaks a law or rule.
Hurt or anger caused by something rude or disrespectful.

ex.en: I copied a criminal offence into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把刑事犯罪抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a criminal offence to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用刑事犯罪来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 英式拼写offence，美式offense；take offence表示生气。

senses.en: Wrong about something or based on an incorrect belief.

ex.en: Our professor circled if I am not mistaken on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了如果我没弄错。

ex.en: The author returns to if I am not mistaken when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了如果我没弄错。

col: if I am not mistaken｜如果我没弄错
tip: 人作主语时常用be mistaken about，表示对某事弄错。

senses.en: a message sent by telegraph and delivered in written form

ex.en: After the lecture, we used telegram in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了电报。

ex.en: Students who can explain telegram usually follow the rest of a lecture on historical change.
ex.zh: 能解释电报的学生，通常跟得上一节关于历史变迁的讲座。

tip: telegram是电报消息；telegraph指电报通信系统。

senses.en: The variety of living things in a habitat or on Earth.

ex.en: The field course measured biodiversity along the campus stream.
ex.zh: 野外课测量了校园溪流一带的生物多样性。

ex.en: The reading links biodiversity to how well a forest recovers after a fire.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把生物多样性和火灾后森林的恢复能力联系起来。

tip: 不可数名词，前面通常不加 a。

senses.en: Too expensive for someone to pay for.

ex.en: I copied unaffordable housing into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把难以负担的住房抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects unaffordable housing with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把难以负担的住房和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 强调超出支付能力，不只是价格高。

senses.en: Working for yourself rather than being employed by an organisation.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used self-employed in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了自雇的。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses self-employed when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了自雇的。

tip: 指为自己工作，不等于失业；注意保留连字符。

senses.en: The activity of collecting money for an organization or cause.

ex.en: I wrote fund-raising on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把fund-raising和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses fund-raising when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了筹款。

tip: 也常拼作fundraising；raise funds意为筹款。

senses.en: to give official permission for an activity
an official document permitting an activity or ownership

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to license someone to do something.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何许可某人做某事。

ex.en: The passage says students who can license someone to do something follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够许可某人做某事的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: license someone to do something｜许可某人做某事
apply for a license｜申请许可证
tip: 英式名词写 licence、动词写 license；美式均用 license。

senses.en: An insect with hard outer wings covering its flying wings.

ex.en: The textbook introduces dung beetle in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了蜣螂。

ex.en: A campus survey used dung beetle to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用蜣螂来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 指甲虫；不要用它表示“近视的人”。

senses.en: the lightest chemical element, a colourless gas that burns easily

ex.en: Office hours began with hydrogen fuel.
ex.zh: 答疑从氢燃料开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of hydrogen fuel.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得氢燃料这个例子。

tip: hydrogen是不可数名词，表示化学元素氢或氢气。

senses.en: information or conclusions obtained through research or investigation

ex.en: I copied research findings into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把研究结果抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around research findings.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕研究结果展开说明。

tip: 常用复数：the findings suggest，谓语不用单数。

senses.en: selling in very large quantities compared with similar products

ex.en: After the lecture, we used best-selling in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了畅销的。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up best-selling while discussing evidence about the humanities.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于人文学科的证据时提到了畅销的。

tip: best-selling作形容词；bestseller是畅销书或商品。

senses.en: Related to organising and running an institution or business.

ex.en: I copied administrative staff into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把行政人员抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around administrative staff.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕行政人员展开说明。

tip: 指机构的行政管理，不等于政府本身。

senses.en: someone who thinks deeply or develops important ideas

ex.en: I copied independent thinker into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把独立思考者抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to independent thinker when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了独立思考者。

col: critical thinker｜善于批判性思考的人
influential thinker｜有影响力的思想家
tip: thinker指人；thinking指思考过程或思维方式。

senses.en: Complete or total, used to emphasise something
To say something or make a sound with your voice

ex.en: Office hours began with utter chaos.
ex.zh: 答疑从彻底混乱开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used utter chaos to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用彻底混乱来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

tip: 形容词utter只放名词前；副词用utterly。

senses.en: A feeling of thankfulness for help or kindness received.

ex.en: Office hours began with express gratitude.
ex.zh: 答疑从表达感激开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used express gratitude to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用表达感激来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: gratitude to someone｜对某人的感激
gratitude for something｜对某事的感激
a token of gratitude｜一点谢意
tip: 对人感激用to，对某事感激用for；通常不可数。

senses.en: to change from liquid into gas, or cause this change
to disappear, especially gradually

ex.en: The professor asked us to evaporate rapidly.
ex.zh: 教授让我们迅速蒸发。

ex.en: The reading asks you to evaporate rapidly and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你迅速蒸发，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 蒸发不一定要沸腾；evaporate也可比喻希望等消失。

senses.en: Happening or behaving in a way that can be expected.
Boring because nothing surprising or original happens.

ex.en: Office hours began with highly predictable.
ex.zh: 答疑从十分容易预测的开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around highly predictable.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕十分容易预测的展开说明。

tip: 既可表示结果可预料，也可贬指情节老套。

senses.en: to discover something previously hidden or unknown
to remove something covering an object or surface

ex.en: The lab instructions say to uncover evidence.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求发现证据。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to uncover evidence.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来发现证据。

tip: 既可指揭去实物覆盖，也可指发现隐藏事实。

senses.en: unkind or excessively severe in judging or treating others
very difficult or unpleasant to live in or experience
unpleasantly strong and uncomfortable to the senses

ex.en: Our professor circled harsh criticism on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了苛刻的批评。

ex.en: The author returns to harsh criticism when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了苛刻的批评。

tip: 比strict更强调严厉得令人不快或难以承受。

senses.en: a power believed to control what happens in people's lives
what eventually happens to someone or something, often something bad

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on seal someone's fate.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论决定某人的命运。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around seal someone's fate.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕决定某人的命运展开说明。

col: leave something to fate｜让某事听天由命
seal someone's fate｜决定某人的命运
suffer the same fate｜遭遇同样的结局
tip: 表示天意时通常不可数；a terrible fate指悲惨结局。

senses.en: Feeling nearly hopeless and ready to try anything.
Wanting or needing something very badly.
Extremely serious or dangerous and needing immediate action.

ex.en: The textbook introduces desperate for help in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了急需帮助。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss desperate for help.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论急需帮助的材料。

col: a desperate attempt｜孤注一掷的尝试
desperate measures｜不得已的极端措施
tip: 渴望某物用desperate for；急切做某事用to do。

senses.en: The framework of bones supporting a human or animal body.
A basic structure to which more details can be added.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about human skeleton.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于人体骨骼的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss human skeleton.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论人体骨骼的材料。

col: skeleton staff｜最低限度的工作人员
tip: skeleton staff指维持运转所需的最少人员。

senses.en: an action taken to prevent danger, damage, or problems

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a precaution against fire.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论防火措施。

ex.en: The author returns to a precaution against fire when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了防火措施。

col: as a precaution｜作为预防措施
a precaution against fire｜防火措施
tip: 常用 take precautions；as a precaution 表示以防万一。

senses.en: Someone competing for a job or an elected position.
Someone taking an examination.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on suitable candidate.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论合适的人选。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around suitable candidate.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕合适的人选展开说明。

col: candidate for a position｜某职位的候选人
tip: candidate for后接所竞聘的职位或所竞选的职务。

senses.en: A book or website explaining many subjects or one field.

ex.en: I copied online encyclopedia into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把在线百科全书抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to online encyclopedia when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了在线百科全书。

col: consult an encyclopedia｜查阅百科全书
tip: 英式英语也常拼作encyclopaedia。

senses.en: larger than normal because of injury or illness
carrying more water than usual after heavy rain

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a swollen ankle.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论肿胀的脚踝。

ex.en: The author returns to a swollen ankle when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了肿胀的脚踝。

col: a swollen river｜水位上涨的河流
tip: 也作swell的过去分词；过去式是swelled。

senses.en: The general opinion people have about someone or something.

ex.en: I copied damage someone's reputation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把损害某人的声誉抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects damage someone's reputation with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把损害某人的声誉和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
a reputation for quality｜品质优良的口碑
tip: 用reputation for接特点；名声可好可坏。

senses.zh: 家政服务员；客房服务员
senses.en: Someone employed to clean and look after homes or hotel rooms.

ex.en: Office hours began with hotel housekeeper.
ex.zh: 答疑从酒店客房服务员开始。

ex.en: The author returns to hotel housekeeper when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了酒店客房服务员。

col: hire a housekeeper｜雇用家政服务员
tip: 指受雇打理家务或客房的人，不限性别。

senses.en: pressure or difficulty that tests someone's strength or resources
to injure or overwork a muscle or body part
a particular type of plant, animal, or microorganism

ex.en: Office hours began with a strain of virus.
ex.zh: 答疑从一种病毒株开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a strain of virus.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕一种病毒株展开说明。

col: put a strain on｜给……造成压力
a strain of virus｜一种病毒株
tip: strain可指拉伤；sprain主要指关节扭伤。

senses.en: the quality of being correct or free from errors

ex.en: I copied improve accuracy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把提高准确性抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to improve accuracy when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了提高准确性。

col: check the accuracy of｜核查……的准确性
a high degree of accuracy｜高度准确
tip: 通常为不可数名词；形容词是accurate。

senses.en: A discussion in which people express different views.
To discuss a subject by considering different views.
To think carefully about options before making a decision.

ex.en: Our professor circled public debate on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公开讨论。

ex.en: The author returns to public debate when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公开讨论。

col: debate an issue｜讨论一个问题
tip: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

senses.en: the gathering of crops, or the crops gathered
to gather crops when they are ready

ex.en: Office hours began with a good harvest.
ex.zh: 答疑从好收成开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a good harvest.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得好收成这个例子。

tip: 作名词可指收割活动，也可指收获的作物或产量。

senses.en: to establish an organization, institution, or settlement
past tense and past participle of find

ex.en: The assignment is to found a company, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先创办公司，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to found a company.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们创办公司。

col: found a charity｜创办慈善机构
tip: “创立”的过去式是founded；“找到”的原形是find。

senses.en: A chemical element needed for strong bones and teeth

ex.en: Our professor circled a source of calcium on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了钙的来源。

ex.en: The reading connects a source of calcium with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把钙的来源和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a source of calcium｜钙的来源
tip: 不可数名词；化学符号为Ca。

senses.en: in a way relating to money, trade, or the economy
using little money, fuel, or other resources

ex.en: The lab manual says to economically viable before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先经济上可行的，再记下数字。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will economically viable when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会经济上可行的。

tip: 兼有economic的“经济上”和economical的“节约地”之意。

senses.en: A strong building or enclosed place built for military defence.

ex.en: I copied coastal fort into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把海岸要塞抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects coastal fort with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把海岸要塞和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: fort侧重军事防御；castle常兼作贵族住所。

senses.en: A woody plant with several stems, usually smaller than a tree

ex.en: Our professor circled flowering shrub on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了开花灌木。

ex.en: The author returns to flowering shrub when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了开花灌木。

tip: 可数名词，指灌木植株；一片灌木可用shrubbery。

senses.en: related to education, study, or research
someone who teaches or researches at a university

senses.zh: 纯理论的；无实际意义的
senses.en: theoretical rather than useful in a practical situation

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about academic achievement.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于学业成就的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to academic achievement when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学业成就。

tip: 作名词指大学教师或研究者，通常不指大学生。

senses.en: A place where waste is buried in the ground.
The disposal of waste by burying it in the ground.

ex.en: I copied landfill site into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把垃圾填埋场抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around landfill site.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕垃圾填埋场展开说明。

col: send waste to landfill｜将垃圾送去填埋
tip: 指填埋场时可数；指填埋处理时通常不可数。

senses.en: A person or business that buys and sells particular goods.
The person who gives out cards in a card game.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a car dealer.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论汽车经销商。

ex.en: The reading connects a car dealer with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把汽车经销商和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a reputable dealer｜信誉良好的经销商
tip: 常在前面加商品类别，如car dealer，明确经营范围。

senses.en: Writing arranged with rhythm, often using rhyme.
A group of lines forming part of a poem or song.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about free verse.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于自由诗的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss free verse.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论自由诗的材料。

tip: 泛指韵文时不可数；指某一诗节时可数。

senses.en: a greater liking for one thing than for another
an advantage given to someone or something over others

ex.en: The textbook introduces personal preference in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了个人偏好。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around personal preference.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕个人偏好展开说明。

col: in preference to｜优先于；而不是
tip: 对某物的偏好用preference for，不用to。

senses.en: A period distinguished by particular events, developments, or ways of life.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about digital era.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于数字时代的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss digital era.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论数字时代的材料。

col: the end of an era｜一个时代的终结
tip: era强调具有共同特征的时代，不指固定年数。

senses.en: A particular quality in someone's character or an organism's nature.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about personality trait.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于性格特征的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects personality trait with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把性格特征和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: trait是可数名词，常指性格或遗传特征。

senses.en: Romantically or sexually attracted to people of the same sex.
Relating to gay people, their lives, or their culture.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on openly gay.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公开同性恋身份的。

ex.en: The reading connects openly gay with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把公开同性恋身份的和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: openly gay｜公开同性恋身份的
tip: 通常作形容词；“快乐的”义现已少用。

senses.en: showing understanding and care for someone's difficulties
showing approval or support for an idea or proposal

ex.en: Office hours began with a sympathetic listener.
ex.zh: 答疑从体贴的倾听者开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a sympathetic listener when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了体贴的倾听者。

col: a sympathetic listener｜体贴的倾听者
sympathetic to a proposal｜赞同一项提议
tip: 常接to或towards；不表示“讨人喜欢的”。

senses.en: a young person developing from a child into an adult
relating to the stage between childhood and adulthood

ex.en: The textbook introduces adolescent development in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了青少年发育。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of adolescent development.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得青少年发育这个例子。

col: adolescent mental health｜青少年心理健康
tip: 既可作名词也可作形容词；比 teenager 更正式。

senses.en: a male peafowl with long, colourful feathers it spreads out

ex.en: Our professor circled peacock feathers on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了孔雀羽毛。

ex.en: A campus survey used peacock feathers to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用孔雀羽毛来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: a peacock's tail｜雄孔雀的尾羽
as proud as a peacock｜像孔雀般得意
tip: 严格说peacock指雄孔雀，雌孔雀叫peahen。

senses.en: An organised procession of people or vehicles watched by spectators.
To walk together in an organised public procession.
To show something publicly, often to attract admiration.

ex.en: I copied a street parade into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把街头游行抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a street parade when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了街头游行。

col: parade through the streets｜列队穿过街道
tip: parade重在列队展示；抗议游行常用march。

senses.en: Having a helpful or positive effect.

ex.en: I copied mutually beneficial into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把互利的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to mutually beneficial when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了互利的。

tip: 常接to或for，说明对谁或哪方面有益。

senses.en: Widely admired for lasting quality and value.
Showing the most recognizable features of a particular kind.
A work admired over time for its excellent quality.

ex.en: Our professor circled timeless classic on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了永恒的经典。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of timeless classic.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得永恒的经典这个例子。

tip: classic指经典或典型；古典音乐用classical。

senses.en: to breathe noisily through your nose and throat while sleeping
a noisy breath made by someone who is sleeping

ex.en: The lab instructions say to snore loudly.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求大声打鼾。

ex.en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to snore loudly.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们大声打鼾。

col: a loud snore｜一声响亮的鼾声
tip: 作动词通常不及物；snoring可指打鼾这一现象。

senses.en: Break down food inside the body so it can be used.
Think about information until you understand it.
A short collection of the main points from longer material.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to digest food.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须消化食物。

ex.en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to digest food.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们消化食物。

tip: 名词重音在首音节，读 /ˈdaɪdʒest/。

senses.en: A short phrase expressing someone's guiding belief or purpose.

ex.en: Our professor circled a personal motto on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了个人座右铭。

ex.en: The author returns to a personal motto when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了个人座右铭。

col: adopt a motto｜采用一句格言
tip: motto强调指导信念；slogan更常指宣传口号。

senses.en: To suffer something difficult or unpleasant without giving up.
To continue existing despite difficulties or the passage of time.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to endure hardship.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须忍受艰苦。

ex.en: The reading asks you to endure hardship and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你忍受艰苦，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 表“忍受”直接接宾语；表“持续”可不接宾语。

senses.en: A barrier across a river that holds back water.
To block a river or stream with a barrier.

ex.en: Our professor circled a hydroelectric dam on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了水电站大坝。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of a hydroelectric dam.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得水电站大坝这个例子。

tip: dam是拦水的坝；reservoir是蓄水的水库。

senses.en: Relating to the regions around the Earth's poles.
Completely opposite in character, direction, or opinion.

ex.en: I copied polar regions into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把极地地区抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to polar regions when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了极地地区。

col: polar opposites｜截然相反的人或事物
tip: polar指两极地区；polar opposites表示截然相反。

senses.en: a feeling of great pleasure or happiness
to give someone great pleasure
something or someone that gives great pleasure

ex.en: The professor explained delight with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了欣喜。

ex.en: Students who can explain delight usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
ex.zh: 能解释欣喜的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。

col: to someone's delight｜令某人高兴的是
delight in doing something｜乐于做某事
tip: delighted形容人感到高兴；delightful形容事物令人愉快。

senses.en: a state of not knowing what is true or will happen
something that is unknown or cannot be predicted

ex.en: Our professor circled economic uncertainty on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经济不确定性。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济不确定性的材料。

col: a period of uncertainty｜不确定的时期
uncertainty about the future｜对未来的不确定
tip: 泛指不确定状态通常不可数；具体未知因素可用复数。

senses.en: Used to express happiness, excitement, or approval.

ex.en: Our professor circled shout hurrah on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了高声欢呼。

ex.en: The reading connects shout hurrah with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把高声欢呼和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a final hurrah｜最后一次精彩表现
tip: 与hooray意思相同；常独立使用，后接感叹号。

senses.en: Naturally replaced and therefore available for continued use.
Able to be extended for another period of time.

ex.en: Our professor circled renewable energy on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可再生能源。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around renewable energy.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕可再生能源展开说明。

tip: 名词renewables用复数，指可再生能源。

senses.en: to turn around a central point or axis
to change positions or duties in a regular order

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to rotate clockwise.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须顺时针旋转。

ex.en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to rotate clockwise.
ex.zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们顺时针旋转。

tip: 既可及物也可不及物：rotate the wheel；the wheel rotates。

senses.en: Strong interest and excitement about something you enjoy or value.

ex.en: I copied generate enthusiasm into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把激发热情抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to generate enthusiasm when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了激发热情。

tip: 对某事的热情用enthusiasm for，通常不可数。

senses.en: A special chair used by a king or queen.
The position or power of a king or queen.

ex.en: I wrote throne on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把throne和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: A reading on historical change uses throne when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于历史变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了王座。

col: sit on a throne｜坐在王座上
heir to the throne｜王位继承人
tip: the throne可指王位，不一定指实体座椅。

senses.en: a disadvantage or negative aspect of something

ex.en: Our professor circled a potential downside on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了潜在的不利之处。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a potential downside.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得潜在的不利之处这个例子。

col: a potential downside｜潜在的不利之处
on the downside｜从不利方面看
tip: 常用the downside of/to sth，表示某事的弊端。

senses.en: To accompany someone to guide or protect them
A person or group accompanying someone for protection or guidance

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to escort someone to.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须陪同某人前往。

ex.en: The reading asks you to escort someone to and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你陪同某人前往，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: escort someone to｜陪同某人前往
a police escort｜警方护送人员
tip: 动词重音在后；名词英/ˈeskɔːt/，美/ˈeskɔːrt/。

senses.en: to send signals, information, or energy between places
to pass a disease from one living thing to another

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to transmit data.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何传输数据。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to transmit data.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来传输数据。

tip: 过去式transmitted，进行式transmitting，均双写t。

senses.en: the process of establishing who or what someone or something is
a document that proves who you are
a feeling of connection with another person or group

ex.en: Our professor circled proof of identification on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了身份证明。

ex.en: The reading connects proof of identification with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把身份证明和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示身份证明时通常不可数，可简称 ID。

senses.en: the act or process of moving
a formal proposal discussed and voted on at a meeting
to signal something using a movement of your hand or head

ex.en: After the lecture, we used motion in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了运动。

ex.en: Students who can explain motion usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 能解释运动的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。

tip: 动议可用pass或reject；in motion表示在运动中。

senses.en: Extremely foolish, unreasonable, or dangerous behaviour.
An old-fashioned term for severe mental illness.

ex.en: I copied absolute madness into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把完全是胡闹抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used absolute madness to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用完全是胡闹来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: a moment of madness｜一时冲动
tip: 指精神疾病的用法陈旧且可能冒犯，避免用于诊断。

senses.en: Not knowing or noticing that something exists or is happening.

ex.en: I copied completely unaware into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把完全不知情抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used completely unaware to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用完全不知情来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 常用be unaware of或be unaware that从句。

senses.en: Someone of similar age, status, or ability
To look carefully, especially when something is difficult to see
A person holding a British noble title

ex.en: I copied peer pressure into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把同伴压力抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of peer pressure.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得同伴压力这个例子。

tip: 名词常用复数peers；动词常接through、at或into。

senses.en: Action taken to protect someone or something from attack or harm.
An argument or explanation supporting someone accused or criticized.
Players or actions that stop opponents from scoring in sport.

ex.en: The textbook introduces self-defence in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了自卫。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around self-defence.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕自卫展开说明。

tip: 英式拼写 defence；美式拼写 defense。

senses.en: a straight line through a circle's centre joining opposite edges

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about internal diameter.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于内径的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of internal diameter.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得内径这个例子。

tip: 直径是diameter，半径是radius；尺寸后常接in diameter。

senses.en: Having a higher rank or more experience within an organisation.
Older than someone else, or relating to older people.
A final-year school or college student, or an older adult.

ex.en: I copied senior management into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把高级管理层抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used senior management to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用高级管理层来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: senior to someone｜级别高于某人
tip: 比较级别用senior to，不用senior than。

senses.en: Make a device, system, or process start working.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer activate an account during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时激活账户。

ex.en: The reading asks you to activate an account and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你激活账户，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 强调使设备或系统开始运作；反义词为deactivate。

senses.en: To regard something as caused or created by someone or something.
A quality or feature of a person or thing.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to attribute success to.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须把成功归因于。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to attribute success to.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们把成功归因于。

col: attribute success to｜把成功归因于
a key attribute｜一个关键特征
tip: attribute A to B指把A归因于B；名词重音在首音节。

senses.en: Designed to perform several different tasks.

ex.en: I copied a multifunction printer into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把多功能打印机抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a multifunction printer.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕多功能打印机展开说明。

col: a multifunction printer｜多功能打印机
a multifunction display｜多功能显示屏
tip: 作形容词，常放设备名词前；也可用multifunctional。

senses.en: To understand and care about someone's suffering or difficulties.
To agree with someone's ideas, aims, or position.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer sympathize with a cause during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时支持某项事业。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to sympathize with a cause.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来支持某项事业。

col: sympathize with a cause｜支持某项事业
tip: 不直接接宾语：用 sympathize with；英式也拼 sympathise。

senses.en: A nutrient needed for growth and repair of body tissues.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about high in protein.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于富含蛋白质的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around high in protein.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕富含蛋白质展开说明。

col: a source of protein｜蛋白质来源
tip: 作营养物质通常不可数；指不同种类时可数。

senses.en: Reasoning that connects ideas in a clear, consistent way.
The study of rules for reasoning correctly.

ex.en: Office hours began with sound logic.
ex.zh: 答疑从严密的逻辑开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sound logic.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论严密的逻辑的材料。

col: the logic behind something｜某事背后的逻辑
tip: 通常不可数；the logic behind表示背后的道理。

senses.en: Energy travelling through space or matter as waves or particles.
Medical treatment using radiation to destroy cancer cells.

ex.en: I copied ultraviolet radiation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把紫外线辐射抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects ultraviolet radiation with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把紫外线辐射和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: exposure to radiation｜受到辐射照射
tip: 通常不可数；辐射不只指核辐射，也包括阳光。

senses.en: Designed for a particular purpose or requiring specific expert knowledge.

ex.en: The textbook introduces highly specialised in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了高度专业化的。

ex.en: The reading connects highly specialised with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把高度专业化的和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 英式常用specialised，美式常用specialized。

senses.en: An evergreen tree with needles, or the wood it produces.
Long deeply for someone or something, sometimes becoming weak.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on pine forest.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论松林。

ex.en: The reading connects pine forest with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把松林和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: pine for someone｜苦苦思念某人
pine away｜因思念而日渐憔悴
tip: pine for表示渴望或思念；pine away指日渐憔悴。

senses.en: People, especially those belonging to a particular group.
Connected with the traditional culture of ordinary people.
Music rooted in the traditions of a community.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about local folk.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于当地人的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of local folk.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得当地人这个例子。

tip: 指人们时用复数动词；my folks口语指父母。

senses.en: Controlled behaviour achieved by following rules or managing yourself.
A particular field of study or knowledge.
To punish misconduct or train someone to follow rules.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about self-discipline.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于自律的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used self-discipline to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用自律来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: discipline yourself to do something｜约束自己做某事
tip: 表示纪律通常不可数；表示学科时可数。

senses.en: In a worried or nervous way.
With a strong desire for something to happen.

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to anxiously await.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习急切地等候。

ex.en: Students who anxiously await are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够急切地等候的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: 常含担忧色彩；纯粹高兴地期待多用eagerly。

senses.en: A line marking where one area ends and another begins
A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something

ex.en: I copied a national boundary into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把国界抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a national boundary.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得国界这个例子。

tip: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。

senses.en: Working independently for different clients rather than one employer
Independently, for different clients rather than one employer
To work independently, offering services to different clients

ex.en: The textbook introduces freelance writer in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了自由撰稿人。

ex.en: The reading connects freelance writer with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把自由撰稿人和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: work freelance中作副词；freelancer是自由职业者。

senses.en: The line where the sky seems to meet land or sea.
The limits of someone's knowledge, experience, or interests.

ex.en: I wrote horizon on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把horizon和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up horizon while discussing evidence about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于自然科学的证据时提到了地平线。

col: on the horizon｜在地平线上；即将发生
beyond the horizon｜在地平线之外
tip: 表示眼界通常用复数：broaden your horizons。

senses.en: A particular aspect of a situation, problem, or experience.
A measurement of something, such as its length or width.
An independent direction of measurement, such as length, width, or height.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a social dimension.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于社会层面的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects a social dimension with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把社会层面和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: add a new dimension｜增添新层面
tip: 表示长宽高等具体尺寸时，通常用复数dimensions。

senses.en: As a result of what has just been stated
In this way

ex.en: Thus, the lab report still needs a clearer definition.
ex.zh: 因此，实验报告仍然需要一个更清楚的定义。

ex.en: Thus, evidence from a single semester cannot support a policy for the whole college.
ex.zh: 因此，仅一个学期的证据不足以支持面向全院的政策。

col: thus reducing costs｜从而降低成本
tip: thus是副词，不能仅用逗号连接两个独立句。

senses.en: cloth made by weaving, knitting, or other fibre processing
relating to cloth or its production

ex.en: Office hours began with textile industry.
ex.zh: 答疑从纺织业开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss textile industry.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论纺织业的材料。

tip: 表示各类纺织品时常用复数textiles。

senses.en: A skilled person, especially a man, who makes things by hand.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a skilled craftsman in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了技艺娴熟的工匠。

ex.en: The reading connects a skilled craftsman with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把技艺娴熟的工匠和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a skilled craftsman｜技艺娴熟的工匠
tip: 复数为craftsmen；性别中性表达可用craftsperson。

senses.en: to release gas, heat, light, or sound

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to emit light.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须发光。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to emit light.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来发光。

col: emit greenhouse gases｜排放温室气体
tip: 过去式 emitted，进行式 emitting，均双写 t。

senses.en: annoyance caused by waiting, delays, or other people's behaviour
a strong desire for something to happen soon

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about growing impatience.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于日益强烈的焦躁的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects growing impatience with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把日益强烈的焦躁和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: impatience with delays｜对延误的不耐烦
tip: 通常不可数；对某人或事不耐烦常接with。

senses.en: produced without artificial fertilizers or most synthetic pesticides
relating to living things or carbon-based substances
developing gradually and naturally rather than through outside intervention

ex.en: Office hours began with organic food.
ex.zh: 答疑从有机食品开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around organic food.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕有机食品展开说明。

tip: 食品语境指有机生产；化学语境通常指含碳化合物。

senses.en: to decide something is not worth considering
to officially remove someone from their job
to tell someone or a group they may leave

ex.en: The lab instructions say to dismiss concerns.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求不理会担忧。

ex.en: The reading asks you to dismiss concerns and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你不理会担忧，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: dismiss someone from a job｜解雇某人
dismiss something as irrelevant｜认为某事无关而不予考虑
tip: dismiss A as B：认为A是B而不予考虑。

senses.en: The process of entering another country to live there.
The official checks or checkpoint for people entering a country.

ex.en: I copied immigration policy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把移民政策抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used immigration policy to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用移民政策来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: go through immigration｜接受入境检查
tip: immigration强调迁入；emigration强调迁出。

senses.en: a financial share or personal interest in something
a pointed post driven into the ground
to risk money or something valuable on an outcome

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a stake in.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论在……中的权益。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a stake in.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论在……中的权益的材料。

col: stake your reputation on｜以声誉赌……
tip: have a stake in指有利益关系；at stake指面临风险。

senses.en: A unit used to measure electrical potential difference

ex.en: I copied a twelve-volt battery into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把十二伏电池抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a twelve-volt battery.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得十二伏电池这个例子。

col: a voltage of five volts｜五伏电压
tip: 伏特衡量电压；瓦特 watt 衡量功率。

senses.en: a substance added to soil to help plants grow

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about chemical fertilizer.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于化肥的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used chemical fertilizer to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用化肥来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

tip: 英式也拼作fertiliser；泛指肥料时常不可数。

senses.en: The process of making written material available to the public.
A book, magazine, or other work made available to readers.

ex.en: Our professor circled academic publication on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了学术出版物。

ex.en: The author returns to academic publication when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了学术出版物。

col: publication of findings｜研究结果的发表
tip: 指出版行为时不可数；指具体出版物时可数。

senses.en: a feature that makes someone or something less effective
a lack of physical strength or energy
a strong liking that is difficult to resist

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about muscle weakness.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于肌肉无力的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects muscle weakness with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把肌肉无力和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a weakness for chocolate｜对巧克力的特别喜爱
tip: 弱点通常可数；虚弱不可数；偏爱用a weakness for。

senses.en: the sound of people clapping to show approval
strong approval or praise for someone or something

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a round of applause.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论一阵掌声。

ex.en: A campus survey used a round of applause to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用一阵掌声来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

col: a round of applause｜一阵掌声
burst into applause｜突然鼓起掌来
tip: 不可数；“一阵掌声”用 a round of applause。

senses.en: relating to European history from about AD 500 to 1500
