ex.en: The quiz had a short question about flour mill.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于面粉厂；磨坊的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss flour mill.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论面粉厂；磨坊的材料。

tip: mill多指加工原料的工厂；普通工厂常用factory。

senses.en: So great or strong that little can oppose it
Too intense or difficult to deal with

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on overwhelming majority.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论绝大多数。

ex.en: The author returns to overwhelming majority when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了绝大多数。

tip: 强调程度极大；既可形容支持，也可形容压力。

senses.en: A senior government official responsible for a particular area.
A religious leader in certain Christian churches.
To care for someone or attend to their needs.

ex.en: I copied education minister into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把教育部长抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects education minister with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把教育部长和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: minister to someone's needs｜照顾某人的需要
tip: 动词义较正式，常用minister to表示照料。

senses.en: To officially forbid an action through rules or laws.
To prevent something by making it impossible or impractical.

ex.en: The assignment is to prohibit the use of, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先禁止使用，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to prohibit the use of.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们禁止使用。

col: prohibit someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事
prohibit the use of｜禁止使用
tip: 用prohibit doing或prohibit sb from doing。

senses.en: a soft sea animal with hanging tentacles that can sting

ex.en: Our professor circled a swarm of jellyfish on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了一大群水母。

ex.en: The author returns to a swarm of jellyfish when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一大群水母。

col: a swarm of jellyfish｜一大群水母
tip: 复数通常仍用 jellyfish；它不是鱼类。

senses.en: An extraordinary event that seems impossible or beyond natural explanation.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a medical miracle.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论医学奇迹。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a medical miracle.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕医学奇迹展开说明。

tip: work miracles指创造奇迹，也可夸张表示效果惊人。

senses.en: to start an organisation, system, or lasting arrangement
to make a position or reputation widely accepted
to discover or prove that something is true

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to establish a business.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须创办企业。

ex.en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers establish a business before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要创办企业。

tip: establish是及物动词，后接机构、制度或事实等。

senses.en: Standards used to judge something or make a decision.

ex.en: Office hours began with selection criteria.
ex.zh: 答疑从筛选标准开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of selection criteria.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得筛选标准这个例子。

tip: criteria是复数，单数为criterion；用criteria are。

senses.en: To communicate or do things with other people.
To affect one another when combined or brought together.

ex.en: The assignment is to interact with, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先与……互动，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to interact with.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们与……互动。

col: interact with each other｜相互交流
tip: 不及物动词：与某人互动用interact with someone。

senses.en: believing certain actions or objects bring good or bad luck

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on superstitious beliefs.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论迷信观念。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of superstitious beliefs.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得迷信观念这个例子。

tip: 常用be superstitious about表示对某事迷信。

senses.en: A national body of representatives that makes laws.
A large formal meeting of representatives or specialists.

ex.en: Office hours began with a national congress.
ex.zh: 答疑从全国代表大会开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a national congress with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把全国代表大会和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a national congress｜全国代表大会
a member of Congress｜国会议员
tip: 特指美国等国家的国会时，通常大写Congress。

senses.en: sudden strong fear that makes clear thinking difficult
to feel or cause sudden fear and lose calm

ex.en: I copied panic attack into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把惊恐发作抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss panic attack.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论惊恐发作的材料。

tip: 过去式panicked、进行式panicking均须在c后加k。

senses.en: Very bad, intense, or damaging.
Very strict or harsh in treatment or judgment.

ex.en: Office hours began with severe pain.
ex.zh: 答疑从剧痛开始。

ex.en: The author returns to severe pain when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了剧痛。

tip: 可修饰疼痛、天气、短缺或惩罚，表示程度重。

senses.en: The purpose or job of something or someone.
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: Our professor circled basic function on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了基本功能。

ex.en: A campus survey used basic function to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用基本功能来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

senses.en: Probably true, based on what is known or reasonably expected.

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to presumably because.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习大概是因为。

ex.en: Students who presumably because are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够大概是因为的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: 表示有依据的推测，不等于certainly的确定语气。

senses.en: Organising people or activities so they work effectively together
The ability to move different body parts smoothly together

ex.en: Our professor circled hand-eye coordination on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了手眼协调能力。

ex.en: The author returns to hand-eye coordination when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了手眼协调能力。

col: coordination between departments｜部门之间的协调
tip: 通常不可数；between引出需要协调的双方或多方。

senses.en: to cause a person or organism to develop an infection
to spread a feeling or attitude to others

ex.en: I heard the lecturer infect a wound during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时使伤口感染。

ex.en: A lecture on public health showed why researchers infect a wound before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共卫生的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要使伤口感染。

col: infect someone with a virus｜使某人感染病毒
tip: 常用infect someone with a virus，表示使某人感染病毒。

senses.en: deeply loved by someone or many people
a person whom someone loves deeply

ex.en: The textbook introduces a beloved friend in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了挚爱的朋友。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a beloved friend.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕挚爱的朋友展开说明。

col: a beloved institution｜深受喜爱的机构
tip: 通常作形容词；作名词指爱人，语气较文学化。

senses.en: The work or skill of making and repairing wooden structures.

ex.en: The textbook introduces basic carpentry in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了基础木工。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around basic carpentry.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕基础木工展开说明。

tip: carpentry指技艺或工作；carpenter指木匠。

senses.en: Unlikely to work well or be useful in practice
Not skilled at handling everyday practical tasks

ex.en: Office hours began with highly impractical.
ex.zh: 答疑从极不实用的开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of highly impractical.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得极不实用的这个例子。

col: an impractical solution｜不切实际的解决办法
impractical for everyday use｜不适合日常使用
tip: 是形容词，不是动词；不实用不一定是不可能。

senses.en: relating to machines or their moving parts
done without thought, interest, or feeling

ex.en: Office hours began with mechanical engineering.
ex.zh: 答疑从机械工程开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used mechanical engineering to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用机械工程来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

col: a mechanical response｜机械式的回应
tip: mechanical指机器相关；mechanic指机械修理工。

senses.en: A substance formed from chemically joined elements.

senses.zh: 围墙内的场地或建筑群
senses.en: An enclosed area containing buildings.
To make an existing problem or difficulty worse.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on chemical compound.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论化合物。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss chemical compound.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论化合物的材料。

tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: To take someone away illegally and hold them captive

ex.en: The assignment is to kidnap someone for ransom, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先绑架某人索取赎金，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to kidnap someone for ransom and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你绑架某人索取赎金，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: kidnap someone for ransom｜绑架某人索取赎金
tip: 不限于儿童；常用过去式kidnapped，分词kidnapping。

senses.en: relating to the rules for forming words and sentences
following the accepted grammar rules of a language

ex.en: The textbook introduces grammatical accuracy in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了语法准确性。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of grammatical accuracy.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得语法准确性这个例子。

tip: 可指“语法方面的”，也可指句子“符合语法的”。

senses.en: goods available for sale
to promote goods and encourage people to buy them

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sell merchandise.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论销售商品。

ex.en: A campus survey used sell merchandise to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用销售商品来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 名词不可数；动词词尾常读作/daɪz/。

senses.en: Safe or suitable to eat.

ex.en: Office hours began with edible plants.
ex.zh: 答疑从可食用植物开始。

ex.en: The reading connects edible plants with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可食用植物和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: edible表示能吃，不表示美味；勿凭外观判断野生植物。

senses.en: Prevent an activity or system from continuing normally.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to disrupt traffic.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求扰乱交通。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to disrupt traffic.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来扰乱交通。

tip: 及物动词，直接接活动或系统；不是形容词。

senses.en: A particular example or occurrence of something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an isolated instance.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论个别事例。

ex.en: The reading connects an isolated instance with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把个别事例和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: in this instance｜在这种情况下
tip: for instance意为“例如”，作用类似for example。

senses.en: At risk of harm, loss, or extinction.
Feeling that someone or something may cause harm or loss.

ex.en: The textbook introduces threatened species in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了受威胁物种。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of threatened species.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得受威胁物种这个例子。

col: threatened with extinction｜面临灭绝威胁
tip: threatened指受到威胁；threatening指构成威胁。

senses.en: Make a long, loud cry or a similar rushing sound.
A long, loud cry expressing pain, anger, or another strong feeling.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to howl at the moon.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须对月长嚎。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers howl at the moon before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要对月长嚎。

col: howl at the moon｜对月长嚎
howls of protest｜愤怒的抗议声
tip: 既用于动物长嚎，也用于风声或人的强烈反应。

senses.en: Most important among several things.
Having the highest rank in an organisation or profession.
The person who leads a group or organisation.

ex.en: The textbook introduces police chief in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了警察局长。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of police chief.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得警察局长这个例子。

tip: chief可作形容词或名词；副词用chiefly。

senses.en: Through another person, thing, or stage rather than directly
Without expressing something clearly or openly

ex.en: The professor told us to indirectly affect and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们间接影响，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: Students who indirectly affect are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够间接影响的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

col: indirectly responsible for｜对……负有间接责任
directly or indirectly｜直接或间接地
tip: 是副词，不是形容词；修饰动词时用indirectly。

senses.en: made or caused by people rather than occurring naturally

ex.en: After the lecture, we used man-made in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了人造的。

ex.en: A reading on environmental policy uses man-made when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于环境政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了人造的。

tip: 强调由人制造或造成；也可用human-made。

senses.en: Completely unreasonable or silly.

ex.en: I copied completely absurd into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把完全荒谬的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used completely absurd to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用完全荒谬的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 常用句式：It is absurd to do sth.。

senses.en: a period of rapid growth or economic success
a loud, deep sound
to grow rapidly or make a loud, deep sound

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on economic boom.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济繁荣。

ex.en: A campus survey used economic boom to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用经济繁荣来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: a boom in tourism｜旅游业的迅猛发展
a booming industry｜蓬勃发展的行业
tip: 表示某领域的迅速增长，常用a boom in。

senses.en: The movement of people to live in another place.
The regular movement of animals between regions, often with the seasons.
The transfer of data or software to another computer system.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about rural-to-urban migration.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于农村向城市的人口迁移的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to rural-to-urban migration when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了农村向城市的人口迁移。

col: rural-to-urban migration｜农村向城市的人口迁移
tip: migration泛指迁移；immigration侧重迁入。

senses.en: Related to volcanoes or produced by their activity.
Sudden and extremely powerful, especially when describing anger.

ex.en: I copied volcanic eruption into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把火山喷发抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss volcanic eruption.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论火山喷发的材料。

tip: 通常作形容词；“火山岩”用volcanic rock。

senses.en: Using measurement units such as metres, litres, and grams.
A measurement used to judge performance, quality, or progress.

ex.en: Our professor circled performance metric on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了绩效指标。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss performance metric.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论绩效指标的材料。

tip: 形容词指公制的；名词指指标，常用复数。

senses.en: having excessive body fat that may harm health

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about clinically obese.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于临床诊断为肥胖的的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects clinically obese with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把临床诊断为肥胖的和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: clinically obese｜临床诊断为肥胖的
tip: 属医学用语，程度通常重于overweight；避免随意评价他人。

senses.en: A small mammal with spines that curls into a ball.

ex.en: I copied a baby hedgehog into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把刺猬幼崽抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of a baby hedgehog.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得刺猬幼崽这个例子。

tip: hedgehog是刺猬；porcupine是豪猪，两者不是同一种动物。

senses.en: A short written message, especially between people at work.

ex.en: I copied internal memo into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把内部通知抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to internal memo when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了内部通知。

col: a memo about something｜关于某事的备忘录
tip: memo常指工作中的简短内部通知，复数为memos。

senses.en: A feeling of worry about something important

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项
senses.en: An issue that matters or causes worry
To relate to someone or something, or cause worry

ex.en: Office hours began with a major concern.
ex.zh: 答疑从一个主要问题开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a major concern when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了一个主要问题。

col: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧
a major concern｜一个主要问题
concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

senses.en: to examine something carefully to understand its parts or causes

ex.en: The assignment is to analyse data, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先分析数据，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers analyse data before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要分析数据。

tip: 英式拼写analyse，美式通常写analyze。

senses.en: relating to technology and its practical development

ex.en: I copied technological advances into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把科技进步抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to technological advances when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了科技进步。

tip: technological侧重科技发展，technical侧重具体技术。

senses.en: The way or amount that something is used.
The customary way words or phrases are used in language.

ex.en: The textbook introduces energy usage in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了能源使用量。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around energy usage.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕能源使用量展开说明。

tip: usage重在使用量、使用方式或语言惯用法。

senses.en: required by a law or rule, rather than optional

ex.en: Office hours began with compulsory education.
ex.zh: 答疑从义务教育开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around compulsory education.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕义务教育展开说明。

tip: compulsory强调规定必须做，与optional相对。

senses.en: communication channels that deliver information to very large audiences

ex.en: The professor explained mass media with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了大众传媒。

ex.en: Students who can explain mass media usually follow the rest of a lecture on public communication.
ex.zh: 能解释大众传媒的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共传播的讲座。

col: mass media coverage｜大众媒体报道
mass media influence｜大众传媒的影响
tip: 泛指大众传媒常用the mass media，通常接复数谓语。

senses.en: a tiny electronic component containing many connected circuits
a small broken piece or the mark it leaves
to break a small piece off something

ex.en: Our professor circled computer chip on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了计算机芯片。

ex.en: A campus survey used computer chip to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用计算机芯片来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

col: a chip in a cup｜杯子上的缺口
chip a tooth｜磕掉一小块牙齿
tip: 食物中的chips：英式指薯条，美式通常指薯片。

senses.en: Connected with a religion and treated with deep respect

ex.en: Our professor circled holy place on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了圣地。

ex.en: A campus survey used holy place to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用圣地来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: holy强调宗教上的神圣，与wholly发音相同。

senses.en: an uncomfortable feeling caused by awkwardness or fear of others' judgment
a person or thing that causes shame or awkwardness

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about blush with embarrassment.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于尴尬得脸红的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around blush with embarrassment.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕尴尬得脸红展开说明。

col: to my embarrassment｜令我尴尬的是
a source of embarrassment｜令人尴尬的根源
tip: 情绪义不可数；指令人尴尬的人或事时可数。

senses.en: the process of giving or delivering things to different people
the way something is spread across an area or group

ex.en: The textbook introduces population distribution in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了人口分布。

ex.en: A campus survey used population distribution to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用人口分布来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 既指分发过程，也指人口等的分布状态。

senses.en: a group that decides facts in a court case
a group that judges entries in a competition

ex.en: I copied jury verdict into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把陪审团裁决抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects jury verdict with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把陪审团裁决和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: serve on a jury｜担任陪审员
tip: jury指整个陪审团；单个陪审员叫juror。

senses.en: Difficult in a way that tests skills or determination.
Expressing doubt or inviting disagreement or competition.

ex.en: Office hours began with intellectually challenging.
ex.zh: 答疑从考验智力的开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used intellectually challenging to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用考验智力的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 形容任务有难度用challenging，不用challenged。

senses.en: to shine with small, bright flashes of light
bright flashes of light, or a lively, exciting quality

ex.en: The lab instructions say to sparkle in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求在阳光下闪耀。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to sparkle in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得在阳光下闪耀。

col: sparkle in the sunlight｜在阳光下闪耀
tip: sparkle强调点点闪光；shine泛指发光。

senses.en: to willingly accept an idea, change, or opportunity
to hold someone closely in your arms
an act of holding someone closely in your arms

ex.en: The professor asked us to embrace change.
ex.zh: 教授让我们欣然接受变化。

ex.en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers embrace change before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要欣然接受变化。

col: embrace an opportunity｜欣然把握机会
tip: 表示接受时，常接change、idea等抽象名词。

senses.en: In addition, introducing another point supporting what was said

ex.en: Furthermore, the class checked the chart a second time.
ex.zh: 此外，全班又核对了一次图表。

ex.en: Furthermore, readers should separate what the passage proves from what it only suggests.
ex.zh: 此外，读者应当区分文章证明了什么，又仅仅暗示了什么。

col: furthermore, it is important｜此外，重要的是
furthermore, evidence suggests｜此外，证据表明
tip: 正式递进副词；连接完整句时，前面用句号或分号。

senses.en: a meeting or explanation giving essential information or instructions

ex.en: Our professor circled safety briefing on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了安全说明会。

ex.en: A campus survey used safety briefing to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用安全说明会来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 不只是书面简报，也常指口头说明或简报会。

senses.en: Containing many things packed closely together
Difficult to understand because information is tightly packed
Slow to understand things

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on dense fog.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论浓雾。

ex.en: The reading connects dense fog with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把浓雾和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 形容人愚钝时有冒犯意味；密集地用densely。

senses.en: Large in amount or importance.

ex.en: There was a substantial gap between the two groups.
ex.zh: 两组之间有很大的差距。

ex.en: The lecture called the improvement substantial, not merely statistically detectable.
ex.zh: 讲座称这一改进是实质性的，而不只是统计上能检测出来。

tip: 不要和 substantive（实质的、有内容的）混淆。

senses.en: Unable to protect yourself or change a difficult situation

ex.en: The textbook introduces a helpless victim in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了无助的受害者。

ex.en: A campus survey used a helpless victim to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用无助的受害者来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: a helpless victim｜无助的受害者
tip: helpless是无助的；unhelpful是不肯帮忙或无用的。

senses.en: Certain to happen and impossible to prevent

ex.en: The textbook introduces almost inevitable in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了几乎不可避免的。

ex.en: The reading connects almost inevitable with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把几乎不可避免的和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常用it is inevitable that…表示“……不可避免”。

senses.en: a social group sharing ancestry, traditions, and community ties

ex.en: Our professor circled a nomadic tribe on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了游牧部落。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a nomadic tribe.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕游牧部落展开说明。

col: members of a tribe｜部落成员
tip: 指特定社群时，宜尊重其自称，避免泛称。

senses.en: Draw attention to something important or especially noticeable.

senses.zh: 最精彩或最重要的部分
senses.en: The best or most memorable part of an experience.
Mark words with bright colour to make them noticeable.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer highlight a problem during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时突出一个问题。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to highlight a problem.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来突出一个问题。

col: highlight a problem｜突出一个问题
highlight the importance of｜强调……的重要性
the highlight of the trip｜旅途中最精彩的部分
tip: 作动词直接接宾语：highlight the problem。

senses.en: Willing to take risks or act with confidence.
Strong and easily noticed in colour, shape, or design.
Printed with thicker, darker lines than ordinary type.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about bold decision.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于大胆的决定的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around bold decision.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大胆的决定展开说明。

tip: in bold表示“用粗体”，常用于排版说明。

senses.en: The likelihood that something will happen.
The ratio determining how much a successful bet pays.

ex.en: Office hours began with against all odds.
ex.zh: 答疑从尽管困难重重开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around against all odds.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕尽管困难重重展开说明。

col: the odds of success｜成功的可能性
against all odds｜尽管困难重重
improve the odds｜提高成功机会
tip: odds用复数形式，常接of或that从句。

senses.en: the act of working together towards a shared goal
willingness to help or do what someone requests

ex.en: Office hours began with international cooperation.
ex.zh: 答疑从国际合作开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of international cooperation.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得国际合作这个例子。

tip: 通常不可数；与……合作用in cooperation with。

senses.en: a small part or amount of something
a mathematical quantity representing part of a whole

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a small fraction.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论很小一部分。

ex.en: A campus survey used a small fraction to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用很小一部分来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: a fraction of a second｜极短的一瞬
tip: a fraction of常强调占比极小，不只是一般部分。

senses.en: the ability to change or adapt to different needs
the ability to bend or stretch easily

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about greater flexibility.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于更大的灵活性的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects greater flexibility with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把更大的灵活性和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: flexibility in working hours｜工作时间的灵活性
tip: 既可指安排可变通，也可指身体或材料的柔韧性。

senses.en: express disapproval of someone or something

ex.en: The professor asked us to criticize someone for something.
ex.zh: 教授让我们因某事批评某人。

ex.en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers criticize someone for something before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要因某事批评某人。

col: criticize someone for something｜因某事批评某人
tip: criticize sb for sth；英式也常拼作criticise。

senses.en: The act or state of finishing something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces near completion in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了接近完工。

ex.en: The author returns to near completion when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了接近完工。

tip: 常用on completion of表示“在……完成时”。

senses.en: words or ideas that are absurd or have no meaning
silly or unacceptable behaviour

ex.en: I copied talk nonsense into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把胡说八道抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around talk nonsense.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕胡说八道展开说明。

col: a load of nonsense｜一堆废话
put up with nonsense｜容忍胡闹
tip: 通常不可数；说一派胡言可用 complete nonsense。

senses.en: A school providing training in a particular subject or skill.
An organization promoting scholarship, science, or the arts.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a music academy in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了音乐学院。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a music academy.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论音乐学院的材料。

tip: 常指专业培训院校或学术机构，不一定是大学。

senses.en: To judge an approximate amount, value, or size.
An approximate calculation of an amount, value, or cost.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to estimate the cost.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何估算费用。

ex.en: The reading asks you to estimate the cost and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你估算费用，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 动词末尾读/eɪt/；名词末尾读/ət/。

senses.en: Someone who judges and discusses artistic works professionally.
Someone who expresses disapproval of a person, policy, or idea.

ex.en: Office hours began with film critic.
ex.zh: 答疑从影评人开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss film critic.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论影评人的材料。

col: an outspoken critic｜直言不讳的批评者
tip: critic指人，criticism指批评或评论。

senses.en: important or unusual enough to deserve attention
a famous or important person, especially in a particular community

ex.en: Office hours began with a notable achievement.
ex.zh: 答疑从显著成就开始。

ex.en: The reading connects a notable achievement with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把显著成就和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a notable exception｜值得注意的例外
tip: notable for表示因……而出名或引人注意。

senses.en: a yellow chemical element used in industry and agriculture

ex.en: Our professor circled sulphur dioxide on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了二氧化硫。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sulphur dioxide.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论二氧化硫的材料。

tip: sulphur是传统英式拼写；科学文献常用sulfur。

senses.en: Accept responsibility for a task and begin doing it
Promise to do something

ex.en: I heard the lecturer undertake research during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时开展研究。

ex.en: The reading asks you to undertake research and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你开展研究，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: undertake to do something｜承诺做某事
tip: 过去式undertook，过去分词undertaken。

senses.en: to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen
an opening in a floor, ceiling, or wall
to develop a plan, often secretly

ex.en: The assignment is to hatch an egg, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先孵蛋，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to hatch an egg.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得孵蛋。

tip: 表示孵化用动词；名词常指舱口或小开口。

senses.en: To move to another country to live there permanently.

ex.en: The professor asked us to immigrate to a country.
ex.zh: 教授让我们移居某国。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to immigrate to a country.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们移居某国。

col: immigrate to a country｜移居某国
tip: immigrate to强调移入；emigrate from强调移出。

senses.en: to make the short, loud sound of a dog
a short, loud sound made by a dog
the outer protective layer of a tree trunk or branch

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to bark at someone.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何冲某人吠叫。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to bark at someone.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来冲某人吠叫。

col: a loud bark｜一声响亮的狗叫
tip: 狗叫声可数；树皮通常不可数。

senses.en: The clearing of forests by cutting down trees.

ex.en: Office hours began with prevent deforestation.
ex.zh: 答疑从防止毁林开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of prevent deforestation.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得防止毁林这个例子。

tip: 不可数名词；常用于栖息地丧失和气候变化话题。

senses.en: Someone employed to help people in a public place.
Occurring together with something, often as a consequence.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on flight attendant.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论航空乘务员。

ex.en: A campus survey used flight attendant to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用航空乘务员来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: car park attendant｜停车场管理员
tip: attendant常指服务人员；参会者通常用attendee。

senses.en: deep sadness caused by loss or disappointment

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on deep sorrow.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论深切的悲痛。

ex.en: The reading connects deep sorrow with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把深切的悲痛和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示悲伤情绪通常不可数；具体伤心事可数。

senses.en: to prevent a device or feature from working
to cause a condition that limits someone's activities

ex.en: The lab instructions say to disable notifications.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求禁用通知。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to disable notifications.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得禁用通知。

col: disable location tracking｜禁用位置追踪
tip: 技术语境常指“禁用”，不表示删除或损坏。

senses.en: to remember something from the past
to order someone back or request the return of products
the ability to remember, or an official request for returns

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to recall a detail.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何回想起一个细节。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to recall a detail.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得回想起一个细节。

col: recall a detail｜回想起一个细节
recall doing something｜记得做过某事
tip: 表示记得做过某事用 recall doing，不用 to do。

senses.en: Extremely beautiful, grand, or impressive.
Exceptionally good or skilfully done.

ex.en: Our professor circled magnificent scenery on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了壮丽的景色。

ex.en: The author returns to magnificent scenery when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了壮丽的景色。

tip: 多形容景色、建筑或成就，不表示品德高尚。

senses.en: A feeling of gratitude for someone's help or kindness.
Recognition and understanding of something's value, quality, or importance.
An increase in the financial value of something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on currency appreciation.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论货币升值。

ex.en: The reading connects currency appreciation with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把货币升值和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an appreciation of art｜对艺术的欣赏
tip: 通常不可数；an appreciation of可指对某事的理解。

senses.en: a heavy load, difficult duty, or source of worry
to give someone a heavy responsibility or worry

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial burden.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济负担。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of financial burden.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得经济负担这个例子。

col: be burdened with debt｜背负债务
tip: 负担落在某人身上用a burden on someone。

senses.en: To shake rapidly with small movements, or cause this movement.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to vibrate gently.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何轻轻振动。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to vibrate gently.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来轻轻振动。

tip: 指快速、小幅度振动，不等于大幅摇摆。

senses.en: A boy or young man, especially in informal British English.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a young lad.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小伙子。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a young lad.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论小伙子的材料。

col: a teenage lad｜十几岁的男孩
tip: 偏英式口语；正式写作宜用boy或young man。

senses.en: a condition that disrupts normal physical or mental functioning
a state in which things are not properly arranged
uncontrolled public behaviour that disturbs peace or safety

ex.en: I copied sleep disorder into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把睡眠障碍抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects sleep disorder with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把睡眠障碍和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 疾病义可数；杂乱或骚乱义通常不可数。

senses.en: to move to another region, seasonally or to live there
to move data or software to a different computer system

ex.en: The professor asked us to migrate south.
ex.zh: 教授让我们向南迁徙。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to migrate south.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来向南迁徙。

tip: migrate强调迁移；immigrate移入，emigrate移出。

senses.en: relating to collective ownership and more equal distribution of wealth
someone who supports socialism

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about socialist policies.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于社会主义政策的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects socialist policies with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把社会主义政策和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: socialist指社会主义的；social仅指社会的或社交的。

senses.en: A large sea animal with a hard shell and claws.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on lobster fishing.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论龙虾捕捞。

ex.en: A campus survey used lobster fishing to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用龙虾捕捞来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 指动物时可数；指作为食物的虾肉时不可数。

senses.en: A particular part of an economy or area of activity.
A particular section of a larger area.
A circle's part enclosed by two radii and an arc.

ex.en: Our professor circled the public sector on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公共部门。

ex.en: The author returns to the public sector when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公共部门。

tip: sector常指经济中的某个行业，不一定是公司部门。

senses.en: the act or ceremony of placing a dead body underground

ex.en: Our professor circled burial site on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了墓葬遗址。

ex.en: The author returns to burial site when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了墓葬遗址。

tip: burial重在入土安葬；funeral泛指葬礼仪式。

senses.en: a unit used to measure power

ex.en: Office hours began with a ten-watt bulb.
ex.zh: 答疑从十瓦灯泡开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a ten-watt bulb.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕十瓦灯泡展开说明。

col: power in watts｜以瓦特表示的功率
rated at fifty watts｜额定功率为五十瓦
tip: 瓦特衡量功率；千瓦时衡量用电量。

senses.en: limited in amount, range, or freedom
available or open only to people with permission

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on restricted access.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论受限的使用权限。

ex.en: The reading connects restricted access with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把受限的使用权限和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a restricted area｜限制进入的区域
tip: restricted to表示“仅限于”；也是restrict过去分词。

senses.en: Something that takes your attention away from your main activity
The state of being unable to give something full attention
An activity that helps you forget worries or boredom

ex.en: I copied a welcome distraction into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把令人愉快的消遣抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a welcome distraction when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了令人愉快的消遣。

col: a welcome distraction｜令人愉快的消遣
tip: 具体干扰物可数；表示分心状态时通常不可数。

senses.en: Stealing from a person or place using force or threats.

ex.en: Office hours began with armed robbery.
ex.zh: 答疑从持械抢劫开始。

ex.en: The reading connects armed robbery with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把持械抢劫和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: robbery涉及暴力或威胁；theft泛指盗窃。

senses.en: A ridge of rock or coral near the sea's surface.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on coral reef.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论珊瑚礁。

ex.en: The reading connects coral reef with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把珊瑚礁和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: reef指接近海面的礁体，不是海边的悬崖cliff。

senses.en: laugh in a light, often nervous or silly way
a light laugh caused by amusement or nervousness

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to giggle at a joke.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何听到笑话咯咯笑。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers giggle at a joke before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要听到笑话咯咯笑。

col: giggle at a joke｜听到笑话咯咯笑
tip: 强调轻轻咯咯笑，可因好玩或紧张；笑某事用at。

senses.en: a serious disagreement between people or groups
to question whether something is true or correct
to argue about something or compete to control it

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a dispute over pay.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论薪酬争议。

ex.en: The reading connects a dispute over pay with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把薪酬争议和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a dispute over pay｜薪酬争议
dispute a claim｜质疑某项说法
tip: dispute a claim是质疑说法，不是讨论说法。

senses.en: A state of not understanding something clearly
A situation where things are mixed up or poorly organised

ex.en: Office hours began with clear up confusion.
ex.zh: 答疑从消除困惑开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of clear up confusion.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得消除困惑这个例子。

tip: 人感到困惑用confused；事物令人困惑用confusing。

senses.en: Relating to factories and the production of goods.

ex.en: I copied industrial production into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把工业生产抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects industrial production with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把工业生产和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: industrial指工业的；industrious才指勤劳的。

senses.en: an established series of actions for completing a task
a medical action performed to diagnose or treat a condition

ex.en: The textbook introduces standard procedure in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了标准程序。

ex.en: A campus survey used standard procedure to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用标准程序来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: procedure 强调规定步骤；process 更侧重整个过程。

senses.en: To manage a difficult situation successfully.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer cope with stress during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时应对压力。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cope with stress.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得应对压力。

tip: cope是不及物动词，接困难或压力时用with。

senses.en: advice about the best thing to do
a statement supporting someone's or something's suitability or quality

ex.en: Our professor circled letter of recommendation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了推荐信。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around letter of recommendation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕推荐信展开说明。

tip: recommendation后的that从句常用should或动词原形。

senses.en: the ability to understand quickly or find effective, inventive solutions

ex.en: Office hours began with remarkable cleverness.
ex.zh: 答疑从非凡的才智开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss remarkable cleverness.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论非凡的才智的材料。

col: the cleverness of a design｜设计的巧妙
tip: 不可数名词；既可指人的聪明，也可指设计巧妙。

senses.en: find something's origin or location by following evidence
a small sign, mark, or amount left behind
copy a picture by drawing over its lines

ex.en: The professor asked us to trace the source.
ex.zh: 教授让我们追查来源。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to trace the source.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来追查来源。

tip: trace A back to B表示“追溯A至B”。

senses.en: A substance such as sugar or starch that provides energy.

ex.en: Office hours began with carbohydrate intake.
ex.zh: 答疑从碳水化合物摄入量开始。

ex.en: The reading connects carbohydrate intake with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把碳水化合物摄入量和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: carbohydrate intake｜碳水化合物摄入量
low-carbohydrate diet｜低碳水化合物饮食
tip: 泛指营养成分可不可数；谈种类或总称常用复数。

senses.en: Having the training and ability to do something well.
Requiring special training or practical ability.

ex.en: I copied highly skilled into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把技艺高超的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects highly skilled with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把技艺高超的和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: skilled at/in后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: not available in large enough amounts to meet demand

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on increasingly scarce.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论日益稀缺。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around increasingly scarce.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕日益稀缺展开说明。

tip: scarce指供应不足；rare强调少见，不一定短缺。

senses.en: Clap your hands to show enjoyment or approval.
Express strong approval of someone or something.

ex.en: The assignment is to applaud a performance, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先为表演鼓掌，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to applaud a performance.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来为表演鼓掌。

col: applaud someone's efforts｜称赞某人的努力
tip: 可直接接人或事；applause是不可数名词。

senses.en: tiny water drops in the air that reduce visibility
to become or make something covered with tiny water drops

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on thick mist.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论浓雾。

ex.en: A campus survey used thick mist to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用浓雾来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: mist通常比fog稀薄；玻璃起雾可说mist over。

senses.en: a place's angular distance east or west of the prime meridian

ex.en: Our professor circled latitude and longitude on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了纬度和经度。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around latitude and longitude.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕纬度和经度展开说明。

tip: longitude是经度，分东西；latitude是纬度，分南北。

senses.en: Something you aim to achieve.
Based on facts rather than personal feelings or opinions.

ex.en: Our professor circled primary objective on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了首要目标。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of primary objective.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得首要目标这个例子。

tip: 名词指目标；形容词指客观的，反义词为subjective。

senses.en: A room where goods are displayed for customers to examine.

ex.en: Office hours began with furniture showroom.
ex.zh: 答疑从家具展厅开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used furniture showroom to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用家具展厅来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 可数名词；showrooming指先在实体店看货再网购。

senses.en: a mass of earth and rocks sliding down a slope
an election victory by a very large margin

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on landslide risk.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论滑坡风险。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of landslide risk.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得滑坡风险这个例子。

col: trigger a landslide｜引发山体滑坡
win by a landslide｜以压倒性优势获胜
tip: 政治语境中常指选举中的压倒性胜利。

senses.en: a business that provides goods or professional services
solid and not easily moved or pressed out of shape
unlikely to change a decision or allow rules to be broken

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a law firm.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论律师事务所。

ex.en: The reading connects a law firm with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把律师事务所和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: take a firm stand｜采取坚定立场
tip: 作名词指公司；作形容词可指物体结实或态度坚定。

senses.en: to obtain something by paying money for it
the act of buying something, or the thing bought

ex.en: The assignment is to purchase goods, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先购买商品，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to purchase goods.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来购买商品。

tip: purchase比buy正式；名词可指购买行为或买到的东西。

senses.en: to get rid of something, used with of
to make someone likely or willing to do something

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to dispose of waste.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何处理废物。

ex.en: A lecture on environmental policy showed why researchers dispose of waste before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于环境政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要处理废物。

col: dispose of unwanted items｜处理不需要的物品
be disposed to agree｜倾向于同意
tip: 表示丢弃必须用dispose of，不能直接接物品。

senses.en: The space something occupies, or the total amount of something.
The level of loudness of a sound.
A book, especially one belonging to a larger set.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a companion volume in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了配套的一卷。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a companion volume.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论配套的一卷的材料。

col: a high volume of traffic｜很大的交通流量
turn down the volume｜调低音量
tip: volume可指体积、总量或音量；面积用area。

senses.en: a situation in which someone is not present
a situation in which something does not exist or occur

ex.en: Our professor circled absence from work on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了缺勤。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss absence from work.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论缺勤的材料。

col: in someone's absence｜在某人不在时
in the absence of｜在缺乏……的情况下
tip: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

senses.en: requiring a large amount of money
causing serious loss, harm or disadvantage

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on prove costly.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论结果代价高昂。

ex.en: The reading connects prove costly with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把结果代价高昂和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a costly mistake｜代价高昂的错误
tip: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；也可指损失惨重。

senses.en: Friendly and generous towards guests or visitors.
Providing suitable conditions for people, animals, or plants to live.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a hospitable host.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于热情好客的主人的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to a hospitable host when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了热情好客的主人。

col: a hospitable host｜热情好客的主人
hospitable to visitors｜热情接待访客
a hospitable environment｜适宜生存的环境
tip: 形容人时指好客；形容环境时指适宜生存。

senses.en: not wanting to learn about or take part in something

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on uninterested in politics.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论对政治不感兴趣。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around uninterested in politics.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕对政治不感兴趣展开说明。

col: uninterested in politics｜对政治不感兴趣
tip: 接in；勿与表示“公正无私”的disinterested混淆。

senses.en: move repeatedly from side to side
a movement from side to side
someone who often makes clever or amusing remarks

ex.en: The professor asked us to wag its tail.
ex.zh: 教授让我们摇尾巴。

ex.en: The reading asks you to wag its tail and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你摇尾巴，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: wag a finger at someone｜向某人摇手指
a wag of the tail｜尾巴的一摆
tip: 过去式wagged，现在分词wagging，均双写g。

senses.en: Equal in value, amount, meaning, or function.
Something equal to another thing in value, meaning, or function.

ex.en: Office hours began with equivalent to.
ex.zh: 答疑从与……相当开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss equivalent to.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论与……相当的材料。

col: the equivalent of｜相当于……的事物
tip: 常用equivalent to；相当不代表完全相同。

senses.en: A difference that separates one thing or group from another
The quality of being excellent and deserving respect
A special award or high grade recognizing excellent achievement

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a clear distinction.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于明显的区别的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects a clear distinction with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把明显的区别和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a person of distinction｜杰出人士
tip: 表示两者区别，常用distinction between A and B。

senses.en: make or become steady and less likely to change

ex.en: I heard the lecturer stabilize prices during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时稳定价格。

ex.en: The reading asks you to stabilize prices and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你稳定价格，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: stabilize a patient's condition｜稳定患者病情
tip: 可及物也可不及物；英式英语也常拼作stabilise。

senses.en: A temporary job providing practical experience in a particular field.

ex.en: Our professor circled paid internship on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了带薪实习。

ex.en: The reading connects paid internship with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把带薪实习和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: apply for an internship｜申请实习岗位
tip: intern指实习生；internship指实习岗位或实习期。

senses.en: a large bovine, often a castrated male, used for work

ex.en: The textbook introduces an ox cart in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了牛车。

ex.en: A campus survey used an ox cart to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用牛车来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: a pair of oxen｜一对役牛
as strong as an ox｜健壮如牛
tip: 复数是oxen；多指役牛，不等同于未阉割公牛bull。

senses.en: To wash yourself or another person in a bath
To gently wash a body part with liquid
To swim or spend time in the sea or a lake

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to bathe a baby.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须给婴儿洗澡。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to bathe a baby.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得给婴儿洗澡。

col: bathe in the sea｜在海里游泳
tip: bathe读/beɪð/，勿与bath混淆；英式还可指海泳。

senses.en: Moving or pointing towards a lower place, level, or amount.
Towards a lower place, level, or amount.

ex.en: I copied a downward trend into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把下降趋势抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a downward trend to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用下降趋势来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: downward可作形容词和副词；downwards只作副词。

senses.en: A legally binding agreement between people or organisations.
To become smaller or make something smaller.
To catch or develop a disease.

ex.en: Our professor circled employment contract on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了劳动合同。

ex.en: The author returns to employment contract when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了劳动合同。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词英/kənˈtrækt/，美同。

senses.en: A structure or underground chamber where a dead person is buried.

ex.en: Our professor circled ancient tomb on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了古墓。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss ancient tomb.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论古墓的材料。

tip: b不发音，与room押韵；常指有建筑结构的墓。

senses.en: Relating to citizens or ordinary society rather than the military.
Relating to private legal disputes rather than criminal offences.
Polite and respectful, though not necessarily friendly.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about civil rights.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于公民权利的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects civil rights with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把公民权利和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: civil law指民法；civil war则指内战。

senses.en: Likely to happen or be true.

ex.en: Office hours began with highly probable.
ex.zh: 答疑从极有可能的开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of highly probable.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得极有可能的这个例子。

tip: 常用it is probable that；不用某人is probable to do。

senses.en: A practice session before a performance or important event.

ex.en: I copied dress rehearsal into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把彩排抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dress rehearsal.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论彩排的材料。

tip: 一次排练可数；in rehearsal表示正在排练。

senses.en: Careful to avoid danger, mistakes, or unnecessary risks.

ex.en: The textbook introduces cautious approach in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了谨慎的方法。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cautious approach.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论谨慎的方法的材料。

tip: 常用be cautious about doing，表示谨慎做某事。

senses.en: a severe shortage of food affecting many people

ex.en: I copied widespread famine into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把大范围饥荒抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around widespread famine.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕大范围饥荒展开说明。

tip: famine指大范围粮食匮乏；个人饥饿用hunger。

senses.en: Concerned with qualities and descriptions rather than numbers.

ex.en: The interview study used a qualitative method.
ex.zh: 这项访谈研究使用了定性方法。

ex.en: A qualitative comment can explain a number that the chart leaves bare.
ex.zh: 一句定性评论可以解释图表上光秃秃的数字。

tip: 和 quantitative（定量的）成对出现，不要看错首字母。

senses.en: with careful attention to what is happening
with care for another person's needs

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize attentively in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出专心地。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up attentively while discussing evidence about academic research.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了专心地。

tip: 最常见于listen attentively，重在专心而非关心。

senses.en: The ability to judge well using knowledge and experience
Ideas or advice considered sensible and valuable

ex.en: Office hours began with conventional wisdom.
ex.zh: 答疑从普遍接受的看法开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of conventional wisdom.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得普遍接受的看法这个例子。

col: question the wisdom of｜质疑……是否明智
the wisdom to do something｜做某事的智慧
tip: 不可数；knowledge重知识，wisdom重判断与运用。

senses.en: One of several payments made over time for something.

senses.zh: 连载的一期；系列的一部
senses.en: One part of a story or series released separately.

ex.en: I copied monthly installment into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把每月分期款抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects monthly installment with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把每月分期款和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the next installment｜下一期；下一部
tip: 美式拼写；英式为instalment，分期用in。

senses.en: to display objects or artworks for people to see
to show a particular quality, feeling or behaviour
an object displayed publicly or presented as evidence in court

ex.en: The assignment is to exhibit artwork, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先展出艺术作品，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The passage says students who can exhibit artwork follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够展出艺术作品的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 英式英语中，exhibit 通常指单件展品，展览用 exhibition。

senses.en: a country ruled by a king or queen
one of the largest groups used to classify living things

ex.en: Our professor circled animal kingdom on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了动物界。

ex.en: The reading connects animal kingdom with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把动物界和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 政治语境指王国；animal kingdom指动物界。

senses.en: A chemical element forming most of the gas in Earth's air.

ex.en: The textbook introduces liquid nitrogen in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了液氮。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss liquid nitrogen.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论液氮的材料。

tip: nitrogen是不可数名词，化学符号为N。

senses.en: continuing or happening repeatedly
remaining the same over time
a value or quantity that does not change

ex.en: The textbook introduces constant pressure in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了持续的压力。

ex.en: The author returns to constant pressure when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了持续的压力。

tip: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

senses.en: To put seeds in soil so they can grow.
To cause feelings or problems to begin and spread.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to sow seeds.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求播种。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers sow seeds before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要播种。

tip: 过去式sowed，分词sown或sowed；母猪读/saʊ/。

senses.en: Made by people rather than occurring naturally
Not sincere or natural in appearance or behaviour

ex.en: Our professor circled artificial intelligence on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了人工智能。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around artificial intelligence.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕人工智能展开说明。

tip: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

senses.en: Relating to light or devices that use light.
Relating to sight or the way the eyes work.

ex.en: Our professor circled optical illusion on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了视错觉。

ex.en: The reading connects optical illusion with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把视错觉和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: optical涉及光或视觉；optical illusion指视错觉。

senses.en: to give or deliver something to several people or places
to spread something over an area

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to distribute food.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须分发食物。

ex.en: The reading asks you to distribute food and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你分发食物，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。

senses.en: polite behaviour showing respect and consideration for others
a polite or helpful act
provided free to customers as a service

ex.en: Our professor circled common courtesy on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了基本礼貌。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss common courtesy.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论基本礼貌的材料。

tip: courtesy of表示承蒙某方提供或允许使用。

senses.en: Calculated before taxes, costs, or other amounts are taken away.
Extremely serious and clearly unacceptable.
Very unpleasant or disgusting.

ex.en: Our professor circled gross income on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了总收入。

ex.en: The author returns to gross income when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了总收入。

col: gross domestic product｜国内生产总值
tip: 财务中gross为扣除前总额，net为净额。

senses.en: To give money, time, or effort towards a shared purpose
To help cause a particular result
To write material for a publication or website

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to contribute to a discussion.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何参与讨论。

ex.en: A lecture on social change showed why researchers contribute to a discussion before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于社会变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要参与讨论。

col: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论
contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长
tip: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: a fold of skin that closes over the eye

ex.en: I copied upper eyelid into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把上眼睑抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to upper eyelid when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了上眼睑。

tip: eyelid是眼皮；eyelash是睫毛。

senses.en: a large tree that produces acorns
the strong, hard wood of an oak tree

ex.en: The textbook introduces solid oak in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了实心橡木。

ex.en: The author returns to solid oak when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了实心橡木。

tip: 指树时可数，指木材时不可数；oak table中作定语。

senses.en: Take control of a country or place by force.
Successfully deal with a fear, difficulty, or challenge.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer conquer a territory during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时征服一片领土。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to conquer a territory.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来征服一片领土。

col: conquer a territory｜征服一片领土
conquer a mountain｜征服一座高山
tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语：conquer a fear。

senses.en: A tiny particle carrying a negative electric charge.

ex.en: The textbook introduces electron microscope in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了电子显微镜。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around electron microscope.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕电子显微镜展开说明。

tip: electron是粒子；electronic意为电子的。

senses.en: complete or total
not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on absolute silence.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论鸦雀无声。

ex.en: The reading connects absolute silence with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把鸦雀无声和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an absolute necessity｜绝对必需的事物
tip: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

senses.en: The process of following movements or monitoring changes over time.

ex.en: The textbook introduces satellite tracking in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了卫星追踪。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around satellite tracking.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕卫星追踪展开说明。

tip: 作名词通常不可数；也是track的现在分词。

senses.en: Existing everywhere or applying to everyone in a group.
Suitable for use with many different devices or situations.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about universal access.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于普遍享有使用机会的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of universal access.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得普遍享有使用机会这个例子。

col: universal access｜普遍享有使用机会
tip: 指全体适用或普遍存在，语气通常强于common。

senses.en: Shared, owned, or done by two or more people or groups.
A place where bones or separate parts meet.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on joint effort.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论共同努力。

ex.en: The author returns to joint effort when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了共同努力。

tip: joint作形容词指共同参与；作名词可指关节。

senses.en: A man who speaks officially for a group or organisation

ex.en: I copied a government spokesman into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把政府男发言人抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on public communication, everyone remembered the example of a government spokesman.
ex.zh: 在关于公共传播的讲座里，大家都记得政府男发言人这个例子。

col: a government spokesman｜政府男发言人
a company spokesman｜公司男发言人
tip: 特指男性；不强调性别时用spokesperson。

senses.en: the curved path of an object moving around another in space
to move around a planet, star, or other object in space

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about enter orbit.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于进入轨道的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects enter orbit with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把进入轨道和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 动词可直接接天体：orbit the Earth，无须加 around。

senses.en: A microscopic single-celled organism, sometimes responsible for disease.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a harmful bacterium in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了有害细菌。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a harmful bacterium.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕有害细菌展开说明。

tip: 单数bacterium，复数bacteria；复数作主语用are。

senses.en: The sudden start of a disease or other harmful event.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a disease outbreak in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了疾病暴发。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a disease outbreak.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论疾病暴发的材料。

col: the outbreak of war｜战争爆发
tip: 名词outbreak写成一词；动词用break out。

senses.en: Financially successful and enjoying wealth or economic growth

ex.en: Office hours began with prosperous economy.
ex.zh: 答疑从繁荣的经济开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss prosperous economy.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论繁荣的经济的材料。

tip: 常修饰国家、地区或经济，强调经济上的兴旺。

senses.en: To move or change position, direction, or focus.
A change in position, direction, or emphasis.
A scheduled period of work in a rotating system.

ex.en: The professor asked us to shift the focus.
ex.zh: 教授让我们转移重点。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to shift the focus.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们转移重点。

col: a shift in attitudes｜态度的转变
tip: shift作名词可指变化，也可指工作班次。

senses.en: a system where people are owned and forced to work

ex.en: I copied abolish slavery into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把废除奴隶制抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss abolish slavery.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论废除奴隶制的材料。

col: the abolition of slavery｜奴隶制的废除
tip: slavery为不可数名词；abolish slavery指废除奴隶制。

senses.en: able or likely to burst violently
increasing very rapidly or appearing with sudden force
a substance that can cause a violent burst of energy

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about explosive materials.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于易爆材料的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around explosive materials.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕易爆材料展开说明。

tip: explosive growth形容激增，并非真正发生爆炸。

senses.en: the part of a plant that absorbs water from soil
the basic cause or origin of something
to grow roots or cause a plant to grow roots

ex.en: The textbook introduces root cause in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了根本原因。

ex.en: The reading connects root cause with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把根本原因和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: at the root of｜是……的根源
tip: root本身不表示根除；root out才表示根除。

senses.en: An arrangement to receive a service or publication regularly.
Money paid regularly for a publication, service, or membership.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an annual subscription.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于年度订阅的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an annual subscription.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕年度订阅展开说明。

tip: subscription是订阅或费用；用户是subscriber。

senses.en: A female deity worshipped in a religion or described in mythology.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on harvest goddess.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论丰收女神。

ex.en: The reading connects harvest goddess with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把丰收女神和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: goddess指女神，对应男性神祇通常用god。

senses.en: Say a poem or passage aloud, often from memory
Say a series of facts or details aloud

ex.en: The professor asked us to recite a poem.
ex.zh: 教授让我们背诵诗歌。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to recite a poem.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来背诵诗歌。

col: recite a list｜逐一念出清单
tip: recite强调出声背诵；memorise强调记住。

senses.en: Expecting bad results or focusing on possible problems.

ex.en: I copied a pessimistic outlook into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把悲观的看法抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a pessimistic outlook.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论悲观的看法的材料。

col: pessimistic about the future｜对未来悲观
tip: 常用be pessimistic about；反义词是optimistic。

senses.en: Work completed during a course, often contributing to final assessment.

ex.en: Office hours began with submit coursework.
ex.zh: 答疑从提交课程作业开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around submit coursework.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕提交课程作业展开说明。

tip: 不可数，不说 a coursework；一份用 a piece of。

senses.en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something

ex.en: Our professor circled a crucial role on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了关键作用。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a crucial role.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得关键作用这个例子。

col: crucial to success｜对成功至关重要
tip: 比important语气强；常用be crucial to。

senses.en: An expert paid to provide specialist advice.
A senior hospital doctor specialising in a particular medical field.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a management consultant in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了管理顾问。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a management consultant.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得管理顾问这个例子。

col: a consultant surgeon｜高级外科医生
tip: 医疗语境中，英国的consultant指高级专科医生。

senses.en: to control equipment, or to work as a machine
to run a business or provide a service
to perform surgery on a patient

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to operate machinery.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何操作机器。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to operate machinery.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来操作机器。

col: operate on a patient｜给病人做手术
tip: 操作机器直接接宾语；给某人做手术用operate on。

senses.en: a person or animal that spends time with someone
a book providing useful information about a particular subject

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a travelling companion.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于旅伴的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a travelling companion to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用旅伴来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: a companion to literature｜文学指南
tip: companion强调陪伴，不一定是好友，也可指动物。

senses.en: Feeling or showing extreme anger.
Done with great force, energy, or speed.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a furious debate.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论激烈的辩论。

ex.en: The author returns to a furious debate when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了激烈的辩论。

col: furious with someone｜对某人大发雷霆
furious about something｜因某事极其愤怒
tip: 对某人生气用with，因某事生气用about。

senses.en: Heavy earth that can be shaped when wet and baked hard.

ex.en: Office hours began with wet clay.
ex.zh: 答疑从湿黏土开始。

ex.en: The author returns to wet clay when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了湿黏土。

tip: 通常不可数；a piece of clay表示一块黏土。

senses.en: To make something longer, larger, or wider in scope
To stretch out a hand, arm, or other body part
To offer someone help, an invitation, or a welcome

ex.en: The lab instructions say to extend a deadline.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求延长截止期限。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to extend a deadline.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们延长截止期限。

col: extend a deadline｜延长截止期限
extend a warm welcome｜表示热烈欢迎
tip: extend by接增加量；extend to接新的终点或期限。

senses.en: Resistance when one surface moves or rubs against another.
Disagreement or tension between people or groups.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on reduce friction.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论减小摩擦。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss reduce friction.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论减小摩擦的材料。

col: friction between surfaces｜表面之间的摩擦
a source of friction｜冲突的根源
tip: 物理摩擦与人际不和两义均通常不可数。

senses.en: A period when economic activity falls and many businesses struggle.
The gradual movement of something backwards from its previous position.

ex.en: The textbook introduces economic recession in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济衰退。

ex.en: A campus survey used economic recession to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用经济衰退来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 通常指整体经济衰退，不等于单纯价格下跌。

senses.en: An insect or animal that damages crops, food, or property.
Someone who annoys others, especially repeatedly.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a garden pest.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于花园害虫的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of a garden pest.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得花园害虫这个例子。

tip: pest不限于昆虫，也可指老鼠等有害动物。

senses.en: Arrange financial protection against loss, damage, illness, or injury.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to insure against theft.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何投保盗窃险。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to insure against theft.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得投保盗窃险。

tip: insure主要指投保；表示确保通常用ensure。

senses.en: To discover or establish something through examination.
To control or strongly influence what happens.
To make a firm decision to do something.

ex.en: The assignment is to determine the cause, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先查明原因，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers determine the cause before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要查明原因。

tip: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。

senses.en: The final result of an action, event, or process.

ex.en: I copied positive outcome into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把积极的结果抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects positive outcome with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把积极的结果和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 可数名词，常用the outcome of表示某事的结果。

senses.en: a group of large animals living or moving together
to guide animals or people together in a particular direction

ex.en: The textbook introduces a herd of cattle in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了一群牛。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a herd of cattle.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕一群牛展开说明。

tip: 牛、象等成群用herd；羊群、鸟群通常用flock。

senses.en: A small device designed to perform a particular useful task

ex.en: I copied electronic gadget into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把电子小装置抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss electronic gadget.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电子小装置的材料。

tip: 指有特定用途的小装置，不一定是电子产品。

senses.en: The state of being awake and aware of your surroundings
Awareness or understanding of a particular issue or situation

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about regain consciousness.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于恢复知觉的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to regain consciousness when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了恢复知觉。

tip: consciousness指意识或知觉；conscience指良心。

senses.en: Accepted rules of polite behaviour in particular social situations.

ex.en: I copied table etiquette into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把餐桌礼仪抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to table etiquette when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了餐桌礼仪。

tip: 通常不可数；表示礼仪规范，不指单个动作。

senses.en: to make a very loud, deep sound
a very loud, deep sound

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to roar with laughter.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何放声大笑。

ex.en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to roar with laughter.
ex.zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们放声大笑。

col: a roar of applause｜雷鸣般的掌声
the roar of an engine｜发动机的轰鸣声
tip: 既可指狮子吼叫，也可指引擎轰鸣或人群欢呼。

senses.en: a thin thread forming part of a material or tissue
plant material in food that helps digestion

ex.en: I copied dietary fibre into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把膳食纤维抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dietary fibre.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论膳食纤维的材料。

tip: 美式拼写为 fiber；膳食纤维义通常不可数。

senses.en: Examining similarities or differences between two or more things.
True to some degree when compared with something else.
An adjective or adverb form expressing a higher or lower degree.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about comparative study.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于比较研究的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to comparative study when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了比较研究。

tip: comparative还可指语法比较级，如better。

senses.en: To bring back a previous condition, ability, or situation.
To repair something old or damaged to its earlier condition.
To return something to its rightful owner or place.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to restore confidence.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求恢复信心。

ex.en: The reading asks you to restore confidence and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你恢复信心，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: restore a historic building｜修复历史建筑
restore something to its owner｜将某物归还原主
tip: restore A to B：使A恢复到B状态或归还给B。

senses.en: the second of two people or things already mentioned
closer to the end of a period or sequence

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on the latter half.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论后半部分。

ex.en: The reading connects the latter half with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把后半部分和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the former and the latter｜前者与后者
tip: the latter指两者中的后者，不等于later。

senses.en: very strong or extreme in degree
showing very strong feelings or serious concentration

ex.en: The textbook introduces intense heat in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了酷热。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around intense heat.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕酷热展开说明。

tip: intense 强调程度强烈；intensive 强调密集投入。

senses.en: Not responsible for a crime or wrongdoing.
Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life.
Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on innocent victims.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论无辜的受害者。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss innocent victims.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论无辜的受害者的材料。

col: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪
tip: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

senses.en: to break down naturally, or cause something to do so
the process or condition of decaying

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to rot away.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须逐渐腐烂。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to rot away.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得逐渐腐烂。

tip: rot与decay都可指腐烂；rotting须双写t。

senses.en: An amount recorded as money taken from a bank account.
To record money as taken from a bank account.

ex.en: I copied direct debit into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把自动扣款抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of direct debit.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得自动扣款这个例子。

tip: 借记卡用账户余额；信用卡使用授信额度。

senses.en: Someone whose job is recording a business's financial transactions.

ex.en: Office hours began with part-time bookkeeper.
ex.zh: 答疑从兼职记账员开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used part-time bookkeeper to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用兼职记账员来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: experienced bookkeeper｜经验丰富的记账员
tip: 主要负责日常记账；accountant职责通常更广。

senses.en: not restricted in amount, number, or extent

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on unlimited access.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论无限制使用权。

ex.en: The reading connects unlimited access with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把无限制使用权和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示没有限制；不等于 uncertain（不确定的）。

senses.en: To help someone do something.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer assist someone with something during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时帮助某人处理某事。

ex.en: The passage says students who can assist someone with something follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够帮助某人处理某事的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: assist someone with something｜帮助某人处理某事
assist in doing something｜协助做某事
assist someone to do something｜帮助某人做某事
tip: 比help正式；常用assist someone with something。

senses.en: the main plant part supporting leaves, flowers, or fruit
originate or result from something
stop or reduce an unwanted flow or increase

ex.en: Office hours began with plant stem.
ex.zh: 答疑从植物茎开始。

ex.en: The reading connects plant stem with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把植物茎和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: stem the flow of｜遏制…的流动
stem the tide of｜遏制…的势头
tip: “源于”用stem from；大写STEM指理工科。

senses.en: To make something less complicated or easier to understand.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to simplify a process.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何简化流程。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to simplify a process.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来简化流程。

col: simplify an explanation｜使解释更易懂
tip: simplify强调减少复杂性；simple是形容词。

senses.en: the process of putting equipment or software in place for use
equipment or buildings arranged for a particular purpose
an artwork made by arranging objects within a space

ex.en: Our professor circled software installation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了软件安装。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss software installation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论软件安装的材料。

tip: 表示安装过程通常不可数；具体设施或作品可数。

senses.en: To make a copy or create the same result again.
To produce young animals, plants, or other living organisms.

ex.en: The assignment is to reproduce results, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先复现结果，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to reproduce results.
ex.zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们复现结果。

tip: 复制某物时及物；表示繁殖时常不及物。

senses.en: The upper part of the leg, above the knee.

ex.en: The textbook introduces inner thigh in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了大腿内侧。

ex.en: A campus survey used inner thigh to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用大腿内侧来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 指髋部到膝盖之间；小腿通常用lower leg。

senses.en: The latest time by which something must be completed

ex.en: Office hours began with a tight deadline.
ex.zh: 答疑从紧迫的截止期限开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on student life, everyone remembered the example of a tight deadline.
ex.zh: 在关于校园生活的讲座里，大家都记得紧迫的截止期限这个例子。

col: miss a deadline｜错过截止期限
extend a deadline｜延长截止期限
a tight deadline｜紧迫的截止期限
tip: 按期完成用meet a deadline，不用catch。

senses.en: a person owned by another and forced to work
to work extremely hard for a long time

ex.en: I copied the slave trade into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把奴隶贸易抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to the slave trade when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了奴隶贸易。

tip: 历史语境可用enslaved person，强调其人的身份。

senses.en: a condition involving persistent sadness and loss of interest
a long period of severely reduced economic activity
an area lower than the surface around it

ex.en: The textbook introduces suffer from depression in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了患抑郁症。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of suffer from depression.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得患抑郁症这个例子。

tip: 抑郁症不等于短暂心情低落；经济萧条常用a depression。

senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more active
to make a body part or biological process more active

ex.en: The professor asked us to stimulate growth.
ex.zh: 教授让我们促进增长。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to stimulate growth.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们促进增长。

col: stimulate the brain｜刺激大脑活动
tip: 直接接宾语：stimulate interest表示激发兴趣。

senses.en: Relating to a company or businesses in general.
Shared by a group acting together as one body.

ex.en: Office hours began with corporate culture.
ex.zh: 答疑从企业文化开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of corporate culture.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得企业文化这个例子。

tip: corporate指企业的；cooperative指合作的。

senses.en: a person or company that provides goods or services

ex.en: Office hours began with local supplier.
ex.zh: 答疑从本地供应商开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss local supplier.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论本地供应商的材料。

tip: supplier of后接所供物品；supply为其动词形式。

senses.en: Information discovered through research or an investigation.
An official decision made by a court after considering evidence.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a finding of fact.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论事实认定。

ex.en: The reading connects a finding of fact with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把事实认定和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: publish the findings｜公布调查结果
a finding of fact｜事实认定
tip: 表示研究或调查结果时，常用复数findings。

senses.en: Belonging separately to each person or thing already mentioned.

ex.en: I copied respective roles into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把各自的角色抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to respective roles when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了各自的角色。

tip: 通常放在复数名词前；勿与respectful混淆。

senses.en: money saved or collected for a particular purpose
money available to spend, usually expressed in the plural
to provide money for an activity, organisation, or project

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a pension fund.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于养老基金的简答题。
