senses.en: deserving disapproval because of dishonest or unfair behaviour

ex.en: I copied dishonorable conduct into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把可耻行为抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used dishonorable conduct to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用可耻行为来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 美式拼写；英式通常写作dishonourable。

senses.en: Extremely careful and attentive to every small detail.

ex.en: I copied meticulous attention to detail into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把对细节的一丝不苟抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to meticulous attention to detail when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了对细节的一丝不苟。

col: meticulous attention to detail｜对细节的一丝不苟
tip: 通常是褒义，强调认真关注每个细节。

senses.en: Emitting light through fluorescence, or using this effect for lighting.
Having an extremely bright, noticeable colour.

ex.en: The textbook introduces fluorescent lighting in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了荧光照明。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fluorescent lighting.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论荧光照明的材料。

tip: 注意拼写是fluorescent，常搭配lamp或tube。

senses.en: Relating to education at college or university level.
Third in order, level, or stage.

ex.en: Office hours began with tertiary education.
ex.zh: 答疑从高等教育开始。

ex.en: The author returns to tertiary education when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了高等教育。

tip: tertiary education指中学之后的高等教育。

senses.en: to agree with someone or share the same opinion

ex.en: I heard the lecturer concur that during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时一致认为。

ex.en: The reading asks you to concur that and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你一致认为，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: concur in a decision｜赞同一项决定
tip: 正式用词，常用concur with某人或concur that从句。

senses.en: Lasting longer than expected or desired.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on protracted negotiations.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论旷日持久的谈判。

ex.en: A campus survey used protracted negotiations to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用旷日持久的谈判来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 比long更强调拖得过久，常含负面意味。

senses.en: a state in which growth, activity, or development stops
the condition of water or air remaining still

ex.en: Office hours began with economic stagnation.
ex.zh: 答疑从经济停滞开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of economic stagnation.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得经济停滞这个例子。

col: a period of stagnation｜一段停滞期
tip: 通常为不可数名词，常用于经济或发展停滞。

senses.en: Cause someone or something serious suffering or difficulty

ex.en: The assignment is to afflict communities, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先困扰社区，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to afflict communities.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来困扰社区。

tip: 常用被动be afflicted with，后接疾病或困境。

senses.en: A feeling of satisfaction from doing something meaningful
The act of meeting a requirement or achieving something desired

ex.en: Our professor circled personal fulfillment on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了个人满足感。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around personal fulfillment.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕个人满足感展开说明。

tip: 这是美式拼写；英式通常写作fulfilment。

senses.en: A person or business that sells writing and office supplies.

ex.en: I copied a local stationer into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把当地文具商抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a local stationer to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用当地文具商来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: a high-street stationer｜商业街文具商
tip: 文具店常用stationer's；stationery是文具，勿混stationary。

senses.en: A living organism too small to see without a microscope

ex.en: The professor explained microbe with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了微生物。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up microbe while discussing evidence about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于自然科学的证据时提到了微生物。

tip: 不只指细菌，也不一定有害；germ常指病菌。

senses.en: The soft light just after sunset or before sunrise
The final stage of something as its strength or importance fades

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize twilight in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出暮色。

ex.en: A reading on the natural sciences uses twilight when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于自然科学的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了暮色。

col: the twilight of a career｜职业生涯的末期
tip: 多指日落后的暮光，也可指日出前的微光。

senses.en: a person who takes part in a competition
a person or organisation newly joining an activity or field

ex.en: I copied competition entrant into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把参赛者抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to competition entrant when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了参赛者。

tip: 新加入某领域用entrant to；不等于入口entrance。

senses.en: Of central importance to a system, belief, or activity.
A senior Catholic official who helps elect the pope.
A North American bird whose male has bright red feathers.

ex.en: I copied cardinal rule into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把首要规则抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cardinal rule.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论首要规则的材料。

tip: cardinal number是基数，ordinal number是序数。

senses.en: A belief that is commonly accepted but actually false.
An error in reasoning that makes an argument unreliable.

ex.en: I copied a common fallacy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把常见谬见抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a common fallacy.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得常见谬见这个例子。

tip: 不只是事实错误，也常指论证中的逻辑错误。

senses.en: Intended to hurt someone through harsh criticism or unkind remarks.
An article or picture cut out of a newspaper.
A deep passage dug through land for a road or railway.

ex.en: Our professor circled newspaper cutting on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了剪报。

ex.en: The reading connects newspaper cutting with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把剪报和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 剪报在英式英语中叫cutting，美式常用clipping。

senses.en: to obtain something, especially through effort or careful arrangements

ex.en: I heard the lecturer procure equipment during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时采购设备。

ex.en: The passage says students who can procure equipment follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够采购设备的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 正式及物动词，直接接所获得的物品或资源。

senses.en: the way you hold your body when sitting or standing
an attitude or position towards a particular issue
to behave artificially in order to impress others

ex.en: Office hours began with good posture.
ex.zh: 答疑从良好的体态开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around good posture.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕良好的体态展开说明。

col: adopt a defensive posture｜采取防御姿态
tip: 名词常指体态；动词常含“装样子”的贬义。

senses.en: Lacking physical strength, energy, or intensity.
Too weak to convince people or achieve a useful result.

ex.en: Office hours began with a feeble voice.
ex.zh: 答疑从微弱的声音开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a feeble voice when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了微弱的声音。

col: a feeble excuse｜站不住脚的借口
tip: 可形容身体、声音，也可批评借口或努力无力。

senses.en: A situation where disagreement prevents any further progress.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about end in deadlock.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于以僵局告终的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss end in deadlock.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论以僵局告终的材料。

tip: 常与reach或break搭配；强调分歧导致无法推进。

senses.en: a tiny blood vessel or an extremely narrow tube

senses.zh: 毛细血管的；毛细作用的
senses.en: relating to tiny blood vessels or liquid movement through narrow spaces

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about capillary action.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于毛细作用的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used capillary action to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用毛细作用来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 复数为capillaries；英美读音的重音位置不同。

senses.en: The legal process of charging and trying someone for a crime.
The lawyers trying to prove an accused person committed a crime.

ex.en: The textbook introduces face prosecution in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了面临起诉。

ex.en: A campus survey used face prosecution to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用面临起诉来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

col: the prosecution case｜控方的案情陈述
tip: the prosecution指刑事案件控方，不是民事原告。

senses.en: Accepting different opinions and supporting people's freedom to choose.
Supporting political principles that protect individual rights and freedoms.
Given or used generously, often in large amounts.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on liberal attitudes.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论开明的态度。

ex.en: The author returns to liberal attitudes when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了开明的态度。

tip: 政治含义随国家而异；也可表示开明或用量充足。

senses.en: to form an idea or imagine something
to become pregnant or cause a baby to begin developing

ex.en: I heard the lecturer conceive an idea during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时构思一个主意。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to conceive an idea.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得构思一个主意。

col: conceive an idea｜构思一个主意
tip: conceive an idea指构思；conceive of指设想。

senses.en: requiring a lot of time and hard work

ex.en: The textbook introduces laborious process in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了费时费力的过程。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of laborious process.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得费时费力的过程这个例子。

tip: 通常形容任务或过程；形容人勤劳用industrious。

senses.en: The quality of being clear and easy to understand.
The quality of being easy to see or hear through.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about lack of clarity.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于不够清晰的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects lack of clarity with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把不够清晰和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 不可数名词；clarify是动词，意为澄清。

senses.en: Grateful to someone for help or support.
Owing money to a person or organisation.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about heavily indebted.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于负债累累的的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of heavily indebted.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得负债累累的这个例子。

col: indebted to someone for｜因某事感激某人
tip: be indebted to sb for sth表示因某事感激某人。

senses.en: Communication over a distance using electronic signals.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on telecommunication networks.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论电信网络。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss telecommunication networks.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论电信网络的材料。

tip: 谈电信行业或技术时，通常用复数telecommunications。

senses.en: money spent on something
the use of time, energy, or effort

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on public expenditure.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公共支出。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of public expenditure.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得公共支出这个例子。

tip: 通常不可数；expenditure on后接花费对象。

senses.en: the act of keeping something or preventing someone from leaving
the ability to keep information in your memory
the accumulation of fluid that the body does not release

ex.en: Our professor circled staff retention on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了员工留任。

ex.en: The author returns to staff retention when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了员工留任。

tip: 通常不可数；动词形式为retain。

senses.en: Hard, boring work that must be repeated regularly.

ex.en: The textbook introduces daily drudgery in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了日常苦差事。

ex.en: A campus survey used daily drudgery to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用日常苦差事来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

col: the drudgery of repetitive work｜重复工作的枯燥劳苦
tip: 不可数名词，强调工作既繁重又单调，而不只是困难。

senses.en: A lawyer who presents a criminal case against an accused person.

ex.en: Our professor circled public prosecutor on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公诉人；检察官。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of public prosecutor.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得公诉人；检察官这个例子。

tip: 代表控方提出指控；不负责作出判决。

senses.en: Feeling sorry about something that happened or something you did.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a regretful smile.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于带着遗憾的微笑的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects a regretful smile with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把带着遗憾的微笑和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a regretful smile｜带着遗憾的微笑
regretful about a decision｜对决定感到后悔
tip: regretful指人感到遗憾；regrettable指事令人遗憾。

senses.en: Property, shares, or other assets owned by someone.
An area of land owned or rented for farming.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a share holding in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了所持股份。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a share holding.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕所持股份展开说明。

tip: 资产常用复数holdings；holding company指控股公司。

senses.en: Someone found guilty of a crime, especially someone in prison.
To officially find someone guilty of a crime in court.

ex.en: I copied a former convict into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把曾经服刑的人抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a former convict to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用曾经服刑的人来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

col: a convicted offender｜被定罪的违法者
convict someone of theft｜判某人盗窃罪成立
a former convict｜曾经服刑的人
tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词在第二音节；定罪用of。

senses.en: A dog bred to hunt using smell or sight.
To repeatedly bother or pursue someone.

ex.en: The professor explained hound with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了猎犬。

ex.en: Students who can explain hound usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 能解释猎犬的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。

col: a pack of hounds｜一群猎犬
hound someone for answers｜追着某人要答案
hound someone out of office｜逼迫某人离职
tip: 作动词强调反复纠缠，不只是普通的追赶。

senses.en: The process of developing a plan, policy, or theory.
A particular way of expressing an idea precisely.
A mixture prepared for a particular purpose.

ex.en: The textbook introduces policy formulation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了政策制定。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss policy formulation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论政策制定的材料。

col: the formulation of a theory｜理论的构建
tip: 常用the formulation of，表示计划等的制定。

senses.en: an economic system based on private ownership and profit

ex.en: Our professor circled free-market capitalism on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了自由市场资本主义。

ex.en: The reading connects free-market capitalism with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把自由市场资本主义和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: free-market capitalism｜自由市场资本主义
the rise of capitalism｜资本主义的兴起
tip: 不可数名词；capitalist可指资本家或作形容词。

senses.zh: 数量上的优势；主导地位
senses.en: The state of being most numerous, powerful, or influential.

ex.en: The textbook introduces economic predominance in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了经济上的主导地位。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around economic predominance.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕经济上的主导地位展开说明。

col: economic predominance｜经济上的主导地位
tip: 强调数量、力量或影响占优，不等于“杰出”。

senses.en: careful use of money and resources to avoid waste

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about practise thrift.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于厉行节约的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used practise thrift to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用厉行节约来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: thrift 是名词；形容词“节俭的”是 thrifty。

senses.en: shake slightly with quick, small movements
a small, quick shaking movement
a container used for carrying arrows

ex.en: The lab instructions say to quiver with fear.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求吓得发抖。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers quiver with fear before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要吓得发抖。

col: a quiver of excitement｜激动得一颤
tip: 多指细微而快速的抖动；声音也可用quiver。

senses.en: continuing all the time or lasting forever

senses.zh: 一再发生的；没完没了的
senses.en: happening repeatedly, often in an annoying way

ex.en: Office hours began with perpetual motion.
ex.zh: 答疑从永动开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss perpetual motion.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论永动的材料。

tip: 可指永不停止，也常夸张表示某事没完没了。

senses.en: to prove that a statement or argument is wrong

ex.en: The lab instructions say to refute a claim.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求驳倒某种说法。

ex.en: The passage says students who can refute a claim follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够驳倒某种说法的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: refute a claim｜驳倒某种说法
tip: 强调用证据证明错误，不只是表示不同意。

senses.en: Too many to count.

ex.en: The textbook introduces innumerable examples in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了无数例子。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around innumerable examples.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕无数例子展开说明。

tip: 后接可数名词复数，语气比many强，较正式。

senses.en: Connected with a god or coming from a god
Extremely pleasant or wonderful
Discover through intuition or supposed supernatural powers

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about taste divine.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于味道好极了的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to taste divine when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了味道好极了。

tip: 表示“极好的”时多用于非正式赞美。

senses.en: Allowing considerable freedom rather than enforcing strict rules.

ex.en: The textbook introduces permissive parenting in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了放任式养育。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around permissive parenting.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕放任式养育展开说明。

tip: permissive指宽纵；permissible才指被允许的。

senses.en: The process of passing something from one place to another.
The broadcasting of radio or television signals or programmes.
The system transferring engine power to a vehicle's wheels.

ex.en: I copied data transmission into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把数据传输抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to data transmission when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了数据传输。

tip: 动词是 transmit；过去式 transmitted 双写 t。

senses.en: A long research paper written for a university degree.
A central claim that someone presents and supports with evidence.

ex.en: The textbook introduces doctoral thesis in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了博士论文。

ex.en: The reading connects doctoral thesis with a larger point about student life.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把博士论文和关于校园生活的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: write a thesis｜撰写学位论文
submit a thesis｜提交学位论文
tip: 复数是theses；既可指学位论文，也可指核心论点。

senses.en: Feel or show great happiness about something.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to rejoice at the news.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求为消息感到欣喜。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers rejoice at the news before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要为消息感到欣喜。

col: rejoice at the news｜为消息感到欣喜
rejoice in someone's success｜为某人的成功欢喜
tip: 较正式；常用rejoice at/in或接that从句。

senses.en: The beginning of something, especially something unpleasant.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sudden onset.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论突然发作。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of sudden onset.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得突然发作这个例子。

col: the onset of symptoms｜症状的出现
the onset of winter｜冬季的来临
tip: 常用the onset of，多指疾病或不利情况的开始。

senses.en: The splitting of an atomic nucleus, usually releasing energy.
Reproduction in which one organism divides into separate organisms.

ex.en: Our professor circled nuclear fission on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了核裂变。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of nuclear fission.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得核裂变这个例子。

tip: 核物理中fission是裂变，fusion是聚变。

senses.en: A group of young birds born to the same mother.
To keep thinking unhappily about something.
To sit on eggs or young birds to keep them warm.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a brood of chicks.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论一窝雏鸟。

ex.en: A campus survey used a brood of chicks to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用一窝雏鸟来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: a brood of chicks｜一窝雏鸟
brood over a mistake｜对一个错误耿耿于怀
brood on the past｜为往事忧思
tip: 作动词表忧思时常接over或on。

senses.en: Give up control, possession or a right to something.

ex.en: The professor asked us to relinquish control.
ex.zh: 教授让我们放弃控制权。

ex.en: The reading asks you to relinquish control and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你放弃控制权，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: relinquish a claim｜放弃权利主张
tip: 正式及物动词，直接接control、power、rights等。

senses.en: Gather the courage, strength, or support needed to do something.
Bring people together, especially for military duties.
A gathering of people, especially soldiers, for inspection or duty.

ex.en: The assignment is to muster the courage, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先鼓起勇气，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers muster the courage before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要鼓起勇气。

tip: muster courage指鼓起勇气；pass muster指合格。

senses.en: Too small or unimportant to deserve much attention.
Unkindly concerned with small, unimportant matters.
Relatively minor or small in scale, especially concerning crime.

ex.en: Our professor circled petty crime on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了轻微犯罪。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss petty crime.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论轻微犯罪的材料。

tip: 形容人时常含贬义，指小心眼，不只是小气。

senses.en: A good reason explaining why something is acceptable or necessary.

ex.en: I copied little justification into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把几乎没有正当理由抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around little justification.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕几乎没有正当理由展开说明。

col: little justification｜几乎没有正当理由
economic justification｜经济上的合理依据
tip: 常接for加名词或动名词，说明某事的合理依据。

senses.en: A rock mainly composed of calcium carbonate, often from marine remains.

ex.en: Our professor circled limestone cliffs on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了石灰岩峭壁。

ex.en: The author returns to limestone cliffs when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了石灰岩峭壁。

tip: limestone通常不可数；lime还可指石灰或青柠。

senses.en: one half of the Earth
either of the two halves of the brain

ex.en: Our professor circled northern hemisphere on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了北半球。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of northern hemisphere.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得北半球这个例子。

tip: 地理中指地球的一半，也可指大脑半球。

senses.en: a new activity or business involving risk
to go somewhere or do something despite possible risks
to express an opinion despite uncertainty about the response

ex.en: Our professor circled joint venture on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了合资企业。

ex.en: The author returns to joint venture when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了合资企业。

col: venture an opinion｜冒昧发表意见
tip: venture本身不等于风险投资；风险资本是venture capital。

senses.en: Collect information from different sources and arrange it together.
Convert computer code into a form a computer can run.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to compile a report.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何编写报告。

ex.en: A lecture on technological change showed why researchers compile a report before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于技术变革的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要编写报告。

tip: 强调从不同来源收集并整理，不只是写作。

senses.en: Easily harmed, attacked, or negatively affected.

ex.en: Our professor circled vulnerable to disease on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了易患病的。

ex.en: A campus survey used vulnerable to disease to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用易患病的来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

tip: 常用 vulnerable to，to 后接名词。

senses.en: a unit of land area equal to ten thousand square metres

ex.en: Office hours began with a hectare of land.
ex.zh: 答疑从一公顷土地开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a hectare of land.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一公顷土地的材料。

col: a hectare of land｜一公顷土地
tip: 公顷是面积单位；一公顷等于一万平方米。

senses.en: To force many things or people into a small space.
To study intensively shortly before an examination.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer cram into a bag during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时硬塞进包里。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to cram into a bag.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得硬塞进包里。

col: cram into a bag｜硬塞进包里
cram a room with people｜让房间挤满人
cram for an exam｜考前突击复习
tip: 过去式crammed；复习考试用cram for。

senses.en: Aiming for morally admirable or very ambitious achievements.
Rising to a great height.
Showing a belief that you are better than others.

ex.en: The textbook introduces lofty ideals in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了崇高的理想。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of lofty ideals.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得崇高的理想这个例子。

tip: 修饰理想时可表赞许，也可暗示目标过高、不切实际。

senses.en: to cause someone or something to enter a particular state
to provide help, a service, or something needed
to represent something in artistic or visual form

ex.en: The lab instructions say to render assistance.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求提供援助。

ex.en: The passage says students who can render assistance follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够提供援助的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: render something useless｜使某物失去用途
tip: 表“使……”时常用render＋宾语＋形容词，语气正式。

senses.zh: 臭名昭著的；声名狼藉的
senses.en: widely known for something bad or undesirable

ex.en: Our professor circled notorious for on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了因…而臭名昭著。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss notorious for.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论因…而臭名昭著的材料。

tip: 通常含贬义；著名但非负面用famous，不宜用notorious。

senses.en: able to cause death

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on potentially lethal.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论可能致命的。

ex.en: The reading connects potentially lethal with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可能致命的和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 通常作形容词；lethal 强调具有致死能力。

senses.en: Someone or something with a similar role in another setting.

ex.en: Office hours began with a foreign counterpart.
ex.zh: 答疑从国外的对等人员开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a foreign counterpart when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了国外的对等人员。

col: a foreign counterpart｜国外的对等人员
a rural counterpart｜农村的对应对象
a digital counterpart｜数字化的对应版本
tip: 强调在另一地区或机构中角色相当，不是对手。

senses.en: To make movement or progress slower or more difficult.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer impede progress during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时阻碍进展。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to impede progress.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得阻碍进展。

tip: 强调使进展困难或缓慢，不一定完全阻止。

senses.en: acting or speaking as though more important than others

ex.en: Our professor circled sound pompous on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了听起来自大。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sound pompous.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕听起来自大展开说明。

tip: 含贬义，重点是自命不凡，不只是外表华丽。

senses.en: An idea or plan offered for consideration
A statement that can be examined as true or false

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a business proposition.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论商业提议。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a business proposition.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得商业提议这个例子。

col: an attractive proposition｜有吸引力的提议
support a proposition｜支持一项主张
tip: 作主张讲可接 that 从句；提议常用 proposal。

senses.en: a hard mineral common in rocks and used in electronics

ex.en: Office hours began with rose quartz.
ex.zh: 答疑从粉晶开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used rose quartz to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用粉晶来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 通常不可数；一块石英用 a piece of quartz。

senses.en: Unfair, unnecessary, or inappropriate in a particular situation.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize uncalled-for in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出无理的。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses uncalled-for when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了无理的。

tip: 常形容批评或言论无理，不只是数量多余。

senses.en: to fill someone's thoughts, leaving little attention for other things

ex.en: The assignment is to preoccupy someone's mind, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先占据某人的心思，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to preoccupy someone's mind.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来占据某人的心思。

col: be preoccupied with work｜一心想着工作
preoccupy someone's mind｜占据某人的心思
tip: 常用be preoccupied with，指心思被某事占据。

senses.en: to confirm someone is reliable or something is true

ex.en: The assignment is to vouch for the accuracy of, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先保证……的准确性，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to vouch for the accuracy of.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来保证……的准确性。

col: vouch for the accuracy of｜保证……的准确性
vouch for the quality of｜保证……的质量
tip: 通常用vouch for，不直接接担保的人或事物。

senses.en: To bring separate parts or groups together as one.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to unify a country.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何统一国家。

ex.en: The reading asks you to unify a country and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你统一国家，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: unify different groups｜使不同群体团结
tip: unify强调把分散部分合成整体，可用于制度或群体。

senses.en: happening repeatedly, often at regular intervals

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on periodic checks.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论定期检查。

ex.en: The author returns to periodic checks when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了定期检查。

tip: periodic是形容词，不是名词；副词为periodically。

senses.en: Happening or found often enough to seem ordinary.
Something ordinary, or a familiar statement lacking originality.

ex.en: Our professor circled increasingly commonplace on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了越来越常见。

ex.en: The reading connects increasingly commonplace with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把越来越常见和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 多指常见到不足为奇，不一定含贬义。

senses.en: Giving benefits or improving the chances of success

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on mutually advantageous.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论互惠互利的。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mutually advantageous.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论互惠互利的的材料。

tip: 常用be advantageous to sb表示对某人有利。

senses.en: Showing kindness by choosing not to punish or hurt someone.
Providing welcome relief from suffering or discomfort.

ex.en: Office hours began with a merciful judge.
ex.zh: 答疑从宽大的法官开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a merciful judge.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得宽大的法官这个例子。

col: be merciful to someone｜对某人仁慈
a merciful release｜令人解脱的结束
tip: 对某人仁慈用be merciful to someone。

senses.en: someone who gives public talks about religious beliefs
someone who strongly promotes particular beliefs or behaviour

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a local preacher.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于当地布道者的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a local preacher.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论当地布道者的材料。

col: a preacher of peace｜和平的倡导者
tip: preacher侧重讲道，missionary侧重传播宗教。

senses.en: Likely or willing to think or act a certain way.
Sloping rather than horizontal or vertical.

ex.en: I copied an inclined plane into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把斜面抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used an inclined plane to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用斜面来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: be inclined to agree｜倾向于同意
tip: be inclined to后接动词原形，表示倾向或意愿。

senses.en: A country's independent authority to govern itself.

ex.en: The textbook introduces national sovereignty in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了国家主权。

ex.en: A campus survey used national sovereignty to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用国家主权来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 通常不可数；对某领土的主权用over连接。

senses.en: To reproduce conditions or processes for testing, training, or study.
To pretend to have a feeling or condition.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to simulate conditions.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何模拟条件。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to simulate conditions.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得模拟条件。

col: simulate an emergency｜模拟紧急情况
simulate the effects of｜模拟……的影响
tip: 模拟环境用simulate；刺激发展用stimulate。

senses.en: to start a line further inward than the surrounding lines
to make a hollow or notch in a surface

ex.en: I heard the lecturer indent a paragraph during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时缩进段落。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to indent a paragraph.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们缩进段落。

col: indent the first line｜缩进首行
tip: 指行首向内移动，不是把整行内容缩短。

senses.en: a system of beliefs shaping political or social views

ex.en: I copied political ideology into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把政治意识形态抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects political ideology with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把政治意识形态和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: share an ideology｜持有共同理念
tip: 指成体系的社会或政治观念，不是单个想法。

senses.en: a social rule against discussing or doing something
considered unacceptable to discuss or do within a particular group

ex.en: I copied a taboo subject into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把忌讳的话题抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a taboo subject.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕忌讳的话题展开说明。

tip: 名词指禁忌；形容词可说a taboo subject。

senses.en: to strengthen a place or structure against attack or damage
to make someone physically or mentally stronger
to add nutrients to food to improve its nutritional value

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to fortify coastal defences.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何加强海岸防御。

ex.en: When the class discussed public health, the speaker told us to fortify coastal defences.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共卫生时，讲者让我们加强海岸防御。

col: fortify coastal defences｜加强海岸防御
fortify food with vitamins｜给食品添加维生素
fortify yourself against｜增强自身力量以抵御
tip: fortify A with B：用B增强A。

senses.en: A machine or structure that burns waste at high temperatures

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about waste incinerator.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于垃圾焚烧炉的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used waste incinerator to explain a pattern in environmental policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用垃圾焚烧炉来解释环境政策中的一种模式。

tip: 通常指废物焚烧炉；火葬场用crematorium。

senses.en: highest in rank, authority, or importance
of the greatest possible degree

ex.en: Our professor circled supreme court on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了最高法院。

ex.en: The author returns to supreme court when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了最高法院。

tip: 本身含“最高”之意，通常不用比较级或最高级。

senses.en: confidence and willingness to take risks or challenge expectations
the quality of being visually strong and noticeable

ex.en: Office hours began with political boldness.
ex.zh: 答疑从政治勇气开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used political boldness to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用政治勇气来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: the boldness of the colours｜色彩的鲜明
tip: 可指行动大胆，也可指设计或色彩醒目。

senses.en: using careful examination of details to understand something

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on analytic approach.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论分析方法。

ex.en: The reading connects analytic approach with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把分析方法和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 与analytical意思接近；日常描述分析能力更常用后者。

senses.en: A difference between things that should match.

ex.en: I copied a significant discrepancy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把显著差异抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a significant discrepancy with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把显著差异和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常指本应一致却不符，搭配 between 或 in。

senses.en: the process of making a sound or signal stronger
an increase in the strength or effect of something

ex.en: Our professor circled sound amplification on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了扩音。

ex.en: A campus survey used sound amplification to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用扩音来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: 常指声音、信号的增强，也可指影响被放大。

senses.en: Greater importance that gives someone or something priority over others.

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize precedence in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出优先权。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up precedence while discussing evidence about public institutions.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共制度的证据时提到了优先权。

tip: 常用take precedence over，表示优先于。

senses.en: The power to evoke shared feelings, memories, or understanding.
The deep, full quality of a sound.
Stronger vibration caused by matching an object's natural frequency.

ex.en: Our professor circled emotional resonance on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了情感共鸣。

ex.en: The reading connects emotional resonance with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把情感共鸣和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 情感义常用have resonance for；物理义指共振。

senses.en: Showing that you are sorry for something.

ex.en: I copied an apologetic smile into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把歉意的微笑抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an apologetic smile.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕歉意的微笑展开说明。

tip: 常接about或for说明歉意的缘由。

senses.en: a medical examination of a body to determine death's cause
an examination of a completed event, especially an unsuccessful one
happening or performed after death

ex.en: Office hours began with postmortem examination.
ex.zh: 答疑从尸体检验开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around postmortem examination.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕尸体检验展开说明。

tip: 英式也常写post-mortem；可比喻赛后或项目复盘。

senses.en: to confirm officially that something is true or meets standards

ex.en: The assignment is to certify that, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先正式证明……，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers certify that before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要正式证明……。

col: certified organic｜经认证的有机产品
tip: 强调正式或权威证明，常用certify that从句。

senses.en: to become stronger or make a feeling or effect stronger

ex.en: The lab instructions say to heighten awareness.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求提高意识。

ex.en: The reading asks you to heighten awareness and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你提高意识，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 多用于情绪、意识或效果增强，不常指身高增长。

senses.en: To publicly support a policy, idea, or course of action.
Someone who publicly supports a cause or policy.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to advocate reform.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何提倡改革。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to advocate reform.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们提倡改革。

col: a strong advocate of｜……的坚定支持者
tip: 名词末尾读/kət/；动词可接动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: An adult female tiger.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a wild tigress in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了野生雌虎。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a wild tigress.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕野生雌虎展开说明。

col: a tigress and her cubs｜母虎和它的幼崽
tip: tigress专指雌虎；tiger可泛指老虎，不一定是雄虎。

senses.en: A natural ability to learn or do something well

ex.en: The textbook introduces an aptitude for languages in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了语言天赋。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an aptitude for languages.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕语言天赋展开说明。

col: an aptitude for languages｜语言天赋
show an aptitude for｜展现出某方面的天赋
tip: 常用aptitude for，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to make someone feel deeply ashamed or foolish

ex.en: The assignment is to humiliate someone publicly, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先公开羞辱某人，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers humiliate someone publicly before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要公开羞辱某人。

col: humiliate someone publicly｜公开羞辱某人
tip: 比embarrass语气更重，强调受辱和尊严受损。

senses.en: Careful examination of something, especially to find faults or problems.

ex.en: The textbook introduces public scrutiny in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了公众监督。

ex.en: The author returns to public scrutiny when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公众监督。

tip: 不可数名词；under scrutiny表示受到严格审查。

senses.en: an animal, such as a frog, living in water and on land
a vehicle or aircraft able to operate on land and water

ex.en: The textbook introduces amphibian species in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了两栖动物物种。

ex.en: A campus survey used amphibian species to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用两栖动物物种来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 动物名词用amphibian；两栖的常用amphibious。

senses.en: The process of making something stronger or more effective.
Encouragement that makes a behaviour more likely to happen again.
Extra people sent to support an existing group or force.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on positive reinforcement.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论正向强化。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around positive reinforcement.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕正向强化展开说明。

tip: 表示援军、增援人员时通常用复数reinforcements。

senses.en: To invent false information in order to deceive
To make a product or structure from separate materials

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to fabricate evidence.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须伪造证据。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to fabricate evidence.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得伪造证据。

tip: 既可指捏造信息，也可指工业制造，须看宾语。

senses.en: Feeling, showing, or causing deep sadness.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about sorrowful expression.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于悲伤的表情的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around sorrowful expression.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕悲伤的表情展开说明。

tip: 比sad更正式，常用于表情、声音或告别。

senses.en: to commit more money or effort than can be managed

ex.en: The assignment is to overextend yourself, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先使自己负担过重，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The passage says students who can overextend yourself follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够使自己负担过重的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: overextend financially｜在财务上超出承受能力
tip: 常用 overextend oneself，指承担超出能力的任务或开支。

senses.en: a departure from an expected route, rule, or behaviour
the difference between a measurement and a reference value

ex.en: Our professor circled standard deviation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了标准差。

ex.en: A campus survey used standard deviation to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用标准差来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: deviation from the norm｜偏离常态
tip: 常用 deviation from；standard deviation 是“标准差”。

senses.en: The scientific study of light and how it behaves

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about geometrical optics.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于几何光学的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around geometrical optics.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕几何光学展开说明。

tip: 表示光学这门学科时，虽以s结尾仍接单数谓语。

senses.en: A mistake caused by failing to notice or consider something.
Responsibility for checking that activities are managed correctly.

ex.en: Office hours began with an unfortunate oversight.
ex.zh: 答疑从令人遗憾的疏忽开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an unfortunate oversight.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论令人遗憾的疏忽的材料。

col: an unfortunate oversight｜令人遗憾的疏忽
tip: 作“疏忽”通常可数；作“监督”通常不可数。

senses.en: Relating to time or the order of events.
Relating to worldly affairs rather than spiritual matters.
Relating to the sides of the head near the temples.

ex.en: The textbook introduces temporal order in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了时间顺序。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of temporal order.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得时间顺序这个例子。

tip: temporal指时间的；temporary才表示暂时的。

senses.en: unnecessary because it is no longer needed or repeats something
having lost a job because the employer no longer needs it

ex.en: Our professor circled redundant information on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了多余信息。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of redundant information.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得多余信息这个例子。

tip: 英式英语中be made redundant指岗位取消而被裁员。

senses.en: morally right or acting according to strong moral principles
arising from a belief that you are morally right

ex.en: I copied righteous anger into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把义愤抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss righteous anger.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论义愤的材料。

tip: 语气较庄重；self-righteous指自以为正直。

senses.en: less strict or severe when enforcing rules or giving punishment

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a lenient sentence.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论从轻的判刑。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a lenient sentence.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得从轻的判刑这个例子。

tip: 对人宽容用lenient with；常涉及规则或处罚。

senses.en: To put something at risk of harm, loss, or failure.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to jeopardise safety.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须危及安全。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to jeopardise safety.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们危及安全。

col: jeopardise a career｜损害职业前途
tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；美式通常拼作jeopardize。

senses.en: Rise and fall irregularly in level, amount, or value.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer fluctuate widely during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时大幅波动。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to fluctuate widely.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们大幅波动。

tip: 通常是不及物动词；在两值间波动用between。

senses.en: The practice of following a rule, law, or custom
A ceremony performed as part of religion or tradition

ex.en: I copied strict observance into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把严格遵守抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of strict observance.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得严格遵守这个例子。

tip: observance指遵守或仪式；observation指观察。

senses.en: expressing a meaning opposite to the words used
strangely opposite to what would normally be expected

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about an ironical remark.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于反讽的话的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects an ironical remark with a larger point about public communication.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把反讽的话和关于公共传播的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an ironical twist｜讽刺性的转折
tip: 与ironic基本同义，但ironic更常用；不一定含恶意。

senses.en: To spread out or make people or things spread out

ex.en: The lab instructions say to disperse a crowd.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求驱散人群。

ex.en: The passage says students who can disperse a crowd follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够驱散人群的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 既可及物也可不及物：驱散人群或人群散去。

senses.en: an organism such as a mushroom, mould, or yeast

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on soil fungus.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论土壤真菌。

ex.en: The reading connects soil fungus with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把土壤真菌和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 复数常用fungi；真菌不属于植物。

senses.en: an idea accepted as the basis for reasoning or action
the buildings and land used by a business or organization

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on basic premise.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论基本前提。

ex.en: The reading connects basic premise with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把基本前提和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: on the premise that｜以……为前提
tip: 表示房屋及场地时用复数premises。

senses.en: the state of containing no unwanted or harmful substances
the quality of being morally good or unmixed in character

ex.en: I copied water purity into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把水的纯净度抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used water purity to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用水的纯净度来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 不可数名词；表示具体纯度常用the purity of。

senses.en: The freedom or right to make decisions independently.

ex.en: I copied greater autonomy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把更大的自主权抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used greater autonomy to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用更大的自主权来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 通常不可数；既指地区自治，也指个人或机构自主。

senses.en: Practical knowledge and skills needed to do something successfully

ex.en: After the lecture, we used know-how in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了实用技能。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses know-how when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了实用技能。

tip: 不可数名词，强调实际操作能力，拼写保留连字符。

senses.en: Quick and energetic.

senses.zh: 生意兴隆的；交易活跃的
senses.en: Involving a lot of buying and selling.
Cold and fresh in a pleasant, energising way.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a brisk walk.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论快步行走。

ex.en: In the lecture on public health, everyone remembered the example of a brisk walk.
ex.zh: 在关于公共卫生的讲座里，大家都记得快步行走这个例子。

tip: brisk walk指轻快有力的快走，不是跑步。

senses.en: A substance made of large molecules containing repeated smaller units.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on synthetic polymer.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论合成聚合物。

ex.en: The reading connects synthetic polymer with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把合成聚合物和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: biodegradable polymer｜可生物降解聚合物
tip: 聚合物不只包括塑料，也包括淀粉等天然物质。

senses.zh: 地道的；符合语言习惯的
senses.en: natural and typical of how fluent speakers use a language
containing or relating to expressions with nonliteral meanings

ex.en: Office hours began with idiomatic English.
ex.zh: 答疑从地道的英语开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used idiomatic English to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用地道的英语来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 地道不等于堆砌习语；自然搭配也体现idiomatic。

senses.en: To replace something older or no longer useful.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to supersede existing rules.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求取代现有规则。

ex.en: The reading asks you to supersede existing rules and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你取代现有规则，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: supersede existing rules｜取代现有规则
supersede earlier versions｜取代早期版本
tip: 注意拼写结尾是-sede，不是-cede；常用被动式。

senses.en: an official count of people that collects information about them

ex.en: The textbook introduces a national census in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了全国人口普查。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a national census.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕全国人口普查展开说明。

col: conduct a census｜开展人口普查
a national census｜全国人口普查
tip: census调查全部人口，sample survey只抽样。

senses.en: A hard, silvery metal used in alloys and batteries.
A coin worth five cents in the US or Canada.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about nickel mining.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于镍矿开采的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used nickel mining to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用镍矿开采来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 指金属时不可数；指五分硬币时可数。

senses.en: An action that breaks a law or violates someone's rights.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on copyright infringement.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论侵犯版权。

ex.en: The author returns to copyright infringement when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了侵犯版权。

tip: 常接of；infringement of rights指侵犯权利。

senses.en: To improve something by adding value, interest, or experience.
To make someone wealthier.
To improve food or soil by adding useful substances.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to enrich people's lives.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何丰富人们的生活。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to enrich people's lives.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来丰富人们的生活。

col: enrich people's lives｜丰富人们的生活
tip: enrich是及物动词，常接life、experience或soil。

senses.zh: 极其巨大的；天文数字的
senses.en: Extremely large, especially when describing prices, costs, or amounts.
Relating to the scientific study of stars, planets, and space.

ex.en: Office hours began with astronomical costs.
ex.zh: 答疑从巨额成本开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss astronomical costs.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论巨额成本的材料。

col: astronomical sums｜天文数字般的金额
tip: 谈费用时常表示高得惊人；也可表示天文学的。

senses.en: Having a bad reputation and not deserving trust or respect.
Looking untidy, worn, or unsuitable for respectable company.

ex.en: The textbook introduces disreputable company in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了名声不佳的公司。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss disreputable company.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论名声不佳的公司的材料。

tip: 通常指名声或行为不佳，不只是外表破旧。

senses.en: likely to attack or cause serious harm
deliberately cruel and intended to hurt someone

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on vicious attack.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论凶残的袭击。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around vicious attack.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕凶残的袭击展开说明。

tip: vicious circle指问题互相加剧的“恶性循环”。

senses.en: Worry intensely while trying to make a difficult decision

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to agonize over a decision.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何为决定而苦恼。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers agonize over a decision before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要为决定而苦恼。

col: agonize over a decision｜为决定而苦恼
agonize about the future｜为未来焦虑
tip: 常用agonize over/about；英式也拼作agonise。

senses.en: The force or process that moves something forward

ex.en: Office hours began with electric propulsion.
ex.zh: 答疑从电力推进开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of electric propulsion.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得电力推进这个例子。

tip: 通常为不可数名词，常用于船舶、飞机和航天器。

senses.en: friendly and peaceful, without conflict
having parts that look or sound pleasing together

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about harmonious relationship.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于融洽的关系的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of harmonious relationship.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得融洽的关系这个例子。

tip: 既可形容人际关系融洽，也可形容色彩、声音协调。

senses.en: Relating to hearing or the sense of hearing

ex.en: The textbook introduces aural skills in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了听辨能力。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of aural skills.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得听辨能力这个例子。

tip: aural指听觉的；oral指口头的或口腔的。

senses.en: To make someone seem foolish by laughing at or imitating them.
Made to imitate something real, often for practice.
A practice examination taken before the real one.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to mock someone's accent.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须嘲笑某人的口音。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to mock someone's accent.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来嘲笑某人的口音。

col: mock someone's accent｜嘲笑某人的口音
tip: mock作动词直接接宾语，不加at。

senses.en: Physical or mental effort, especially when it makes you tired.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about physical exertion.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于体力消耗的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around physical exertion.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕体力消耗展开说明。

tip: 多指消耗体力或脑力，不等同于表示尽力的try hard。

senses.en: Acts intended to destroy a national, ethnic, racial, or religious group.

ex.en: Office hours began with commit genocide.
ex.zh: 答疑从实施种族灭绝开始。

ex.en: The reading connects commit genocide with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把实施种族灭绝和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: victims of genocide｜种族灭绝的受害者
tip: 不泛指大规模杀戮，核心是蓄意毁灭特定群体。

senses.zh: 会犯错的；不完全可靠的
senses.en: Capable of making mistakes or being wrong

ex.en: I copied fallible human judgement into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把可能出错的人类判断抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fallible human judgement.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论可能出错的人类判断的材料。

col: fallible human judgement｜可能出错的人类判断
a fallible system｜不完全可靠的系统
tip: 强调可能犯错，并非一定错误；反义词为infallible。

senses.en: to conduct business or carry out a business deal

ex.en: The assignment is to transact business, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先办理业务，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers transact business before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要办理业务。

tip: 正式用语，常用transact business表示开展业务。

senses.en: To make an achievement, position, or skill stronger.
To combine separate things into a single effective whole.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to consolidate knowledge.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须巩固知识。

ex.en: The passage says students who can consolidate knowledge follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够巩固知识的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 既可指巩固已有成果，也可指合并多个部分。

senses.en: Animal waste used to improve soil and help plants grow.
To spread animal waste on land as fertilizer.

ex.en: Office hours began with animal manure.
ex.zh: 答疑从动物粪肥开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of animal manure.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得动物粪肥这个例子。

tip: 名词通常不可数；fertilizer泛指肥料，范围更广。

senses.en: Best or most effective for a particular purpose.

ex.en: I copied optimal conditions into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把最佳条件抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of optimal conditions.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得最佳条件这个例子。

tip: 已含“最佳”之意，通常不再用 most 修饰。

senses.en: In a determined way, without giving up or changing course

ex.en: The professor told us to resolutely oppose and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们坚决反对，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will resolutely oppose when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会坚决反对。

tip: 这是副词；形容词形式为resolute。

senses.en: to keep returning to someone's mind and causing distress
for a ghost to appear repeatedly in a place
a place someone visits frequently

ex.en: I heard the lecturer haunt an old house during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时在老房子里出没。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers haunt an old house before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要在老房子里出没。

col: be haunted by memories｜被回忆困扰
haunt an old house｜在老房子里出没
a favourite haunt｜最爱常去的地方
tip: 作动词直接接宾语；be haunted by表示受困扰。

senses.en: to have particular people or things as parts
to be the parts or members that form something

ex.en: I heard the lecturer comprise several sections during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时包含几个部分。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to comprise several sections.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们包含几个部分。

col: comprise several sections｜包含几个部分
comprise a range of services｜涵盖一系列服务
tip: 最稳妥结构：整体comprises部分，不加of。

senses.en: people who belong to a royal family
a payment for using someone's work, invention, or property

ex.en: I copied a member of royalty into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把王室成员抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a member of royalty.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得王室成员这个例子。

col: a member of royalty｜王室成员
tip: 指王族时不可数；指版税收入时常用复数royalties。

senses.en: To die or be destroyed, especially in harsh conditions.
To decay or lose strength and flexibility over time.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to perish from cold.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须冻死。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers perish from cold before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要冻死。

col: perish in a fire｜在火灾中丧生
tip: 通常是不及物动词；英式英语也用于橡胶等老化。

senses.en: able to be moved or passed to another person or place
useful in different jobs or situations

ex.en: Our professor circled transferable skills on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可迁移技能。

ex.en: The author returns to transferable skills when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了可迁移技能。

tip: transferable skills 指换岗位或行业仍适用的技能。

senses.en: a bad habit or morally wrong behaviour
a tool that holds an object firmly between two jaws

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a minor vice.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论小恶习。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a minor vice.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得小恶习这个例子。

tip: 台钳在美式英语中拼作vise；副主席中的vice-是前缀。

senses.en: a passage through which air reaches the lungs
an established route used by aircraft

ex.en: I copied upper airway into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把上呼吸道抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used upper airway to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用上呼吸道来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

col: keep the airway clear｜保持气道通畅
tip: 常指呼吸道；航线义较专业，勿与airline混淆。

senses.en: to force someone to do something

ex.en: The lab instructions say to compel someone to act.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求迫使某人行动。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to compel someone to act.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们迫使某人行动。

col: compel someone to act｜迫使某人行动
be compelled by circumstances｜为形势所迫
tip: 常用compel sb to do，语气强且较正式。

senses.en: Force people to leave their homes or usual surroundings.
Take the position or role previously held by something else.
Move something from its position, especially by occupying its space.

ex.en: The assignment is to displace workers, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先取代工人，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to displace workers.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得取代工人。

tip: displace常指被迫迁离；也可指新事物取代旧事物。

senses.en: To attract someone by offering something appealing, sometimes deceptively.
An attraction or object used to draw someone or something closer.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to lure customers.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求吸引顾客。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to lure customers.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得吸引顾客。

col: lure someone into doing something｜诱使某人做某事
the lure of wealth｜财富的诱惑
tip: 常用lure sb into doing，往往暗含诱骗意味。

senses.en: An officer holding a junior rank in the armed forces
A trusted assistant who helps a leader manage important work

ex.en: Our professor circled army lieutenant on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了陆军中尉。

ex.en: A campus survey used army lieutenant to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用陆军中尉来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 英式开头读/lef/，美式读/luː/；军衔译名因军种而异。

senses.en: The gradual gathering of something, or the amount gathered.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on gradual accumulation.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论逐渐积累。

ex.en: The reading connects gradual accumulation with a larger point about environmental policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把逐渐积累和关于环境政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常接of，强调随时间逐渐增多。

senses.en: a statement about the future, often claiming supernatural knowledge
the supposed ability to know and describe future events

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a self-fulfilling prophecy.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论自我实现的预言。

ex.en: The reading connects a self-fulfilling prophecy with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把自我实现的预言和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a self-fulfilling prophecy｜自我实现的预言
the gift of prophecy｜预言天赋
tip: prophecy是名词；动词prophesy词尾读/saɪ/。

senses.en: A belief or set of principles taught by a group.

ex.en: Office hours began with religious doctrine.
ex.zh: 答疑从宗教教义开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around religious doctrine.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕宗教教义展开说明。

tip: 不一定含贬义；可指宗教教义或政治、经济学说。

senses.en: calm and peaceful, without noise or disturbance

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a tranquil setting.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于宁静的环境的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a tranquil setting to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用宁静的环境来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 常描写环境或水面，比 quiet 更强调安宁感。

senses.en: To grow strongly or become successful.

ex.en: The professor asked us to thrive in warm conditions.
ex.zh: 教授让我们在温暖环境中茁壮成长。

ex.en: The reading asks you to thrive in warm conditions and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你在温暖环境中茁壮成长，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: thrive in warm conditions｜在温暖环境中茁壮成长
thrive on challenges｜遇到挑战更有干劲
a thriving business｜生意兴隆的企业
tip: 不及物动词；thrive on表示因某事而更有活力。

senses.en: Something that encourages activity, growth, or change.
Something that causes a physical or mental response.

ex.en: I copied economic stimulus into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把经济刺激抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss economic stimulus.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济刺激的材料。

col: a stimulus to growth｜促进增长的因素
respond to a stimulus｜对刺激作出反应
tip: 复数是stimuli；stimulus to中的to是介词。

senses.en: Easily upset or offended, especially by criticism.
Likely to cause upset or disagreement unless handled carefully.

ex.en: Office hours began with touchy about criticism.
ex.zh: 答疑从对批评很敏感开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used touchy about criticism to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用对批评很敏感来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: touchy about criticism｜对批评很敏感
a touchy issue｜棘手的敏感问题
tip: touchy指易生气；touched指受感动。

senses.en: The skill and quality shown in making something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fine workmanship.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论精细的做工。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fine workmanship.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕精细的做工展开说明。

tip: 不可数名词，强调成品的做工，而非工作态度。

senses.en: to gather and arrange people, resources, or ideas effectively
someone who directs people and maintains order at an event
a military officer holding a very high rank

ex.en: The assignment is to marshal resources, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先调集资源，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to marshal resources and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你调集资源，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 英式过去式marshalled，美式marshaled；勿混淆martial。

senses.en: relating to medicines or their production
a drug used as medicine

ex.en: The textbook introduces pharmaceutical industry in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了制药业。

ex.en: The author returns to pharmaceutical industry when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了制药业。

tip: 作名词常用复数 pharmaceuticals，泛指药品。

senses.en: offering little hope of improvement or success
cold, bare, and unwelcoming

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on bleak future.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论黯淡的未来。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss bleak future.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论黯淡的未来的材料。

tip: 既可描述荒凉阴冷的环境，也可描述无望的前景。

senses.en: Very tired, especially after prolonged effort
No longer interested in something because it continues too long
To make someone tired or become tired of something

ex.en: The textbook introduces grow weary in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了渐感疲倦。

ex.en: A campus survey used grow weary to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用渐感疲倦来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

tip: weary是疲倦的；wary是警惕的，注意拼写。

senses.en: A layer that covers a surface or area
The thick layer of Earth between its crust and core
An important role or responsibility passed to someone

ex.en: The textbook introduces Earth's mantle in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了地幔。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around Earth's mantle.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕地幔展开说明。

col: a mantle of snow｜一层积雪
assume the mantle of｜承担……的职责
tip: mantle也可指披风；壁炉架通常拼作mantel。

senses.en: used in or connected with a formal public ceremony

ex.en: Office hours began with ceremonial dress.
ex.zh: 答疑从礼仪服饰开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of ceremonial dress.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得礼仪服饰这个例子。

tip: ceremonial重在仪式用途；ceremonious指礼节隆重。

senses.en: Relating to the moon.
Based on the changing phases of the moon.

ex.en: The textbook introduces lunar eclipse in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了月食。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of lunar eclipse.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得月食这个例子。

tip: lunar指月亮的；solar指太阳的。

senses.en: to manage an organization or put a system into operation
to give someone medicine or medical treatment

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to administer a programme.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何管理项目。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to administer a programme.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得管理项目。

tip: 给某人用药可说administer medicine to someone。

senses.en: The chemical process of burning, which releases heat.

ex.en: The textbook introduces fuel combustion in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了燃料燃烧。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss fuel combustion.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论燃料燃烧的材料。

tip: 通常不可数，是burning的科技语体表达。

senses.en: Having no name, or having a name that remains unknown
Too difficult to identify or describe clearly

ex.en: Our professor circled nameless fear on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了莫名的恐惧。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of nameless fear.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得莫名的恐惧这个例子。

tip: remain nameless指不透露姓名，不一定真的没名字。

senses.en: an event causing extremely serious damage or suffering

ex.en: Our professor circled environmental catastrophe on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了环境灾难。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of environmental catastrophe.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得环境灾难这个例子。

col: avert a catastrophe｜避免一场灾难
tip: 比一般problem严重，常指损失惨重的灾难。

senses.en: a ring of flowers or leaves used decoratively or ceremonially

ex.en: The textbook introduces laurel wreath in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了月桂花冠。

ex.en: The author returns to laurel wreath when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了月桂花冠。

col: a wreath of flowers｜鲜花编成的花环
tip: w不发音；复数wreaths；动词另用wreathe。

senses.en: Clear enough for written or printed words to be read.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about clearly legible.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于清晰可辨的的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used clearly legible to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用清晰可辨的来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: legible强调字形可辨；readable也可指内容易读。

senses.en: kind and polite, especially when treating others generously
elegant, comfortable, and associated with wealth

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a gracious host.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论热情有礼的主人。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a gracious host.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得热情有礼的主人这个例子。

col: a gracious host｜热情有礼的主人
gracious in defeat｜落败仍有风度
tip: gracious重待人有礼；graceful重动作优美。

senses.en: A person who works on a ship at sea.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an experienced seaman.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经验丰富的海员。

ex.en: The author returns to an experienced seaman when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经验丰富的海员。

col: an experienced seaman｜经验丰富的海员
tip: 复数为seamen；seafarer是常用的性别中性称呼。

senses.en: requiring considerable effort and sustained hard work

ex.en: The textbook introduces an arduous task in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了艰巨的任务。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an arduous task.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论艰巨的任务的材料。

tip: 强调长期费力，常修饰task、journey、process。

senses.en: in a clear and direct way that leaves no doubt
for a particular purpose

ex.en: The professor told us to expressly prohibit and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们明令禁止，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: A lecture on public institutions asks the class to expressly prohibit before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于公共制度的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先明令禁止。

tip: 勿与expressively混淆，后者指富有表现力地。

senses.en: an idea accepted as true without enough evidence

ex.en: The textbook introduces mere supposition in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了纯属推测。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss mere supposition.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论纯属推测的材料。

tip: 可指一个假设，也可泛指推测；不等于已证实的事实。

senses.en: Relating to heat
Designed to keep heat from escaping
A rising current of warm air

ex.en: I copied thermal energy into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把热能抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of thermal energy.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得热能这个例子。

tip: thermal可指与热有关，也可指衣物保暖。

senses.en: To recognize or explain the differences between things
To make something different from other similar things

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to differentiate between.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何区分两者。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to differentiate between.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们区分两者。

col: differentiate A from B｜区分甲与乙
tip: 常用differentiate between A and B。

senses.en: To decorate cloth by sewing patterns with thread.
To make a story more interesting by adding invented details.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer embroider a pattern during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时绣图案。

ex.en: When the class discussed the humanities, the speaker told us to embroider a pattern.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人文学科时，讲者让我们绣图案。

col: embroider flowers on cloth｜在布上绣花
embroider with silk thread｜用丝线刺绣
embroider a story｜给故事添油加醋
tip: embroider是在布上绣花，不是用毛线织物的knit。

senses.en: A decorative picture made by cutting shapes from paper

ex.en: Office hours began with a traditional papercut.
ex.zh: 答疑从传统剪纸作品开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used a traditional papercut to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用传统剪纸作品来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

col: a traditional papercut｜传统剪纸作品
an intricate papercut｜精细的剪纸作品
tip: 剪纸艺术常用papercutting；纸划伤通常写paper cut。

senses.en: Consisting of parts or people that are all similar

ex.en: Office hours began with relatively homogeneous.
ex.zh: 答疑从相对同质的开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around relatively homogeneous.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕相对同质的展开说明。

tip: 强调组成部分相似或一致，反义词为heterogeneous。

senses.en: Beliefs and principles about what is right and wrong
The degree to which an action is right or wrong

ex.en: The textbook introduces public morality in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了社会公德。

ex.en: The reading connects public morality with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把社会公德和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the morality of an action｜某一行为的道德性
tip: moral是形容词；morality是名词，常为不可数。

senses.en: General agreement among members of a group.

ex.en: The textbook introduces broad consensus in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了广泛共识。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of broad consensus.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得广泛共识这个例子。

tip: 常用reach a consensus on；共识未必全票一致。

senses.en: A woman having a relationship with someone married to another person.
A woman who owns or controls a household, in older usage.
A woman highly skilled in a particular activity.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used mistress in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了情妇。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses mistress when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了情妇。

col: mistress of the house｜一家之女主人
mistress of her craft｜精通技艺的女性
tip: 不可当作妻子或普通女友；女主人义较陈旧。

senses.en: A strong-smelling gas also dissolved in water for cleaning.

ex.en: I copied ammonia solution into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把氨水抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss ammonia solution.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论氨水的材料。

tip: 不可数名词；既可指氨气，也可指氨水。

senses.en: Loyalty and support given to a country, group, or leader.

ex.en: The textbook introduces political allegiance in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了政治上的效忠。

ex.en: A campus survey used political allegiance to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用政治上的效忠来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

tip: 效忠对象用to引出：allegiance to a country。

senses.en: extreme tiredness caused by effort, stress, or illness
weakening of a material after repeated stress

ex.en: Office hours began with chronic fatigue.
ex.zh: 答疑从慢性疲劳开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss chronic fatigue.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论慢性疲劳的材料。

tip: 通常为不可数名词，比tiredness更正式。

senses.en: Giving information that makes something easier to understand.

ex.en: Office hours began with explanatory notes.
ex.zh: 答疑从说明性注释开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around explanatory notes.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕说明性注释展开说明。

tip: 常修饰notes、material；self-explanatory指不言自明的。

senses.en: to begin something or start happening

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to commence work.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何开始工作。

ex.en: The passage says students who can commence work follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够开始工作的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 比start正式；可接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Impressive language that may lack sincerity or practical substance.
The skill or study of using language to persuade.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about empty rhetoric.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于空洞的言辞的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used empty rhetoric to explain a pattern in public communication.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用空洞的言辞来解释公共传播中的一种模式。

col: the art of rhetoric｜修辞艺术
tip: 是名词；形容词为rhetorical，可含贬义。

senses.en: A stated reason that hides someone's real purpose.

ex.en: The professor explained pretext with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了借口。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses pretext when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了借口。

col: under the pretext of｜以……为借口
a pretext for doing something｜做某事的借口
tip: 强调掩盖真实目的的借口；常接for或of。

senses.en: To jump suddenly towards something to catch or attack it.
To seize an opportunity or criticise a mistake immediately.
A sudden jump towards something to catch or attack it.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to pounce on prey.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须猛扑向猎物。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to pounce on prey.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来猛扑向猎物。

col: pounce on an opportunity｜立即抓住机会
pounce on a mistake｜揪住错误不放
tip: 常接on，既可指猛扑，也可指抓住机会或错误。

senses.en: Introducing important new ideas or methods before others.

ex.en: Office hours began with pioneering research.
ex.zh: 答疑从开创性研究开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of pioneering research.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得开创性研究这个例子。

tip: 通常作形容词；指先驱人物用名词pioneer。

senses.en: A task or project, especially one requiring considerable effort.
A formal promise to do something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a major undertaking.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论重大任务。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a major undertaking.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕重大任务展开说明。

col: a joint undertaking｜共同承担的项目
give an undertaking｜作出正式承诺
tip: 作“承诺”时常用give an undertaking to do。

senses.en: to stop something from having an effect
to make an acid or alkali chemically neutral

ex.en: The assignment is to neutralize an acid, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先中和酸，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to neutralize an acid.
ex.zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们中和酸。

tip: 英式也拼neutralise；强调抵消作用，不一定移除物体。

senses.en: A strong hope or ambition to achieve something.
A breath of air released when pronouncing certain speech sounds.

ex.en: Office hours began with aspiration to succeed.
ex.zh: 答疑从成功的志向开始。

ex.en: The reading connects aspiration to succeed with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把成功的志向和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 抱负义常用复数；aspiration to do表示做某事的志向。

senses.en: an idea or understanding of what something is like
the process in which an egg is fertilised, beginning pregnancy
the formation of a plan or idea

ex.en: I copied a broad conception into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把宽泛的理解抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a broad conception.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕宽泛的理解展开说明。

col: from conception to completion｜从构思到完成
the moment of conception｜受孕时刻
tip: conception of指对事物的理解；也可表示受孕。

senses.en: With care and a strong sense of responsibility.

ex.en: The professor told us to conscientiously carry out duties and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们认真履行职责，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy asks the class to conscientiously carry out duties before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先认真履行职责。

col: conscientiously carry out duties｜认真履行职责
tip: 强调责任心与认真态度，不只是动作小心。

senses.en: A subgroup whose views conflict with others in a larger group.

ex.en: Our professor circled political faction on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了政治派别。

ex.en: The author returns to political faction when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了政治派别。

col: a faction within the party｜党内派系
tip: 常指大组织内意见对立的小集团，尤用于政治。

senses.en: Relating to the earliest known inhabitants of a region
Relating to Australia's Aboriginal peoples, cultures, or languages

ex.en: Office hours began with aboriginal peoples.
ex.zh: 答疑从原住民族开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of aboriginal peoples.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得原住民族这个例子。

col: Aboriginal culture｜澳大利亚原住民文化
Aboriginal communities｜澳大利亚原住民社区
tip: 指澳大利亚原住民时首字母大写；避免单独作名词称人。

senses.en: to balance or reduce the effect of something

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to offset the cost.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须抵消成本。

ex.en: The reading asks you to offset the cost and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你抵消成本，然后再核对第二个来源。

tip: 过去式和过去分词仍为offset；现在分词为offsetting。

senses.en: Suitable for or used for growing crops.

ex.en: I copied arable land into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把耕地抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around arable land.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕耕地展开说明。

tip: 常修饰land；强调可种作物，不指单纯放牧用地。

senses.en: An agreement to stop fighting or arguing for a time

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a temporary truce.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论临时停战。

ex.en: A campus survey used a temporary truce to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用临时停战来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: agree to a truce｜同意停战
break a truce｜破坏休战协议
tip: 通常指暂时停止冲突，不等于永久和平。

senses.zh: 兴高采烈的；热情洋溢的
senses.en: full of energy, excitement, and happiness
growing abundantly or richly decorated and imaginative

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on exuberant enthusiasm.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高涨的热情。

ex.en: The reading connects exuberant enthusiasm with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把高涨的热情和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an exuberant personality｜热情奔放的性格
tip: 核心是活力或丰富程度高，不等于“华而不实”。

senses.en: A compound consisting of oxygen and another chemical element.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on zinc oxide.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论氧化锌。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of zinc oxide.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得氧化锌这个例子。

tip: oxide为氧化物统称，dioxide指二氧化物。

senses.en: write or carve words on an object, often permanently

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to inscribe a name on.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须把名字刻在……上。

ex.en: A lecture on the humanities showed why researchers inscribe a name on before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人文学科的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要把名字刻在……上。

col: inscribe a name on｜把名字刻在……上
tip: 常用inscribe A on B或inscribe B with A，非普通记笔记。

senses.en: A broad statement based on particular cases, sometimes without enough evidence.
The process of forming general conclusions from particular examples.

ex.en: The textbook introduces sweeping generalization in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了过于笼统的论断。

ex.en: The author returns to sweeping generalization when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了过于笼统的论断。

tip: 英式也写 generalisation；概括未必可靠。

senses.en: To move an organ or plant into a new location.
An operation transferring an organ, or the organ transferred.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to transplant seedlings.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求移栽幼苗。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to transplant seedlings.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得移栽幼苗。

tip: 动词重音在后，名词重音在前；既可指器官也可指植物。

senses.en: To support and maintain a principle, right, or standard
To confirm that an earlier decision remains valid

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to uphold the law.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何维护法律。

ex.en: When the class discussed public institutions, the speaker told us to uphold the law.
ex.zh: 全班讨论公共制度时，讲者让我们维护法律。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为upheld；常接权利或裁决。

senses.en: Behaviour that follows accepted rules, standards, or group expectations.

ex.en: Our professor circled social conformity on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了社会从众。

ex.en: The author returns to social conformity when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了社会从众。
