ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论商务信函的材料。

col: correspondence with someone｜与某人的通信
tip: 表示往来信件时不可数；与某人通信用with。

senses.en: to dislike someone or something very strongly

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to detest violence.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须憎恶暴力。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to detest violence.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得憎恶暴力。

tip: 后接名词或动名词：detest doing，不接to do。

senses.en: An act that breaks someone's trust or loyalty.

ex.en: I copied a sense of betrayal into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把被背叛的感觉抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a sense of betrayal.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕被背叛的感觉展开说明。

col: a betrayal of trust｜辜负信任
a sense of betrayal｜被背叛的感觉
an act of betrayal｜背叛行为
tip: 通常指辜负信任；并非一般意义上的“暴露”。

senses.en: Showing love for and pride in your country.

ex.en: The textbook introduces patriotic pride in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了爱国自豪感。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around patriotic pride.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕爱国自豪感展开说明。

tip: patriotic强调爱国，不必然含排斥他国之意。

senses.en: Rude or offensive, especially in language or behaviour.
Lacking good taste, especially through excessive display.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on vulgar language.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论粗俗的语言。

ex.en: A campus survey used vulgar language to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用粗俗的语言来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: vulgar display of wealth｜俗气的炫富行为
tip: 现代常用义带贬义，不宜用来表示“普通的”。

senses.en: Unable to read or write.
Lacking basic knowledge or skills in a particular area.

ex.en: I copied computer illiterate into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把不懂电脑的抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of computer illiterate.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得不懂电脑的这个例子。

tip: 名词用法易显贬义，宜用形容词客观描述。

senses.en: Thinking about something constantly and finding it difficult to stop.

ex.en: I copied obsessive behaviour into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把执念行为抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around obsessive behaviour.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕执念行为展开说明。

col: obsessive about details｜过度纠结细节
tip: 比interested强得多，常含过度、难以自控之意。

senses.en: the act of denying something or stating its opposite
the grammatical expression that something is not true or present

ex.en: The textbook introduces complete negation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了彻底否定。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss complete negation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论彻底否定的材料。

col: negation of a claim｜对某说法的否定
tip: 偏正式；语法中指否定，日常说拒绝多用refusal。

senses.en: Microbial breakdown of sugars into substances such as acids or alcohol.

ex.en: Office hours began with lactic acid fermentation.
ex.zh: 答疑从乳酸发酵开始。

ex.en: The author returns to lactic acid fermentation when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了乳酸发酵。

tip: 通常为不可数名词；动词是ferment。

senses.en: the complete removal of something unwanted or unnecessary
the removal of a competitor from a competition

ex.en: Our professor circled process of elimination on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了排除法。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of process of elimination.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得排除法这个例子。

tip: 动词是eliminate；by elimination表示“用排除法”。

senses.en: Make someone feel unwelcome or unwilling to support you

ex.en: I heard the lecturer alienate voters during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时失去选民的支持。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to alienate voters.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来失去选民的支持。

col: alienate someone from｜使某人与……疏远
tip: 常指使人疏远或失去支持，不表示挪用。

senses.en: A high level of skill or ability in something.

ex.en: I copied language proficiency into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把语言能力抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of language proficiency.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得语言能力这个例子。

col: proficiency in English｜英语熟练程度
tip: 常用proficiency in接语言、学科或技能。

senses.en: Happening or existing as a result of something else.
A single vector equivalent to two or more combined vectors.

ex.en: Our professor circled the resultant damage on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了由此造成的损害。

ex.en: The reading connects the resultant damage with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把由此造成的损害和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the resultant damage｜由此造成的损害
the resultant increase｜由此产生的增长
tip: 较正式，常置于名词前；日常更常用resulting。

senses.en: Relating to how something is built or its parts are arranged.

ex.en: I copied structural damage into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把结构性损坏抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss structural damage.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论结构性损坏的材料。

tip: 既可指建筑结构，也可指经济、制度等的结构。

senses.en: To keep people apart based on race or other characteristics.
To separate things into different groups or locations.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer segregate by race during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时按种族隔离。

ex.en: The reading asks you to segregate by race and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你按种族隔离，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: racially segregated schools｜实行种族隔离的学校
tip: segregate A from B指把A与B隔离。

senses.en: an activity or fashion that becomes extremely popular briefly

ex.en: The textbook introduces the latest craze in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最新热潮。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the latest craze.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论最新热潮的材料。

col: a craze for something｜对某事物的狂热
tip: 强调短期风靡；常用a craze for加名词。

senses.en: very serious and giving little reason for hope
looking very serious, worried, or determined
unpleasant, depressing, or uncomfortable

ex.en: I copied a grim outlook into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把严峻的前景抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to a grim outlook when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了严峻的前景。

col: a grim reminder｜令人警醒的提醒
tip: 常形容前景、现实或表情，强调沉重而非普通的不悦。

senses.en: Someone or something that comes before and influences a later development.
Something that signals the arrival of a later event.

ex.en: Office hours began with an early forerunner.
ex.zh: 答疑从早期先驱开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an early forerunner.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论早期先驱的材料。

tip: 常用a forerunner of；不指比赛中领先的人。

senses.en: A period of one thousand years.
The point when one thousand-year period ends and another begins.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about the past millennium.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于过去的一千年的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the past millennium.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕过去的一千年展开说明。

col: the past millennium｜过去的一千年
the turn of the millennium｜千年之交
tip: 注意双写l和n；复数常用millennia。

senses.en: too old or outdated to be suitable for modern use

ex.en: I copied antiquated equipment into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把陈旧的设备抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used antiquated equipment to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用陈旧的设备来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: 含贬义，强调旧到不合时宜；antique可指珍贵古物。

senses.en: a large military unit or branch with particular duties
an organized group of people doing the same specialized work

ex.en: I copied medical corps into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把军队医疗部队抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss medical corps.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论军队医疗部队的材料。

tip: 单复数拼写相同；单数不读ps，复数词尾读/z/。

senses.en: A place where beer is produced commercially.

ex.en: Office hours began with local brewery.
ex.zh: 答疑从当地啤酒厂开始。

ex.en: The author returns to local brewery when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了当地啤酒厂。

tip: 通常指啤酒厂；葡萄酒庄是winery。

senses.en: To cause a process or activity to begin.
To introduce someone to an activity or admit them to a group.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to initiate negotiations.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求发起谈判。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers initiate negotiations before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要发起谈判。

tip: 作动词较正式；initiate sb into指使入门。

senses.en: A long research paper written as part of a university degree

ex.en: The textbook introduces a doctoral dissertation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了博士论文。

ex.en: The reading connects a doctoral dissertation with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把博士论文和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: write a dissertation｜撰写学位论文
submit a dissertation｜提交学位论文
a dissertation on education｜关于教育的学位论文
tip: 主题用on引出；美式常指博士论文，英式范围较广。

senses.en: To feel or express deep sadness after a death or loss.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to mourn someone's death.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须哀悼某人的去世。

ex.en: The passage says students who can mourn someone's death follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够哀悼某人的去世的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: mourn someone's death｜哀悼某人的去世
mourn the loss of｜为失去……而悲痛
tip: 可直接接逝者或损失，也可用mourn for sb。

senses.en: an office or organisation providing information or managing particular activities
a desk with a folding cover, or an American chest of drawers

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about tourist bureau.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于旅游咨询处的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to tourist bureau when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了旅游咨询处。

tip: 复数可用bureaux或bureaus；家具义有英美差异。

senses.en: Money returned after you pay for something or pay tax

ex.en: The textbook introduces a tax rebate in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了退税。

ex.en: The reading connects a tax rebate with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把退税和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: offer a rebate｜提供返款优惠
tip: rebate通常是付款后返还，discount通常是付款时减价。

senses.en: a device controlling the flow of liquid or gas
a body structure keeping fluid moving in one direction

ex.en: I copied a safety valve into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把安全阀抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a safety valve with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把安全阀和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 工程中指阀门，人体中可指心脏等部位的瓣膜。

senses.en: Move with quick, light movements, especially through air
A quick, light movement or brief uneven heartbeat

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to flutter in the breeze.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须在微风中飘动。

ex.en: The passage says students who can flutter in the breeze follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够在微风中飘动的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: flutter in the breeze｜在微风中飘动
a flutter of excitement｜一阵激动
tip: 强调轻而快的反复运动，可用于翅膀、布料或心跳。

senses.en: A system arranging people or things by rank or importance
The people holding the highest positions in an organisation

ex.en: Our professor circled a rigid hierarchy on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了严格的等级制度。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a rigid hierarchy.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕严格的等级制度展开说明。

col: a rigid hierarchy｜严格的等级制度
a hierarchy of needs｜需求层次
the top of the hierarchy｜等级体系的顶层
tip: 既可指等级结构，也可指组织的最高领导层。

senses.en: Arranged along lines spreading out from a central point.

ex.en: The textbook introduces radial pattern in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了放射状图案。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of radial pattern.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得放射状图案这个例子。

col: radial road network｜放射状道路网
tip: 强调从中心向外延伸，不泛指与光线有关。

senses.en: to make a sound or electrical signal stronger
to increase the strength or effect of something
to explain something further by adding details

ex.en: The lab instructions say to amplify sound.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求放大声音。

ex.en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to amplify sound.
ex.zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们放大声音。

tip: 既可放大实际声音，也可增强影响或情绪。

senses.zh: 积压的工作；待处理订单
senses.en: work or orders waiting to be dealt with

ex.en: Our professor circled a growing backlog on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不断增加的积压。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a growing backlog.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕不断增加的积压展开说明。

col: a backlog of orders｜积压的订单
a growing backlog｜不断增加的积压
tip: 常用a backlog of，指本应处理却积压的事项。

senses.en: An organised attempt by a population to resist those in power.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a popular uprising in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了民众起义。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a popular uprising.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕民众起义展开说明。

tip: 通常指反抗统治者的起义，不用于日常的起床或上升。

senses.en: the quality of being advanced or carefully developed
knowledge of social situations, culture, and fashionable tastes

ex.en: Office hours began with technological sophistication.
ex.zh: 答疑从技术先进程度开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of technological sophistication.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得技术先进程度这个例子。

col: a high degree of sophistication｜高度精密
tip: 不可数名词；既指技术精密，也指处世老练。

senses.en: to punish someone for harm done to yourself or others

ex.en: The professor asked us to avenge a defeat.
ex.zh: 教授让我们一雪败北之耻。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to avenge a defeat.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得一雪败北之耻。

col: avenge a defeat｜一雪败北之耻
avenge a wrong｜报复不公待遇
tip: avenge是动词，常接所受伤害；revenge常作名词。

senses.en: To formally give someone an honour, gift, or benefit.

ex.en: The assignment is to bestow an honour on, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先授予……荣誉，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to bestow an honour on.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得授予……荣誉。

col: bestow an honour on｜授予……荣誉
bestow a title upon｜授予……称号
tip: 正式用语：bestow sth on/upon sb。

senses.en: To strongly disapprove of something or deeply regret it

ex.en: I heard the lecturer deplore violence during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时强烈谴责暴力。

ex.en: The reading asks you to deplore violence and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你强烈谴责暴力，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: deplore the lack of｜对缺乏……深感遗憾
deplore the decision｜强烈反对该决定
tip: 正式及物动词，后直接接所谴责或痛惜的事。

senses.en: A rigid support that keeps an injured body part still.
To support an injured body part with a splint.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a wrist splint in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了腕部夹板。

ex.en: The author returns to a wrist splint when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了腕部夹板。

tip: 指固定伤处的夹板；不同于石膏固定用的cast。

senses.en: soldiers trained to fight on foot

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on infantry unit.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论步兵分队。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss infantry unit.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论步兵分队的材料。

tip: 集合名词，指步兵整体，不用an infantry指一个人。

senses.en: A round bacterium forming clusters, sometimes causing infections.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on strains of staphylococcus.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论葡萄球菌菌株。

ex.en: The reading connects strains of staphylococcus with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把葡萄球菌菌株和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: strains of staphylococcus｜葡萄球菌菌株
antibiotic-resistant staphylococcus｜耐抗生素葡萄球菌
tip: 复数为staphylococci；常见简称为staph。

senses.en: to appoint someone to act or perform a task for you

ex.en: The assignment is to depute a representative, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先委派代表，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to depute a representative.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得委派代表。

col: depute someone to do something｜委派某人做某事
tip: 正式用词，常用depute sb to do sth。

senses.en: to surround or cover something, especially with smoke or mist

ex.en: After the lecture, we used wreathe in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了环绕。

ex.en: Students who can explain wreathe usually follow the rest of a lecture on the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 能解释环绕的学生，通常跟得上一节关于自然科学的讲座。

col: be wreathed in smoke｜被烟雾笼罩
mist wreathes the hills｜薄雾环绕山丘
a face wreathed in smiles｜满面笑容
tip: 偏文学用语；wreathe尾音/ð/，wreath尾音/θ/。

senses.en: A spinning mass of fluid drawing things towards its centre
A situation that pulls people into increasing confusion or difficulty

ex.en: Office hours began with a swirling vortex.
ex.zh: 答疑从盘旋的涡流开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a swirling vortex.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论盘旋的涡流的材料。

col: a vortex of debt｜债务旋涡
be sucked into a vortex｜被卷入旋涡
tip: 复数可用vortices或vortexes；也可比喻困境。

senses.en: to prevent something or make it impossible

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to preclude the possibility.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须排除可能性。

ex.en: When the class discussed academic research, the speaker told us to preclude the possibility.
ex.zh: 全班讨论学术研究时，讲者让我们排除可能性。

col: preclude someone from doing something｜使某人无法做某事
preclude further discussion｜使进一步讨论无法进行
tip: 正式用词；可用preclude sb from doing sth。

senses.en: To make someone annoyed, worried, or frustrated.

ex.en: The assignment is to vex policymakers, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先困扰政策制定者，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers vex policymakers before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要困扰政策制定者。

col: be vexed by delays｜因延误而烦恼
tip: 较正式的及物动词，日常多用annoy。

senses.en: A small detail or distinction requiring careful understanding
A small convention of polite social behaviour

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize nicety in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出微妙细节。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses nicety when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了微妙细节。

col: legal niceties｜法律上的细微区别
tip: 多用复数 niceties，勿直接理解为“美好”。

senses.en: to distort something good or proper for harmful purposes

ex.en: The assignment is to pervert the course of justice, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先妨碍司法公正，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The reading asks you to pervert the course of justice and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你妨碍司法公正，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: pervert the course of justice｜妨碍司法公正
tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前且常含贬义。

senses.en: The theft of small amounts or items, especially from workplaces.

ex.en: Our professor circled prevent pilferage on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了防止小额偷窃。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around prevent pilferage.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕防止小额偷窃展开说明。

col: losses from pilferage｜小额失窃造成的损失
tip: pilferage是不可数名词，不是动词；动词为pilfer。

senses.en: showing strength and energy traditionally associated with men

ex.en: Our professor circled virile image on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了阳刚形象。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around virile image.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕阳刚形象展开说明。

col: virile young man｜强健的年轻男子
tip: 不只是“男性的”；强调传统观念中的男性力量与活力。

senses.en: a long, detailed piece of writing about a particular subject

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a philosophical treatise.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论哲学论著。

ex.en: The author returns to a philosophical treatise when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了哲学论著。

tip: 常用a treatise on，指系统详尽的专论而非短文。

senses.en: Form an opinion using limited evidence
An opinion formed without enough evidence to be certain

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to surmise that.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须推测……。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to surmise that.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得推测……。

tip: 较正式，强调证据不足；动词常接that从句。

senses.en: Able to be ended, especially under agreed conditions

ex.en: Our professor circled terminable contract on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可终止的合同。

ex.en: The reading connects terminable contract with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可终止的合同和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: terminable on notice｜通知后可终止的
terminable by either party｜任何一方均可终止的
tip: 正式法律用语，常形容合同；不等于terminal。

senses.en: say what will happen, especially through claimed spiritual knowledge

ex.en: The lab instructions say to prophesy that.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求预言……。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to prophesy that.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来预言……。

tip: prophesy是动词，词尾读/saɪ/；名词为prophecy。

senses.en: An indirect suggestion or indication of something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces the first intimation in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了最初的暗示。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around the first intimation.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕最初的暗示展开说明。

col: an intimation of trouble｜麻烦的征兆
tip: 别与intimacy（亲密）混淆；常接of或that从句。

senses.en: An excessive display of wealth or importance to impress others.

ex.en: Office hours began with an air of ostentation.
ex.zh: 答疑从炫耀的气派开始。

ex.en: The reading connects an air of ostentation with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把炫耀的气派和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: an air of ostentation｜炫耀的气派
tip: 不可数名词，通常含贬义，强调故意展示以引人注目。

senses.en: The narrow lower part of the uterus opening into the vagina.

ex.en: The professor explained cervix with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了子宫颈。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up cervix while discussing evidence about public health.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共卫生的证据时提到了子宫颈。

col: the cervix of the uterus｜子宫颈
cells of the cervix｜子宫颈细胞
cancer of the cervix｜子宫颈癌
tip: 通常指子宫颈；cervical 也可表示颈部的。

senses.en: Someone who murders an important person, often for political reasons.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a would-be assassinator.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于企图行刺者的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used a would-be assassinator to explain a pattern in historical change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用企图行刺者来解释历史变迁中的一种模式。

col: the assassinator's motives｜暗杀者的动机
tip: 此词罕见；通常用assassin表示暗杀者。

senses.en: A unit of dry volume used especially for grain.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a bushel of wheat.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一蒲式耳小麦的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a bushel of wheat.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一蒲式耳小麦的材料。

col: a bushel of wheat｜一蒲式耳小麦
tip: 是干量单位；英美容量不同，不能直接等同固定重量。

senses.en: lying flat with your face towards the ground

senses.zh: 精疲力竭的；悲痛难支的
senses.en: overwhelmed by exhaustion, illness, or strong emotion
to make someone lie face down or become extremely weak

ex.en: I copied prostrate with exhaustion into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把疲惫得无法动弹抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to prostrate with exhaustion when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了疲惫得无法动弹。

col: prostrate with exhaustion｜疲惫得无法动弹
tip: 勿与prostate（前列腺）混淆；注意多一个r。

senses.en: Showing the distinctive qualities of a person or thing.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on characteristical features.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论典型特征。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around characteristical features.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕典型特征展开说明。

tip: 罕见旧式形式；现代写作应优先用characteristic。
note: 罕见旧式形容词，现代英语通常用 characteristic。

senses.en: extreme poverty, with too little money for basic needs

ex.en: Office hours began with die in penury.
ex.zh: 答疑从在贫困中去世开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss die in penury.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论在贫困中去世的材料。

col: live in penury｜生活在赤贫中
die in penury｜在贫困中去世
reduce someone to penury｜使某人陷入赤贫
tip: 正式或文学用词，程度重于poverty，通常不可数。

senses.en: To grow or develop rapidly.

ex.en: The professor explained burgeon with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了迅速增长。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up burgeon while discussing evidence about economic policy.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了迅速增长。

col: a burgeoning industry｜蓬勃发展的行业
a burgeoning population｜迅速增长的人口
tip: 现代常作不及物动词；burgeoning常用于名词前。

senses.en: opposing social progress and wanting older political arrangements restored
someone who opposes progress and favours restoring older political arrangements

ex.en: Our professor circled reactionary policies on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了反动政策。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around reactionary policies.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕反动政策展开说明。

tip: 常含贬义，强调恢复旧制度；不等于reactive。

senses.en: to make someone extremely angry or frustrated

ex.en: The assignment is to madden someone, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先使某人极为恼怒，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed human behavior, the speaker told us to madden someone.
ex.zh: 全班讨论人类行为时，讲者让我们使某人极为恼怒。

col: be maddened by delays｜因延误而抓狂
tip: 通常是及物动词，表示使某人恼怒到抓狂。

senses.en: someone who writes or edits dictionaries

ex.en: Our professor circled a bilingual lexicographer on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了双语词典编纂者。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of a bilingual lexicographer.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得双语词典编纂者这个例子。

col: work as a lexicographer｜担任词典编纂者
a team of lexicographers｜词典编纂团队
a bilingual lexicographer｜双语词典编纂者
tip: 指编写或修订词典的人，不泛指语言学家。

senses.en: Rude and disrespectful, especially towards someone in authority.

ex.en: I copied insolent behaviour into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把傲慢无礼的行为抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects insolent behaviour with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把傲慢无礼的行为和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 现代常用作形容词；对应名词是insolence。

senses.en: To make an official decision about a dispute
To judge performances or entries in a competition

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to adjudicate a dispute.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何裁决纠纷。

ex.en: The passage says students who can adjudicate a dispute follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够裁决纠纷的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: adjudicate on a claim｜就索赔作出裁决
adjudicate a competition｜担任比赛评委
tip: 可直接接争议，也可用adjudicate on；不专指宣判刑罚。

senses.en: To shout or laugh at someone in an unkind way.
An unkind shout or remark intended to ridicule someone.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to jeer at someone.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须嘲笑某人。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to jeer at someone.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得嘲笑某人。

col: jeers from the crowd｜人群中的嘲笑声
a chorus of jeers｜一片嘲笑声
tip: 动词常用 jeer at someone；名词常用复数。

senses.en: Unwilling or reluctant to do something.

ex.en: The textbook introduces loth to admit in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了不愿承认。

ex.en: The reading connects loth to admit with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把不愿承认和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: loath的较少见变体；常用be loth to do。

senses.en: harmful or poisonous to people or other living things

ex.en: I copied noxious fumes into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把有毒烟气抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to noxious fumes when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了有毒烟气。

tip: 常形容气体或物质；不只是气味难闻。

senses.en: A system or machine sending document copies over telephone lines.
To send a document using a fax machine.

ex.en: The textbook introduces telefax machine in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了传真机。

ex.en: The author returns to telefax machine when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了传真机。

col: send by telefax｜通过传真发送
tip: 较旧的说法；现代英语通常直接用fax。

senses.en: generous and forgiving, especially towards a rival or weaker person

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on magnanimous in victory.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论胜而有雅量。

ex.en: A campus survey used magnanimous in victory to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用胜而有雅量来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: a magnanimous gesture｜宽宏大量的举动
tip: 较正式，常形容对对手或冒犯者宽容大度。

senses.en: to break a law, rule, or moral boundary

ex.en: The lab instructions say to transgress the law.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求违法。

ex.en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers transgress the law before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要违法。

col: transgress moral boundaries｜逾越道德界限
transgress social norms｜违反社会规范
tip: 正式用词，可直接接law、rules等宾语。

senses.en: To divide or spread into branches or connected parts.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to ramify into branches.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求分成枝杈。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers ramify into branches before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要分成枝杈。

tip: 正式且少见，常指根系、血管或网络分叉延伸。

senses.en: a system where employees reserve shared workspaces instead of permanent desks

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about office hotelling.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于办公位预约共享制的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss office hotelling.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论办公位预约共享制的材料。

col: office hotelling｜办公位预约共享制
hotelling system｜工位预约共享系统
tip: 通常指预约共享工位；旅馆业用hotel industry。
note: 真实词，亦拼作hoteling；现代常见义为办公位预约共享制，并非通常所说的旅馆业。

senses.en: Until now or until the time being discussed.

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to hitherto unknown.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习此前未知的。

ex.en: Students who hitherto unknown are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够此前未知的的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: 正式用语，常见于hitherto unknown等搭配。

senses.en: Mentioned or presented earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: The textbook introduces the foregoing discussion in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了上述讨论。

ex.en: A campus survey used the foregoing discussion to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用上述讨论来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 正式书面语，常用the foregoing修饰名词。

senses.en: to pay out money, especially from an official fund

ex.en: The professor asked us to disburse funds.
ex.zh: 教授让我们拨付资金。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers disburse funds before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要拨付资金。

tip: 正式用词，常以funds或money作宾语。

senses.en: A strong public reaction of anger or excitement.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used furor in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了公愤。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses furor when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了公愤。

col: cause a furor｜引起轩然大波
a furor over something｜因某事引发的风波
tip: 美式常用furor，英式常用furore；多指公众强烈反应。

senses.en: to pay all or part of a cost

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to defray costs.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何支付成本。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers defray costs before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要支付成本。

tip: 正式用词，宾语通常是costs或expenses，不是人。

senses.en: To excite desire for something that remains out of reach.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to tantalize someone with.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须用某物引逗某人。

ex.en: The reading asks you to tantalize someone with and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你用某物引逗某人，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: tantalize someone with｜用某物引逗某人
tantalizing glimpse｜勾起渴望的短暂一瞥
tantalizing prospect｜诱人却未实现的前景
tip: 英式也写tantalise；强调勾起欲望却暂时得不到。

senses.en: express a financial amount in a particular currency
give a particular name to something

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize denominate in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出以某货币计价。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up denominate while discussing evidence about economic policy.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于经济政策的证据时提到了以某货币计价。

tip: 金融中常用be denominated in＋货币；命名义较罕见。

senses.en: Able to be hammered or pressed into a different shape.
Easily influenced or changed by other people or circumstances.

ex.en: Our professor circled highly malleable on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了可塑性很强的。

ex.en: The reading connects highly malleable with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把可塑性很强的和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 金属义强调锻压成形；ductile强调可拉成丝。

senses.en: The degree to which something can be sold easily.

ex.en: Office hours began with improve salability.
ex.zh: 答疑从提高适销性开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around improve salability.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕提高适销性展开说明。

tip: 美式拼写；英式通常写作saleability。

senses.en: News reporting, especially detailed accounts based on direct observation

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about investigative reportage.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于调查报道的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to investigative reportage when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了调查报道。

tip: 通常不可数，比reporting正式，常强调现场记录。

senses.en: Overused and therefore no longer interesting or original

ex.en: I copied sound trite into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把听起来很老套抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects sound trite with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把听起来很老套和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 强调因反复使用而失去新意，不只是年代久远。

senses.en: The everyday language spoken by people in a particular place.

senses.zh: 本地语言的；本土风格的
senses.en: Using local everyday language or traditional local building styles.

ex.en: The textbook introduces the local vernacular in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了当地日常用语。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of the local vernacular.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得当地日常用语这个例子。

col: the local vernacular｜当地日常用语
tip: 强调当地日常语言，不等同于“本国的”。

senses.en: To make someone feel excited, energetic, and very happy

ex.en: I wrote exhilarate on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把exhilarate和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: Students who can explain exhilarate usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
ex.zh: 能解释使兴奋的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。

col: exhilarated by the experience｜因这次经历而振奋
an exhilarating experience｜令人兴奋的经历
tip: 及物动词；人感到兴奋用exhilarated。

senses.en: so small that it is almost impossible to measure
a mathematical quantity smaller in magnitude than any positive real number

ex.en: The textbook introduces infinitesimal amount in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了极微小的量。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of infinitesimal amount.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得极微小的量这个例子。

tip: 比small语气强得多；名词用法主要见于数学。

senses.en: Relating to the separate parts that make up a whole

ex.en: Office hours began with componential analysis.
ex.zh: 答疑从成分分析开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of componential analysis.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得成分分析这个例子。

tip: 专业形容词，常见于语言学术语componential analysis。

senses.en: previously mentioned in the same document or statement

ex.en: The textbook introduces the aforesaid conditions in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了上述条件。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss the aforesaid conditions.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论上述条件的材料。

tip: 法律或正式书面语，通常置于名词前。

senses.en: Showing disrespect for religion, or using offensive language.
To treat something sacred with serious disrespect.

ex.en: Office hours began with profane language.
ex.zh: 答疑从粗俗的语言开始。

ex.en: The reading connects profane language with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把粗俗的语言和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: profane a sacred place｜亵渎圣地
tip: 形容词常修饰language；动词指亵渎神圣事物。

senses.en: The larger front bone between the knee and ankle

ex.en: I copied a fractured tibia into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把骨折的胫骨抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a fractured tibia.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论骨折的胫骨的材料。

col: the tibia and fibula｜胫骨和腓骨
tip: 即shinbone；复数可用tibias或tibiae。

senses.en: Expressing very strong feelings, especially anger or opposition

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about vehement opposition.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于强烈反对的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of vehement opposition.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得强烈反对这个例子。

tip: 多形容反对、否认或批评的强烈程度，语气较正式。

senses.en: A gemstone often showing changing colours when light strikes it

ex.en: I copied precious opal into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把贵蛋白石抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of precious opal.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得贵蛋白石这个例子。

tip: 珠宝语境常称“欧泊”；并非所有蛋白石都有变彩。

senses.en: having many different kinds or aspects

ex.en: The textbook introduces multifarious activities in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了多种多样的活动。

ex.en: The author returns to multifarious activities when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了多种多样的活动。

tip: 正式词，强调种类多；日常多用varied或diverse。

senses.en: A substance that drives something forward or forces liquid out
Providing the force that moves something forward

ex.en: I copied rocket propellent into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把火箭推进剂抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used rocket propellent to explain a pattern in technological change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用火箭推进剂来解释技术变革中的一种模式。

tip: 是propellant的较少见拼写；写作优先用后者。

senses.en: Unwilling to do something.

ex.en: I wrote loath on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把loath和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: Students who can explain loath usually follow the rest of a lecture on human behavior.
ex.zh: 能解释不情愿的的学生，通常跟得上一节关于人类行为的讲座。

col: be loath to admit｜不愿承认
be loath to leave｜不愿离开
be loath to accept｜不愿接受
tip: 常用be loath to do；勿混淆动词loathe（厌恶）。

senses.en: Something believed to solve every problem or cure every illness.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on no panacea.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论并非万能之策。

ex.en: The author returns to no panacea when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了并非万能之策。

col: a panacea for｜解决……的万能之策
a universal panacea｜包治百病的灵丹妙药
tip: 常用a panacea for；多用于否定万能解法。

senses.en: Lose a pregnancy before the baby can survive outside the womb.
Fail to achieve the intended result.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to miscarry early in pregnancy.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何孕早期流产。

ex.en: The reading asks you to miscarry early in pregnancy and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你孕早期流产，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: miscarry early in pregnancy｜孕早期流产
tip: 通常指流产；表示计划失败时较正式且少见。

senses.en: A person or organisation that accepts insurance risks.
An institution guaranteeing to buy securities not purchased by investors.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on insurance underwriter.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论保险承保人。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss insurance underwriter.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论保险承保人的材料。

tip: 保险领域指承保人，证券领域指承销商。

senses.en: Transfer goods from one ship or vehicle to another.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer transship cargo during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时转运货物。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to transship cargo.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来转运货物。

tip: 过去式为transshipped，现在分词双写p。

senses.en: a tree mainly native to Australia, with strongly scented leaves

ex.en: The textbook introduces eucalyptus tree in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了桉树。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around eucalyptus tree.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕桉树展开说明。

tip: 指树种；eucalyptus oil指从桉树叶提取的精油。

senses.en: Honest and trusting, often through a lack of worldly experience.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on an ingenuous smile.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论天真无邪的微笑。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of an ingenuous smile.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得天真无邪的微笑这个例子。

col: an ingenuous smile｜天真无邪的微笑
an ingenuous question｜天真坦率的提问
tip: 勿与ingenious（巧妙的）混淆；本词强调天真坦率。

senses.en: Something earlier that influenced or resembled a later thing.
A word or phrase that a later pronoun refers to.
Existing or happening before something else.

ex.en: I copied a pronoun's antecedent into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把代词的先行词抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a pronoun's antecedent.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得代词的先行词这个例子。

col: historical antecedents｜历史先例；历史根源
a pronoun's antecedent｜代词的先行词
tip: 语法中指代词所指的先行词；不宜直接等同祖先。

senses.en: living mainly in trees
relating to trees

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on arboreal species.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论树栖物种。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss arboreal species.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论树栖物种的材料。

tip: 常用于动物学，描述主要生活在树上的动物。

senses.en: To compensate for loss or provide financial protection against it.

ex.en: The assignment is to indemnify someone against loss, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先保障某人免受损失，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to indemnify someone against loss.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来保障某人免受损失。

col: indemnify someone against loss｜保障某人免受损失
indemnify someone for damage｜赔偿某人的损害
tip: 法律正式用语：for接已受损害，against接防范风险。

senses.en: A set of criteria used to assess work.
Instructions explaining how to complete a task or examination.
A heading or category under which something is grouped.

ex.en: I copied an assessment rubric into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把评估细则抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an assessment rubric.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕评估细则展开说明。

col: under the rubric of｜归入……类别
tip: 教育中常指评分细则，也可指试题作答说明。

senses.en: The state of being married, especially in formal or religious language.

ex.en: I copied joined in matrimony into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把结为夫妻抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to joined in matrimony when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了结为夫妻。

col: the bonds of matrimony｜婚姻的纽带
tip: 正式或宗教用语；日常谈婚姻通常用marriage。

senses.en: extremely careful to do things correctly and thoroughly
careful to act honestly and avoid doing anything wrong

ex.en: Office hours began with scrupulous attention to detail.
ex.zh: 答疑从对细节的一丝不苟开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around scrupulous attention to detail.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕对细节的一丝不苟展开说明。

col: scrupulous attention to detail｜对细节的一丝不苟
tip: 既可指做事严谨，也可指恪守道德。

senses.en: a large branch of a tree

ex.en: The textbook introduces a low bough in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了低垂的大树枝。

ex.en: The reading connects a low bough with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把低垂的大树枝和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a low bough｜低垂的大树枝
a spreading bough｜向外伸展的大树枝
tip: 读音与cow押韵；通常指大枝，小枝用twig。

senses.en: A compound containing sulphur combined with another element or group

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about iron sulphide.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于硫化铁的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of iron sulphide.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得硫化铁这个例子。

tip: 美式及国际化学命名常写sulfide；勿混同硫酸盐。

senses.en: examine something closely to understand it fully
measure how deep water is
a weight on a string used to check vertical alignment

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to plumb the depths of.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何深入探究；达到低谷。

ex.en: The passage says students who can plumb the depths of follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够深入探究；达到低谷的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: plumb the depths of｜深入探究；达到低谷
tip: 词尾 b 不发音；plumb the depths 常用于比喻。

senses.en: Peaceful in nature or intended to avoid conflict

ex.en: Office hours began with pacific approach.
ex.zh: 答疑从和平的处理方式开始。

ex.en: The author returns to pacific approach when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了和平的处理方式。

tip: 小写pacific是正式形容词；the Pacific指太平洋。

senses.en: Move or rise and fall in a smooth, wave-like pattern.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer undulate gently during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时轻轻起伏。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers undulate gently before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要轻轻起伏。

tip: 描述地形起伏时，常用形容词undulating。

senses.en: the general opinion people have of someone or something
to consider someone or something to have a particular quality

ex.en: I wrote repute on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把repute和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up repute while discussing evidence about social change.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于社会变迁的证据时提到了名声。

col: of international repute｜享有国际声誉的
tip: 动词多用被动式be reputed to be，意为“据说是”。

senses.en: Following the styles that are currently fashionable.

ex.en: I copied modish clothes into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把时髦的服装抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of modish clothes.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得时髦的服装这个例子。

tip: 较书面，有时暗含“追逐潮流”的意味。

senses.en: Using power cruelly and unfairly to control others.

ex.en: Our professor circled a tyrannical ruler on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了暴虐的统治者。

ex.en: A campus survey used a tyrannical ruler to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用暴虐的统治者来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

col: a tyrannical ruler｜暴虐的统治者
tip: 不仅指政治暴政，也可形容老板等人的专横行为。

senses.en: Unwilling to help others or adjust to their needs.

ex.en: Office hours began with an unaccommodating attitude.
ex.zh: 答疑从不肯通融的态度开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used an unaccommodating attitude to explain a pattern in social change.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用不肯通融的态度来解释社会变迁中的一种模式。

col: an unaccommodating attitude｜不肯通融的态度
an unaccommodating employer｜不肯通融的雇主
tip: 指不愿帮助或迁就他人，不表示没有住宿。

senses.en: In this document, statement, or situation.

ex.en: The lab manual says to herein lies the problem before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先问题就在于此，再记下数字。

ex.en: Students who herein lies the problem are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够问题就在于此的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

col: herein lies the problem｜问题就在于此
tip: 正式或法律用语，常指“在本文件中”。

senses.en: Causing strong dislike or a feeling of sickness.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on disgustful smell.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论令人作呕的气味。

ex.en: The author returns to disgustful smell when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了令人作呕的气味。

tip: 此词罕见且偏旧；现代英语通常用disgusting。
note: 真实但罕见、偏旧的词；通常用disgusting

senses.en: to provoke someone into acting through persistent pressure or annoyance
a pointed stick used to make animals move
something that strongly pushes a person to act

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to goad someone into doing something.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何激某人做某事。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to goad someone into doing something.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来激某人做某事。

col: goad someone into doing something｜激某人做某事
goad someone on｜不断刺激某人行动
a goad to action｜行动的驱动力
tip: 常用goad sb into doing，通常含负面刺激。

senses.en: the Western world, especially Europe and North America

ex.en: The textbook introduces the Occident in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了西方世界。

ex.en: The reading connects the Occident with a larger point about historical change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把西方世界和关于历史变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: the Orient and the Occident｜东方与西方
tip: 旧式用语，通常写作the Occident；现代多用the West。

senses.en: in accordance with a law, rule, or agreement

ex.en: Office hours began with pursuant to regulations.
ex.zh: 答疑从依照法规开始。

ex.en: The reading connects pursuant to regulations with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把依照法规和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: pursuant to an agreement｜根据协议
tip: 几乎总用于pursuant to，常见于法律等正式文本。

senses.en: To swell or become larger because of pressure from inside.

ex.en: I wrote distend on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把distend和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: A reading on public health uses distend when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于公共卫生的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了胀大。

col: distended with gas｜因气体而膨胀
tip: 多用于医学，强调内部压力导致胀大。

senses.en: Numerous and varied
A pipe system distributing or collecting gas or liquid

ex.en: I copied exhaust manifold into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把排气歧管抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around exhaust manifold.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕排气歧管展开说明。

tip: 形容词用法较正式，常修饰benefits、problems等复数名词。

senses.zh: 兴趣广泛的；兼收并蓄的
senses.en: Including or appreciating a wide variety of things.
Relating to the Christian church led by the Pope.
A member of the Christian church led by the Pope.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a practising Catholic in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了践行信仰的天主教徒。

ex.en: The reading connects a practising Catholic with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把践行信仰的天主教徒和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a practising Catholic｜践行信仰的天主教徒
tip: 小写指广泛包容；指天主教或其信徒须大写Catholic。

senses.en: to understand something in the wrong way

ex.en: I heard the lecturer misconceive someone's intentions during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时误解某人的意图。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to misconceive someone's intentions.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得误解某人的意图。

col: misconceive someone's intentions｜误解某人的意图
tip: 较正式；日常表达“误解”更常用misunderstand。

senses.en: To kill someone or something, especially violently.

ex.en: The assignment is to slay a dragon, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先杀死恶龙，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: A lecture on the humanities showed why researchers slay a dragon before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人文学科的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要杀死恶龙。

tip: 过去式slew，过去分词slain；常见于文学或新闻。

senses.en: Someone favouring individual freedom and minimal government control
Favouring individual freedom and minimal government control

ex.en: I copied libertarian views into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把自由意志主义观点抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects libertarian views with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把自由意志主义观点和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: libertarian views｜自由意志主义观点
libertarian principles｜自由意志主义原则
a libertarian approach｜自由意志主义的做法
tip: 强调个人自由和有限政府，不等同于liberal。

senses.en: infected with harmful bacteria, or relating to such infection

ex.en: The textbook introduces a septic wound in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了感染的伤口。

ex.en: The author returns to a septic wound when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了感染的伤口。

tip: septic tank 指化粪池；septic 不作“腐烂物”名词。

senses.en: Payment or a reward for work, loss, or inconvenience.
To pay or reward someone for work, loss, or inconvenience.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on fair recompense.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论公平的报酬。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around fair recompense.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕公平的报酬展开说明。

col: recompense someone for something｜因某事补偿某人
tip: 较正式；动词用recompense sb for sth。

senses.en: an unusual habit or feature particular to someone or something

ex.en: The professor explained idiosyncrasy with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了特性。

ex.en: A reading on social change uses idiosyncrasy when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于社会变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了特性。

col: linguistic idiosyncrasies｜语言上的独特之处
tip: 可数名词，复数为idiosyncrasies，常指独特习惯。

senses.en: Showing great enthusiasm and commitment to a cause or activity.

ex.en: The textbook introduces overly zealous in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了过分热心的。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around overly zealous.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕过分热心的展开说明。

col: a zealous supporter｜热忱的支持者
zealous in their efforts｜努力而热忱
tip: 语气比enthusiastic强，有时暗示热心得过头。

senses.en: The process of correcting an error or putting something right
The process of converting alternating electric current into direct current

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about half-wave rectification.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于半波整流的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to half-wave rectification when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了半波整流。

tip: 正式名词；日常说“纠正”常用correction。

senses.en: with that thing or together with it
immediately after that

ex.en: The professor explained therewith with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了随同。

ex.en: Students who can explain therewith usually follow the rest of a lecture on public institutions.
ex.zh: 能解释随同的学生，通常跟得上一节关于公共制度的讲座。

col: documents submitted therewith｜随同提交的文件
costs associated therewith｜与此相关的费用
tip: 古旧或法律用语；日常用with it或along with it。

senses.en: A wooden frame joining two animals to pull a load.
A condition of being controlled or oppressed.
Join animals with a frame, or force things together.

ex.en: Our professor circled a wooden yoke on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了木轭。

ex.en: In the lecture on historical change, everyone remembered the example of a wooden yoke.
ex.zh: 在关于历史变迁的讲座里，大家都记得木轭这个例子。

col: the yoke of oppression｜压迫的枷锁
tip: 与 yolk（蛋黄）同音；比喻义常指压迫的枷锁。

senses.en: To firmly reject a claim, belief, or association.
To refuse to honour an agreement or pay a debt.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer repudiate an allegation during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时坚决否认指控。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to repudiate an allegation.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们坚决否认指控。

col: repudiate an allegation｜坚决否认指控
repudiate a claim｜驳斥某种说法
repudiate a contract｜拒绝履行合同
tip: 是正式动词，不是名词；名词为repudiation。

senses.en: An event happening by chance, or chance itself.

ex.en: I copied an element of fortuity into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把偶然因素抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used an element of fortuity to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用偶然因素来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: an element of fortuity｜偶然因素
tip: 较罕见的正式词；日常表达多用chance或coincidence。

senses.en: serious disagreement or conflict between people or groups

ex.en: Office hours began with social strife.
ex.zh: 答疑从社会冲突开始。

ex.en: The author returns to social strife when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了社会冲突。

tip: 不可数名词，语气正式，比一般争论更严重。

senses.en: A brief fight between small groups of opposing forces.
A brief argument, often within a larger disagreement.
Fight or argue briefly without a major confrontation.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on border skirmish.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论边境小规模冲突。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of border skirmish.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得边境小规模冲突这个例子。

col: skirmish over something｜围绕某事的争执
tip: 强调规模小、时间短；也可比喻口头争执。

senses.en: slippery or moving smoothly with a twisting motion

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a slithery snake.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论蜿蜒滑行的蛇。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a slithery snake.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕蜿蜒滑行的蛇展开说明。

col: a slithery snake｜蜿蜒滑行的蛇
a slithery eel｜滑溜溜的鳗鱼
tip: 常形容蛇、鳗鱼等滑溜或扭动滑行的动物。

senses.en: small, delicate, and attractive
showing delicate or careful movements and manners

ex.en: I copied dainty jewellery into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把小巧精致的首饰抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects dainty jewellery with a larger point about the humanities.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把小巧精致的首饰和关于人文学科的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常形容杯具、首饰等小而精致，不泛指高档。

senses.en: showing that you consider someone or something unworthy of respect

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on contemptuous of.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论鄙视……的。

ex.en: The reading connects contemptuous of with a larger point about human behavior.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把鄙视……的和关于人类行为的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: contemptuous是鄙视人的；contemptible是可鄙的。

senses.en: Relating to copies of documents made by a photographic process.

ex.en: Office hours began with a photostatic copy.
ex.zh: 答疑从照相复制件开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a photostatic copy.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得照相复制件这个例子。

tip: 旧式技术用语，指照相复制，并非静电复印。

senses.zh: 不可撤销的；无法改变的
senses.en: Impossible to change, cancel, or take back.

ex.en: Office hours began with an irrevocable decision.
ex.zh: 答疑从不可撤销的决定开始。

ex.en: The author returns to an irrevocable decision when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不可撤销的决定。

col: an irrevocable decision｜不可撤销的决定
an irrevocable commitment｜不可撤回的承诺
tip: 常修饰决定、同意或承诺，强调无法撤回。

senses.en: a biological group containing closely related species

ex.en: Our professor circled the same genus on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了同一个属。

ex.en: The reading connects the same genus with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把同一个属和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: belong to a genus｜属于某个属
tip: 复数为genera；属低于科、高于种。

senses.en: Give a customer less weight of goods than paid for

ex.en: After the lecture, we used short-weight in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了售货时缺斤少两。

ex.en: A reading on economic policy uses short-weight when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于经济政策的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了售货时缺斤少两。

col: short-weight customers｜向顾客售货时缺斤少两
short-weight a buyer｜给买家不足分量的货
tip: 动词指缺斤少两；名词通常分写为 short weight。
note: 罕用形式；名词“短重”通常写作 short weight。

senses.en: relating to an axis or extending along it

ex.en: The textbook introduces axial tilt in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了轴倾角。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around axial tilt.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕轴倾角展开说明。

tip: axial与轴有关；radial指沿半径方向的。

senses.en: To oversee and take responsibility for work or an activity.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to superintend construction.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求监督施工。

ex.en: The passage says students who can superintend construction follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够监督施工的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 正式及物动词，直接接工作或活动；日常多用supervise。

senses.en: Relating to the most basic features or forces of something.
Relating to powerful natural forces such as wind and water.
Consisting of a chemical element rather than a compound.

ex.en: I copied elemental forces into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把自然力量抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects elemental forces with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把自然力量和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: elemental强调根本或自然力；elementary常指初级。

senses.en: An exact copy of a document, book, or picture
A copy of a document sent electronically over telephone lines

ex.en: The textbook introduces an exact facsimile in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了精确复制品。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss an exact facsimile.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论精确复制品的材料。

col: send by facsimile｜通过传真发送
tip: 指精确复制品；表示传真时通常简称fax。

senses.en: A radioactive metallic chemical element

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on radium decay.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论镭的衰变。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around radium decay.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕镭的衰变展开说明。

tip: radium是不可数名词，元素符号为Ra。

senses.en: an open sore on the skin or inside the body

ex.en: Office hours began with a stomach ulcer.
ex.zh: 答疑从胃溃疡开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a stomach ulcer.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论胃溃疡的材料。

tip: 可数名词，常用身体部位修饰，如mouth ulcer。

senses.en: determined to continue despite difficulties
holding firmly or remaining difficult to remove or change

ex.en: The textbook introduces a tenacious campaigner in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了坚持不懈的倡导者。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a tenacious campaigner.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论坚持不懈的倡导者的材料。

col: a tenacious campaigner｜坚持不懈的倡导者
tip: 核心是坚持不放弃；也可形容抓得紧或难消除。

senses.en: A period when a serious illness improves or becomes inactive.
An official reduction or cancellation of a debt or punishment.

ex.en: The textbook introduces complete remission in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了完全缓解。

ex.en: The reading connects complete remission with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把完全缓解和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: in remission指病情缓解，不一定表示治愈。

senses.en: a person's usual mood and way of behaving
a natural tendency or willingness to do something
the arrangement of people or things in particular positions

ex.en: Our professor circled cheerful disposition on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了开朗的性格。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss cheerful disposition.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论开朗的性格的材料。

col: a disposition to help｜乐于助人的倾向
a disposition towards anxiety｜容易焦虑的倾向
tip: 性情义常用单数；a disposition to do表示做某事的倾向。

senses.en: To produce a particular result, especially credit or benefit.

ex.en: The professor asked us to redound to someone's credit.
ex.zh: 教授让我们为某人增光。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to redound to someone's credit.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来为某人增光。

col: redound to someone's credit｜为某人增光
redound to the benefit of｜有益于
redound to someone's honour｜为某人增添荣誉
tip: 正式且少见；常接to，不能直接接宾语表示增加。

senses.en: An official finding that someone is not guilty or responsible.

ex.en: Office hours began with complete exoneration.
ex.zh: 答疑从彻底洗清罪名开始。

ex.en: The author returns to complete exoneration when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了彻底洗清罪名。

col: lead to exoneration｜使人获证清白
tip: 强调证明无罪或无责；pardon指赦免。

senses.en: To read or examine something carefully

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to peruse a document.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何审阅文件。

ex.en: The reading asks you to peruse a document and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你审阅文件，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: peruse a report｜仔细阅读报告
tip: 正式用词；直接接阅读对象，名词为perusal。

senses.en: a shiny yellow mineral containing iron and sulphur

ex.en: Office hours began with iron pyrite.
ex.zh: 答疑从黄铁矿开始。

ex.en: The author returns to iron pyrite when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了黄铁矿。

tip: 因外观似金，俗称 fool’s gold（愚人金）。

senses.en: a general feeling of illness or unease without a clear cause
a widespread lack of confidence, energy, or progress in society

ex.en: Office hours began with general malaise.
ex.zh: 答疑从全身不适开始。

ex.en: The author returns to general malaise when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了全身不适。

col: a sense of malaise｜一种不安感
tip: 较正式，既指笼统的身体不适，也可指社会经济低迷。

senses.en: A simple organism that photosynthesises, usually living in water.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a freshwater alga.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论一种淡水藻。

ex.en: The reading connects a freshwater alga with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把一种淡水藻和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: alga是单数，复数为algae；整体谈藻类常用复数。

senses.en: Having a pleasant musical sound

ex.en: The textbook introduces melodious voice in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了悦耳的嗓音。

ex.en: A campus survey used melodious voice to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用悦耳的嗓音来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

tip: 强调声音悦耳；melodic侧重与旋律有关。

senses.en: A circular current in water or air.
To move in a circular current.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a swirling eddy.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于旋转的涡流的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects a swirling eddy with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把旋转的涡流和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 可指水流或气流打旋；复数为eddies。

senses.en: Silently showing anger or unhappiness and refusing to be friendly.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about sullen silence.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于阴郁的沉默的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss sullen silence.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论阴郁的沉默的材料。

col: a sullen mood｜闷闷不乐的心情
tip: 强调生气或不快时沉默、不友好的样子。

senses.en: To steal goods by force, especially during war.
Goods stolen by force, especially during war.

ex.en: The professor asked us to plunder a city.
ex.zh: 教授让我们洗劫城市。

ex.en: The passage says students who can plunder a city follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够洗劫城市的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 常指战乱中的抢掠；也可指肆意掠夺资源。

senses.en: A group or set of four things.
Four chromatids formed when homologous chromosomes pair during meiosis.

ex.en: Office hours began with a tetrad of cells.
ex.zh: 答疑从一组四个细胞开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a tetrad of cells.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕一组四个细胞展开说明。

col: a tetrad of cells｜一组四个细胞
tip: 专业词；生物学四分体含四条染色单体。

senses.en: To shorten a written work while keeping its main content.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to abridge a novel.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何删节小说。

ex.en: The passage says students who can abridge a novel follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够删节小说的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 删去部分内容但保留主干，不等同于写摘要。

senses.en: to stop resisting and accept another person's demands

ex.en: The lab instructions say to capitulate to pressure.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求屈服于压力。

ex.en: The reading asks you to capitulate to pressure and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你屈服于压力，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: capitulate to demands｜接受要求而让步
tip: 不及物动词；向某人或压力屈服用capitulate to。

senses.en: to formally agree to a request, demand, or proposal
to take an important official position, especially as a ruler

ex.en: The lab instructions say to accede to a request.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求答应请求。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to accede to a request.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来答应请求。

col: accede to a request｜答应请求
tip: 正式用语，通常接to；勿与exceed（超过）混淆。

senses.en: of or relating to the thing just mentioned

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize thereof in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出其中的。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up thereof while discussing evidence about public institutions.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于公共制度的证据时提到了其中的。

col: any portion thereof｜其中的任何部分
tip: 意为of that，常见于法律文体，不等于therefore。

senses.en: Disturbing or frightening because of a connection with death.

ex.en: Our professor circled macabre humour on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了死亡主题的黑色幽默。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss macabre humour.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论死亡主题的黑色幽默的材料。

col: macabre humour｜死亡主题的黑色幽默
macabre imagery｜死亡主题的恐怖意象
tip: 不泛指吓人，通常涉及死亡或令人不安的细节。

senses.en: Abnormal hardening of tissue within the body.

ex.en: Our professor circled multiple sclerosis on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了多发性硬化症。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around multiple sclerosis.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕多发性硬化症展开说明。

tip: 医学词；multiple sclerosis是多发性硬化症。

senses.en: To restrict someone's freedom or ability to act.
Something limiting freedom, or a chain securing someone's ankles.

ex.en: The professor asked us to fetter creativity.
ex.zh: 教授让我们束缚创造力。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to fetter creativity.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来束缚创造力。

col: break free from fetters｜挣脱束缚
tip: 较正式；名词通常用复数fetters。

senses.en: A large flat sea fish, also eaten as food

ex.en: I copied grilled halibut into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把烤大比目鱼抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around grilled halibut.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕烤大比目鱼展开说明。

tip: 指鱼时复数通常仍为halibut；指鱼肉时不可数。

senses.en: operated by compressed air or filled with air

ex.en: Our professor circled a pneumatic drill on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了风钻。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a pneumatic drill.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得风钻这个例子。

tip: 词首p不发音；常指靠压缩空气驱动的设备。

senses.en: A sudden confused mental state, often caused by illness.
A state of extreme excitement or happiness.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on acute delirium.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论急性谵妄。

ex.en: The reading connects acute delirium with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把急性谵妄和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a state of delirium｜谵妄状态
tip: 医学义是急性意识混乱，不等于长期痴呆。

senses.en: Able to be defended or maintained against criticism.

ex.en: The textbook introduces no longer tenable in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了不再站得住脚。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss no longer tenable.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论不再站得住脚的材料。

col: a tenable position｜站得住脚的立场
a tenable argument｜经得起推敲的论点
no longer tenable｜不再站得住脚
tip: 常形容论点或立场站得住脚，不等于舒适。

senses.en: A peaceful, happy experience, especially in the countryside.
A poem or short story describing peaceful country life.

ex.en: I copied rural idyll into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把田园乐境抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss rural idyll.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论田园乐境的材料。

tip: 既可指田园诗，也常指田园般的恬静生活。

senses.en: Sounding sad, especially in a gentle or complaining way.

ex.en: Our professor circled plaintive cry on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了哀怨的叫声。

ex.en: In the lecture on human behavior, everyone remembered the example of plaintive cry.
ex.zh: 在关于人类行为的讲座里，大家都记得哀怨的叫声这个例子。

tip: 多形容声音、语调或旋律中流露的哀伤。

senses.en: Capable of forming ideas or mental images.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on conceptive faculty.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论构想能力。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of conceptive faculty.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得构想能力这个例子。

tip: 罕见词；勿与表示“概念上的”conceptual混用。

senses.en: to formally inform someone about something

ex.en: The assignment is to apprise someone of something, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先将某事告知某人，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to apprise someone of something.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们将某事告知某人。

col: apprise someone of something｜将某事告知某人
keep someone apprised｜随时向某人通报
tip: 正式用语；用apprise sb of sth，勿混appraise。

senses.en: To a very great degree, especially in a positive way.

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to eminently suitable.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习非常合适。

ex.en: Students who eminently suitable are less likely to misread the lecture.
ex.zh: 能够非常合适的学生不太会误读这场讲座。

tip: 常修饰褒义形容词；勿与imminently（即将）混淆。

senses.en: An ancient practice seeking to turn ordinary metals into gold
A mysterious process that transforms ordinary things into something special

ex.en: Office hours began with medieval alchemy.
ex.zh: 答疑从中世纪炼金术开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss medieval alchemy.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论中世纪炼金术的材料。

col: the alchemy of creativity｜创造力的神奇转化作用
tip: 通常不可数；比喻义强调神奇转化，并非泛指魔法。

senses.en: Deep respect and admiration for someone or something.

ex.en: Office hours began with deep reverence.
ex.zh: 答疑从深深的敬意开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used deep reverence to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用深深的敬意来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

tip: 通常不可数；对某人的崇敬用reverence for。

senses.en: A viral illness causing painful swelling near the jaw

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about catch mumps.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于感染腮腺炎的简答题。

ex.en: The reading connects catch mumps with a larger point about public health.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把感染腮腺炎和关于公共卫生的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 虽以s结尾，但作疾病名称用单数：mumps is。

senses.zh: 温文尔雅的；善于应酬的
senses.en: Polite, confident, and comfortable in social situations.

ex.en: Our professor circled urbane manner on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了温文尔雅的举止。

ex.en: The author returns to urbane manner when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了温文尔雅的举止。

tip: urbane指人文雅善交际；urban指城市的。

senses.en: Stated or appearing to be true, but possibly not genuine

ex.en: Our professor circled ostensible reason on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了表面上的理由。

ex.en: A campus survey used ostensible reason to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用表面上的理由来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 暗示表象可能不是真相，但不等于已证实虚假。

senses.en: A complicated, unpleasant situation that is difficult to escape.
An area of soft wet ground that can trap you.

ex.en: Office hours began with a legal quagmire.
ex.zh: 答疑从法律困境开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a legal quagmire.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得法律困境这个例子。

col: be mired in a quagmire｜深陷泥潭
tip: 常比喻复杂且难脱身的困境，不泛指普通困难。

senses.en: Involving all members of a group or meeting.
A meeting attended by all participants in a larger event.
Complete or unrestricted, especially concerning official power.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about plenary session.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于全体会议的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around plenary session.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕全体会议展开说明。

tip: 会议语境指全体参加；plenary powers指全权。

senses.en: To injure someone severely, causing lasting damage to their body.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer maim workers during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时使工人重伤致残。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to maim workers.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得使工人重伤致残。

col: maimed in an accident｜在事故中重伤致残
tip: 比injure严重，强调造成永久性身体损伤。

senses.en: A numerical factor multiplying a variable or measuring a property.

ex.en: The textbook introduces correlation coefficient in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了相关系数。

ex.en: The reading connects correlation coefficient with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把相关系数和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 数学中指系数；相关系数高不代表存在因果关系。

senses.en: A woman holding a baron's rank, or a baron's wife.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a life baroness in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了终身女男爵。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a life baroness.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕终身女男爵展开说明。

col: the title of baroness｜女男爵头衔
tip: 可指本人拥有爵位的女性，也可指男爵之妻。

senses.en: an image in a shiny surface, or light bouncing back
careful thought about an experience or idea

ex.en: I copied careful reflexion into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把认真思考抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around careful reflexion.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕认真思考展开说明。

tip: reflexion 是少用变体；考试写作宜用 reflection。

senses.zh: 脊髓灰质炎；小儿麻痹症
senses.en: A viral disease that can damage nerves and cause paralysis.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about vaccination against poliomyelitis.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于预防脊髓灰质炎的疫苗接种的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss vaccination against poliomyelitis.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论预防脊髓灰质炎的疫苗接种的材料。

col: vaccination against poliomyelitis｜预防脊髓灰质炎的疫苗接种
tip: 日常多用polio；虽俗称小儿麻痹症，成人也可感染。

senses.en: To regard someone or something with deep respect.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer venerate ancestors during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时敬奉祖先。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to venerate ancestors.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得敬奉祖先。

col: venerate as a hero｜尊为英雄
tip: 正式用词，比respect语气强；后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: Requiring an exceptionally large amount of strength or effort.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a herculean task.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论艰巨的任务。

ex.en: The reading connects a herculean task with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把艰巨的任务和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 源于大力神Hercules；也常写作Herculean。

senses.en: Repeated movement backwards and forwards around a central position.
Repeated change between different values, states, or opinions.

ex.en: I copied pendulum oscillation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把钟摆摆动抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss pendulum oscillation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论钟摆摆动的材料。

tip: 既指物体往复运动，也指数值或观点的反复变化。

senses.en: A person's face or facial expression.
To accept or approve of something.

ex.en: Office hours began with a calm countenance.
ex.zh: 答疑从镇定的神情开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a calm countenance.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕镇定的神情展开说明。

tip: 名词较文学化；动词常用于否定句，意为容许。

senses.en: a special right belonging to a particular person or group

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on royal prerogative.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论王室特权。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of royal prerogative.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得王室特权这个例子。

tip: 指特定身份享有的权利，不是人人都有的普通权利。

senses.en: Waste material separated from metal during smelting

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on blast furnace slag.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论高炉矿渣。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around blast furnace slag.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕高炉矿渣展开说明。

tip: 工业义通常不可数；另有侮辱女性的英式俚语义，勿用。
note: 另有侮辱女性的英式俚语义；此处仅收工业义。

senses.en: A water channel with a gate that controls flow.
To wash something with a strong flow of water.
To flow quickly and in large amounts.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on sluice gate.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论水闸闸门。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of sluice gate.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得水闸闸门这个例子。

col: sluice down the floor｜用水冲洗地面
tip: 作动词可指冲洗；sluice gate指控制水流的闸门。

senses.en: An older term for psychological difficulties involving anxiety or distress.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on anxiety neurosis.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论焦虑性神经症。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss anxiety neurosis.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论焦虑性神经症的材料。

tip: 旧心理学术语，不等于神经衰弱；复数为neuroses。

senses.en: Arrange or style hair.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer hairdress professionally during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时专业从事美发。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to hairdress professionally.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得专业从事美发。

tip: 日常说做发型用 style hair；美发行业用 hairdressing。
note: 罕见动词，不宜作常用名词；“美发”通常用 hairdressing。

senses.en: impossible to take away or transfer to someone else

ex.en: Our professor circled inalienable rights on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不可剥夺的权利。

ex.en: A campus survey used inalienable rights to explain a pattern in public institutions.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用不可剥夺的权利来解释公共制度中的一种模式。

col: an inalienable right to freedom｜不可剥夺的自由权
tip: 正式用语，主要修饰rights，强调不能剥夺或转让。

senses.en: the weight of packaging or a container without its contents
adjust a scale to exclude the weight of a container

ex.en: Our professor circled tare weight on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了皮重。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of tare weight.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得皮重这个例子。

col: tare the scale｜将秤去皮归零
tip: 皮重是容器重量；净重等于毛重减去皮重。

senses.en: A solid block of metal cast for storage or processing.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a gold ingot in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了金锭。

ex.en: A campus survey used a gold ingot to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用金锭来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

tip: 指铸成块的金属，不专指铁或纯铁。

senses.en: containing a promise, especially a written promise to pay

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on promissory note.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论本票；期票。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of promissory note.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得本票；期票这个例子。

tip: 主要用于法律金融语境，常见搭配为promissory note。

senses.en: Caring mainly about money rather than other considerations
A soldier paid to fight for a foreign army or group

ex.en: Our professor circled mercenary motives on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了唯利是图的动机。

ex.en: The reading connects mercenary motives with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把唯利是图的动机和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 形容词带贬义，强调只看重金钱；作名词指雇佣兵。

senses.en: Acting as though you are better than other people.

ex.en: The textbook introduces haughty expression in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了傲慢的神情。

ex.en: The author returns to haughty expression when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了傲慢的神情。

tip: 含贬义，强调自视高人一等，不等于自信。

senses.en: The choice and style of words in speech or writing.
The way someone pronounces words, especially how clearly.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on formal diction.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论正式措辞。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around formal diction.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕正式措辞展开说明。

tip: 既可指用词风格，也可指吐字是否清晰。

senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of joy and delight.

ex.en: Our professor circled sheer rapture on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了无比的喜悦。

ex.en: A campus survey used sheer rapture to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用无比的喜悦来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

col: go into raptures over｜对……欣喜若狂
tip: 语气强于happiness，常带文学色彩。

senses.en: Making something false seem true or something unreal seem real.

ex.en: The textbook introduces delusive hopes in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了虚妄的希望。

ex.en: A campus survey used delusive hopes to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用虚妄的希望来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: delusive sense of security｜虚假的安全感
tip: 较正式且少见；日常多用misleading或deceptive。

senses.en: having soft, loose flesh rather than firm muscles
lacking strength, effectiveness, or clear structure

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about flabby muscles.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于松弛的肌肉的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used flabby muscles to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用松弛的肌肉来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 多指肌肉松弛；形容文章时指松散无力，语气贬义。

senses.en: To strongly urge someone to do something.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer exhort citizens to vote during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时敦促公民投票。

ex.en: The passage says students who can exhort citizens to vote follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够敦促公民投票的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: exhort someone to act｜敦促某人行动
exhort citizens to vote｜敦促公民投票
tip: 正式用词：exhort sb to do，不只是提出忠告。

senses.en: The practice or study of writing and editing dictionaries.

ex.en: Office hours began with digital lexicography.
ex.zh: 答疑从数字词典编纂开始。

ex.en: The reading connects digital lexicography with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把数字词典编纂和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: a career in lexicography｜词典编纂职业
tip: 指词典编纂或其研究，通常作不可数名词。

senses.en: appearing real but based on illusion

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about illusive appearance.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于虚幻的外表的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss illusive appearance.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论虚幻的外表的材料。

tip: 较少用，常用illusory；elusive意为难以捉摸的。

senses.en: A sequence formed by selecting elements without changing their original order.

ex.en: The textbook introduces common subsequence in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了公共子序列。

ex.en: The reading connects common subsequence with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把公共子序列和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 主要是数学、计算机术语；“后果”用consequence。

senses.en: To regret wrongdoing deeply and intend to behave better.

ex.en: The assignment is to repent of wrongdoing, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先为过错忏悔，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: The passage says students who can repent of wrongdoing follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够为过错忏悔的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 常用repent of sth；比regret更强调悔过。

senses.en: a thick clear liquid used in medicines, foods, and skincare products

ex.en: Our professor circled vegetable glycerin on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了植物甘油。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of vegetable glycerin.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得植物甘油这个例子。

tip: 不可数名词；也拼作glycerine，化学名为glycerol。

senses.en: To prevent something unwanted, or because of fearing it

ex.en: I copied lest we forget into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把以免我们忘记抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used lest we forget to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用以免我们忘记来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: lest we forget｜以免我们忘记
tip: 较正式；从句常用动词原形或should加原形。

senses.en: To dishonestly take entrusted money or property for your own use.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to misappropriate funds.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求挪用资金。

ex.en: The passage says students who can misappropriate funds follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够挪用资金的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 正式用语，常搭配funds，强调擅自挪作私用。

senses.en: The science of extracting metals and studying their properties.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about physical metallurgy.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于物理冶金学的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss physical metallurgy.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论物理冶金学的材料。

col: advances in metallurgy｜冶金技术的进步
tip: 不可数名词；从业专家称metallurgist。

senses.en: Destroy or remove something completely, leaving little or no trace.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer obliterate all traces during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时抹去所有痕迹。

ex.en: The passage says students who can obliterate all traces follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够抹去所有痕迹的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: obliterate all traces｜抹去所有痕迹
tip: 是动词，强调彻底消除，比普通 remove 语气更强。

senses.en: To prove someone innocent or show that something was justified.

ex.en: The assignment is to vindicate a decision, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先证明决定正确，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to vindicate a decision.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得证明决定正确。

col: vindicate a decision｜证明决定正确
vindicate an approach｜证明方法正确
feel vindicated｜感到自己得到证明
tip: 强调证据或结果证明正确，不只是口头辩护。

senses.en: A toxic, flammable liquid hydrocarbon used in chemical manufacturing.
